name: Alex Padilla (via Democrats.org)
subject: We will not be intimidated and we will not be deterred
body:
---
Let’s talk about what just happened, Derek: Last week, I was in the Federal Building in Los Angeles to meet with federal officials as part of my job to provide oversight and accountability of the Trump administration. While I was waiting for a scheduled briefing with General Guillot to learn more about the unprecedented military presence in Los Angeles, I learned that Secretary of Homeland Security Kristi Noem was having a press conference just down the hall. We have repeatedly asked the Trump administration for answers on the deployment of military forces and the needless escalation in Los Angeles over the last week — and have gotten limited to no information. I attended Secretary Noem’s press conference in hopes of getting some answers. After identifying myself and trying to ask a question, I was aggressively pushed out of the room, forced to the ground, and handcuffed. If that’s how this administration responds to a United States Senator with a question, imagine what they do to farm workers, day laborers, cooks, and the other nonviolent immigrants they are targeting in California and across the country. If that’s what the Trump Administration will do to a U.S. Senator with cameras broadcasting live — imagine what they’ll do to Americans when the cameras are off. **Imagine what they can do to anyone who dares to speak up.** This is a wake-up call for our nation. An attack on anyone’s rights is an attack on everyone’s rights. Derek, we will not be intimidated and we will not be deterred. We must hold this administration accountable. **[If you’re with me, I hope you’ll consider splitting a contribution between my campaign and the DNC. Right now, it’s essential that we come together to stand against Trump and his allies’ abuse of power. Each donation helps send a powerful message.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-padilla-split?amount=10&refcode=em_20250617_3755_fr&refcode2=3755_22930333_ZwDTlS&akid=3755%2E22930333%2EZwDTlS) _If you've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your split contribution between Alex Padilla and the Democratic National Committee instantly:_ | | | **[Donate $10](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-padilla-split?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=em_20250617_3755_fr&refcode2=3755_22930333_ZwDTlS&akid=3755%2E22930333%2EZwDTlS)**

body:
My name is Abigail Spanberger, and I'm the Democratic nominee for Governor in Virginia's general election.

**My name is Abigail Spanberger, and I'm the Democratic nominee for Governor in Virginia's general election.** I'm ready to flip the Governor's office blue this November, defeat Trump's agenda at the ballot box, and get to work creating a more affordable Commonwealth for all.
But one lesson I learned during my years in Congress and at CIA is that a strong team beats going at it alone every time, so I hope you will join my campaign today.
**[Will you become a founding member of my campaign for Governor by splitting a $10 contribution with Wes Moore? There's no bigger election this year than here in Virginia, and I feel the responsibility to set the tone by winning big — but I can only deliver if we raise the resources to air ads, hire organizers, and turn out voters.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250618-1?refcode=em-20250618-1&refcode2=187_1086043_ViaHXU&akid=187%2E1086043%2EViaHXU)**

Abigail Spanberger

body:
I'm ready to put up a fight

|

Peter,

A few days ago, as we were getting ready to launch this campaign, my daughter asked me: _What's it like to run for Congress?_

I told her the truth — it isn’t easy. It takes persistence, and it takes heart. But I love my community, so I keep going.

I came to Iowa to give my family a better opportunity, and in the more than two decades since, I’ve come to love this state for what it is: a hard-working, kind, and community-oriented place full of people who look out for one another. That’s who we are, and we deserve leaders who reflect those same values.

Last year, we lost this race by just 799 votes. Now, it's still a toss-up, and I'm ready to win this thing in 2026.

Since our announcement this morning, I'm overwhelmed with gratitude, and I can’t thank you all enough. But if we’re going to show we have what it takes to flip this seat blue in 2026, we need to be all in, together.

body:
My name is Abigail Spanberger, and I'm the Democratic nominee for Governor in Virginia's general election.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250617_2_spanberger?amount=5&refcode=em20250617-2668&refcode2=2668_400544_tUlXrE&akid=2668%2E400544%2EtUlXrE)
Team, the polls just closed. Now, it's official:
**My name is Abigail Spanberger, and I'm the Democratic nominee for Governor in Virginia's general election.** I'm ready to flip the Governor's office blue this November, defeat Trump's agenda at the ballot box, and get to work creating a more affordable Commonwealth for all.
But one lesson I learned during my years in Congress and at CIA is that a strong team beats going at it alone every time, so I hope you will join my campaign today.
[**Will you become a founding member of my campaign for Governor by splitting a $5 contribution with Deb Haaland? There's no bigger election this year than here in Virginia, and I feel the responsibility to set the tone by winning big — but I can only deliver if we raise the resources to air ads, hire organizers, and turn out voters.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250617_2_spanberger?amount=5&refcode=em20250617-2668&refcode2=2668_400544_tUlXrE&akid=2668%2E400544%2EtUlXrE)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250617_2_spanberger?amount=5&refcode=em20250617-2668&refcode2=2668_400544_tUlXrE&akid=2668%2E400544%2EtUlXrE)**
In a few short months, we can start Democrats on a winning streak by flipping Virginia blue.
It's not going to be easy.
Four years ago, we lost this same Governor's race by _two points_ and saw years of progress erased in an instant. And my opponent Winsome Earle-Sears has shown she will indulge in fearmongering and disinformation to keep Virginia under Republican control.
Your contribution today, whatever the amount, will help us rise above the attacks and build a winning campaign that reflects our shared values.
If you're fed up with the chaos coming out of Washington, if you're outraged watching GOP officials bend their knee rather than uphold their oath, I am counting on your immediate and full support.
[**Click this link to complete your donation and become a founding member of my campaign for Governor.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250617_2_spanberger?amount=5&refcode=em20250617-2668&refcode2=2668_400544_tUlXrE&akid=2668%2E400544%2EtUlXrE) Together, we will flip Virginia blue and send a resounding message to this White House and beyond that voters will not stand for the corruption, the attacks on fundamental rights, and the brazen disregard for the needs of working families.
**[Contribute »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250617_2_spanberger?amount=5&refcode=em20250617-2668&refcode2=2668_400544_tUlXrE&akid=2668%2E400544%2EtUlXrE)**
I'm honored by the trust you are placing in me. Virginia is where I grew up and where I'm raising my three girls, and I refuse to let far-right extremism win the day.
With immense gratitude,
Abigail Spanberger

## Trump Demands Iran's "Complete Give-Up"
President Trump [demanded Iran's "complete give-up"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHunDAMx_GnCZtPwccBHRi6sP27dkSGmDu3IYkS3yHevkpf4T9b-uj39e-v5YvES3j-ooMn3eMS-CyeVTkviYK-OJdTQlEKnq_tnTS_jwUtPsD20I6LI_HX0jVu2pmR7w1P7fCw2LVtNzSvyfXr0G3DShbduP4YH7vlfrduW3FYW7o3MlXN9u3YWvvo7jdi7Mdx3IYdaV-3zXSWnWjMtz9R6qLdX_HD-bbFo_HTSzUVc_9pcDY4hyvFovVkcK6wwdn2Bud2MDifMXsHNdHgXEsSOD4ouAJbPJJnZXjKh-GdYL1AMgWgAlIysQelv1wgvhWUX5lCgSMWhcJBYoZDvCjlq0qV5GxwbvLk0ineS-kH09nnQeL_D9dvffsz4b8AAAD__-Vtl3g) and said he's seeking "a real end" to the escalating Israel-Iran conflict, not just a ceasefire, after cutting short his G7 summit participation to return to Washington. Trump said Tuesday the U.S. [knows where Iran's Supreme Leader](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3u4yAQxJ_G7ohg-TAuKK5Jl2uvtDawJHvC2MIkUd7-5HuFfzkaaeY38-e23JAL18dvXCn0vC2VPkeh3qktO9b-pHZ8uB4da6FvfO29vdYFJFghnVB-Scjlu5gxhUwEpEcKarISjFJmGp9BZ61dsilqp1D6qFyyziEkLe9KWxo5nGnSKa-ktEZfkMB57-OUAfM9xsFISty3dvm78UmUy3d7U7vEbR1LePa-H4P-NcB1gCvu54DTOkXrHAsNcD2pd8ENq6ivWAib4KMhFfGYhNKQZsj6brORysRISUUrYU5ez0jz2ELaP1wKH24ajHysyOV_e__RZe8A_wIAAP__cuZ_jg) Ayatollah Ali Khamenei is hiding but won't kill him "for now," while urging Iran's "unconditional surrender" as the five-day conflict continues. Israel said it killed Ali Shadmani, Iran's wartime chief of staff and most senior military commander, as part of an ongoing offensive that has reportedly killed more than 20 Iranian senior military officers since Friday. Aerial footage showed massive traffic jams as thousands of Iranians fled the capital after five days of Israeli airstrikes. [See it here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkbGupDAMRb8mdB6FDDC8gmIburftlsgTHPBTiFFiBvH3K_YXtrNl6cjn3j_f0zdy5LT8xo0GDTIlOkskVcrTjklXyuXkVBRTpMsfu-Zjm5x1LdgO6n6akeM1NdU8BCJHz4qG-tVa19R186rWgZ5NP7u6Jf_lMHh8-7fta_zq-tDS3DYVDzfNdnVfW9s2zweS6_q-96_gMLy9N42lmVXy40f4_ijESz6UH162Kg6r6l7M85dxo3FjunYpep-MG2-wcaPtjBvrl3HjKTnOcCsaNxZ5U-a0QBBRXAjKKmeBDUvhD4FmDIE9_OAGWEBXOQqmuUDImJQ9xnhBiESgtGZMcLKucMezA5dy3GTZOMlR4MSc7v2SIxMscs8qEDjNIIcaN1Z5mPeTY-TSvUxjlw05_jPU_6rlM7i_AQAA__9EUKey).
## NYC Comptroller Arrested by ICE
New York City Comptroller and mayoral candidate [Brad Lander was arrested Tuesday by ICE](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uwyAURp8Gb0Rw_ZuBoQtbuna0ruGSUGFAQBK5T1-5r9D5k47Od75u6w198PH-iTup5tIa6V0DtUZlzRjbg0p9-1gbxkCHeeZWnvsKAkYuJi6X1aIPxzp0VjkioL4jJedRwCDlMHcPJWDozTKO0uGVpJgNObuJ-bqI3oreuM6rkyYmuUghxqG_IMG0LIuZHaDbjGGDIOtbKpfv5E8jF470onIxae-CerSWK-s_GGgGOh451XZODPQJZqDFxEDLmYF-Vn7-Y6BN2nMrKQQqfCtoecBoqXAshWojy7eDe0McG3dkqWDgOeAPch95PAwD3RVl89uH4Os0s0Hcd_Thz6n9K-RLwW8AAAD__8ifiCI) agents outside a Manhattan immigration court after trying to block the detention of a man leaving immigration court. Lander refused to release the man to ICE officers without a judicial warrant, leading to a scuffle that was caught on video. [See the footage here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1urDAUBOCnMd0i_2HcuLjSiltEmyJNlMoy5nhxZDAyh7V4-4i8QtoZ6dNoPh_24WKK6_PdLWAwZLtC3RMgQrGbW3GGste47ujWBKc_NizHYjnl3Y2qG9N2cjGdVjaTCQAcRAOG9R3lkjHZN7OhYdQaptAHGWjvAuNsFEop6DqupBdNNJdGFdOM0k6K1gFXWmvfB-7C6D2RFKaIubTfOV6LQjrzC0rr89IkMyNuOxH_CB8IH2qt7ZkPPEa4-itx6GcihhcR94_7c-jeHjb8_2qKmbYaU4q76omkz8XF9Evin354Gf4TAAD__-nuchk). He was held for several hours but released after charges of assaulting and obstructing federal officers were dropped.
## Streaming Surpasses Traditional TV
For the first time in TV history, streaming platforms have [overtaken cable and broadcast combined](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOtCAUBeCnwU4DV1Qair-xm7_d0lzxMrJBNHBnyLz9xn2FrU_ynZPz9VgeGGJIz_94kGV_LolqicRMebkw8U651JAKY4r0ca-L8-tYQMLQyrFVZtkwxM-im816IqC-IaumQYJWSk_Nbv0qEfrJkHZqVBqcdgSDV8p4LQ3KJthbk6MySspB9x0SjMYYN3lAvzontKQt8Jm77zPci3z8nG_KnTuPJtqd-Sqi_ydgFjDXWjuXVneHAuabFjDLUcCsJgFz4Ux4hPRs13zi5rBw63CN1PK72_mITbbbVUOMoYyT0PJ5YIi_Vfynf94WfgIAAP___e95VA) in U.S. TV viewership, grabbing 44.8% of all screen time in May, according to Nielsen. The combination of broadcast, with 20.1%, and all cable channels, with 24.1%, represented 44.2% of TV viewing, according to Nielsen. Other TV uses, including video games and DVD viewing, made up the small remainder. YouTube and Netflix alone made up [nearly 20% of total U.S. viewing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3O2zAQBU9DdTTINSXKBQsDiVJ9aVKkFFbUymbMH4NcW_DtA-UKqQcYzHu_v-YvDDHk209M5Hgrc6a9RWKmOj8x851q20NujDnSx7-eXF9pBgW9VIPU47xiiJ_ZdKvbiIDOHTltewVGa2O7u9PWjsPW62VAMP5i1XJRF6t7bfy5B2264A6bGvSolerN-YQEwziO3m6A2-K9MIrWwKWe_pRwFG3xU95UT76kLro787OJ81XAJGDa9_2UWj6YgImyfDUBE78FTMcyAVPjSphCvsl74CZRphCpcckkDyvj42Ael0gS8yqXWnD12Fj6kpaQaZUhS37LVyMBE1Z5veofv74_vnXVrc89xBjaYIVRt4Qh_qvk_7r27eBvAAAA___FvY9F). Free ad-supported services like Tubi, Roku Channel, and Pluto TV also played a key role in the surge.

## Political Protests and Violence
Texas Democrats Veronica Escobar of El Paso and Joaquin Castro of San Antonio said their names were [among the 45 elected officials](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O2zAQhJ9G6miQtCjTBYs07i5tSmFFruTF8efAXZzstw90yBukGgwG-DAzfz6WD6BMdf8NBYO8trZUPDijCPZlg08s0DvBjpHkvVFHzsCyWG2d0rMyfklA-b1MYwqrTnczYjA3p-00Td6Nz7BODs06r2lzHlKyMdlJm5ub3epNNHGkcML0bLwx2pj7ZdXJOX9Nt2uM_u71MGlMJK1f5ImCL-Atv9s39ktsZczhKfLFw_XXYB-DfRzHcfl8QT3DwT7ONaeAUKuQ1T8vR1M_KBVb3TsyFywrdlYVCibVqoKcccekCtWK3AQUMAMzVVZPEpWJZbCPsYf0dVDOxPNtmPRegPJPM_m_P7-D_RsAAP__nOONtA) on a “hit list” compiled by Vance Boelter, the man charged with murdering one Democratic lawmaker and wounding another in Minnesota. On Monday, it was reported that Boelter had attended Christ for the Nations Institute in Dallas, graduating in 1990. "_This is not what we teach_ ," [said the school](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFygzAQRL8GOjGSLIEoVKShc9qUzFk6zE0E8kgXY_99hvxCui3e7M6-r-t8BUq03z9hQ8-vJc87HjUhM5Z5gW_coBSCOwbi90IFa4LKs5baCtkL5eYIlN6zaaO_yTiqFr0arNTGGGfb1Wsch7Ef0SlwMkgF2BtA3dvxpK1tyZ9lsldOKanU2N1ktNZd4nAJwY1ONkZiJM6l4xUZX1CX9M5PLF3IW5v8yvyozeWj0VOjp-M4uiW_zHnjBBo9nbHR0xP2gOKWMTEWESElqCKshSqLJRfBK4odmPJeBe2ViX8Y2-Lj46CUqPZDY-R9A0p_w_w_XU-vfwMAAP__J6SA1g) in a statement. In related news, the suspect accused of planning an attack on lawmakers at the Texas Capitol on Saturday has been identified as Robert Leroy Bowers, 45, of Katy. Authorities arrested Bowers in Fayette County after being [alerted of his intentions](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L3unDAQBPCngc4n25ivwkUaun_alGixF1idsZG9grs8fXT3CqlH-s1o_vzMP0CB4vYbDrT8WtMc8S4BmTHPKzzxgJwJNnTE75UylgCFZy11K2Qn1DB7oPCeTe3tIv2oarSqb6U2xgxtvduhV2Pr5LIo3UnjHYy9aUfnVnBN1zWmJvvBZKcGpaRS42ORvm2HxveNc8M4yMpI9MQpP3hHxheUNbzThfnh0lEHuzOfpWp-VXqq9HTf9-P5gvgJKz1RvLAwbcCUYqn05M8imE6x5nQIl6LDHNELR0x_MYqMF0JAL3jPCCw4iR3yIb69IsB9wBPzB6qz9edNIVDp-srI7QAK30n8f0deVv8LAAD__1Fbis0) by a friend. Yesterday, the Texas Department of Public Safety stated that [nine people were arrested](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQhZ8Gd1gwgA0FxTbusu2WFoaxg4J_BGycvP2Vo7zBbecbfTrn_LuNNxdT3Ja_bkVbX_M-bniWhLViHmf3wNXlHN2CPtb3HDOW5EodgYGirKNcj8HF9B5lE-zEguENWt4rBlJKrZq7DdPkAUIHrp_BKME5eNEFoxmbRUDWRHvJWMc154xz004sKKVF6IX32mhGJMMQ657beseKL1fm9N6fmFu_r02y91qPQsQfAgOB4TzP9vH8jxckMLhco09IYLh6ERjS7l0iMBx5r1jqdfo4aTgK3Xb6iNtS6JdSl_P3CTpDPQti6r2m06QklQY1NWo2VEkUTgH3HPom23CcMaVYup5Itqwupk_S-rt9nxZ-AgAA__-EY42F) during Saturday’s “No Kings” protest in Austin. Local police also arrested three people during the demonstration, and three officers were injured.
## Woman Fraudulently Marries Ex-Boyfriend
A 42-year-old Central Texas man was surprised to learn that he was [married to his ex-girlfriend](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ8Gd0SAIXYKF9e4-6-90lrDEq-CTQT7h-TtT4nunuBvppiRPs3Mn6_lCyjRcf0NO078jHk5sNWEzFiWCDfcoRSCK3riV6SCNUHlxSjjpDpLPS4BKL0W24VpVeGiO5z04JSx1o6u2yazxov16Ia4KmdHbZz1qh8Bh753wZqOpjdMnfWotdL6clpVcG7sw9B7P15GJazCQJzLiTdkfEKN6ZUfWE4-712aNuZ7Ff0vYWZh5tba6db4-Q6Fmd9sYWZ1FmbWb2ngs_xQZMs7HNLn40GHxyDvUDkX6bEwxZdc8_W7yv_7_9nkgVFCZCwyEhxeriXfUH7fZSPe5IZFmLkrU7g3SonqeRBWXXeg9KnLPzv5MZm_AQAA___QmJI4) on Friday when he received a gift bag from her with a copy of a marriage certificate from the McLennan County Clerk’s Office. Kristin Marie Spearman, 36, is accused of [obtaining the fraudulent certificate](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOgzAQBNCvgc7INrYhhYtr0uXaK9Fir8PqDET2Kgl_fyK_cP1oRm9-btMNKNN2_4YVPb_TPm34qhmZsUwJfnGFUgjuGIiPRAVrhsqTltoK6YQapwiUj8m00c8yXlSLXg1WamPMaNvFozUGBuucTXoeHEA0qg9DgFkHN4NsyZ9l0qlRKanUpZtltHbs49CHMF5G2RiJkXgvHS_I-Iaa8rE_sXRhX9vsF-ZHbfqvRl8bfQ3QnYLugGXfz0SjrytsItEWq_hoMAp8i0QZq9BKGqOV67uF19wWHx8vypmqGxoj7ytQ_szw_855ev0XAAD__xL7eIw) by convincing a local pastor to sign a marriage license the former couple had received before her boyfriend broke off the relationship. Spearman left the document at her ex-boyfriend’s house with gifts from Bath & Body Works and a photo of herself holding the signed marriage license. "_I don’t think in 23 years I’ve ever heard of anybody who managed somehow to get married to someone who wasn’t present for a ceremony_ ," [said Beverly Hills Police Chief Kory Martin](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL_O4yAQxJ8Gd1iA8b-C4hp3ufZKi8Bio2CIYBPitz85-t7g63ZXO6P5zb_betM--Lj91Qco_Li0RqglACLk1ekHHDpnrzcwHk_nM5SgC66CiZ6ygfJptdqHc5WNVXdmZ96A4mPPhJRy6ptdjd3sRifBmc5YEK4TnYX5roeeDdbA1Hh1mbGBT5wzzuf2zmzfT50dO2OmeWJEMrAeU25xB4SPLi6c6Q25NelogtoRn4V0f4hYiFhqra1LHykvjuuDiOUaiVhCMjrQn-UwAWLUkZr0inheFx2p89EWugOtutAvOlhaPe7phXT3hT5iqgHsBrSmS6BzhoJgiViarOyz-hB8GUYi2XZoH74Z8XfNvpX4HwAA__9JRpEZ). Neither the victim nor the pastor has been identified. Spearman was charged with [third-degree felony stalking](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbHOnDAQhJ_GdD7ZxuZ8BUUauj9tSrS3XmCFwb_M5rh7-4hIeYKUoxmN9M38-hq_gDPv80_YqJf3VMadziOTCNVxgpU2qJVhJmT5TFzpyHDI6IwL2nTaxjEB58_om9Q_TXrYhnp7D8Z572Nolp6etvMmtK4F8s67OFE3-balzkTCZBvurzLT2WitsfZxe5oUQmzTvUWMj2iUN5RYSr3JQkJvOKb8KS-qNyxbk_tF5PtQ7Q_lBuWG8zxvK9Iur8tWboAqjJmUGy4y5YZcEPKVBCz6LBvsGheoMyV9COSV91nDJFT1TCKX-reBzoy0H6RPlqX8Fk1vve7l5H1WbgjGaBfBJ-tRTxiN9jaCjmhJB2vDM93RJIxN7dP3yTnz0d2VN_MGnP-yyP898OrdnwAAAP__KT-axw) and is being held at the McLennan County Jail on a $10,000 bond.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

I've been getting a lot of questions/texts about what's happening with Israel and Iran right now. For background, as an active duty Marine I spent my third tour at the Pentagon on the Joint Staff working counter-proliferation and arms control portfolios. The counter-proliferation work gave me significant insight into Iran's proliferation efforts and the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (the JCPOA/2015 Iran nuclear deal) was in my arms control portfolio before we stopped participating in it.
With that background, these are my hot takes jammed out in 30 minutes on a Wednesday morning.
Lucas's Substack is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9sdWNhc2t1bmNlLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.0Op62VEvdGuDgQxtxEHxcuD5N5_EaXr7Wl_Qxb2Cz7U?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=166236904)
1. Iran has talked about the destruction of Israel for as long as I can remember and built or supported organizations that made it seem like they meant it (Hamas, Hezbollah, the Houthis to some extent). So it's no surprise that Israel wants to get rid of the current regime and weaken Iran's military.
2. Iran is at the weakest it has been in a long time. It's proxy network is absolutely decimated, Assad is gone in Syria, Russia is consumed by Ukraine, Israel knocked out a lot of their air defenses last October, and the economy has long been in shambles. It makes perfect sense militarily for Israel to strike right now, and probably makes great sense for Netanyahu politically and personally, so this isn't surprising.
3. There was an opportunity to get a better deal than the JCPOA and we trashed it. The last point on Iran's weakness, the state of the economy, was one of the reasons the JCPOA was accomplished and the reason that Iran (despite what hardliners in the US said) was following the JCPOA. Because they really needed sanctions lifted. Likewise, it's the basis for my belief that Iran would have been open to a second round of negotiations beyond the JCPOA during the first Trump administration. They really wanted to lift the banking/money sanctions at the time because the JCPOA didn't improve their economy the way they thought it would. We could tried to negotiate another deal, giving them more economic access for true guarantees and access to their facilities regarding nuclear weapons, but the administration chose to trash the deal instead and put us on this path.
4. Iran has long been a proliferator of missile technology and likely has nuclear weapon aspirations. Frankly, given our track record of taking out regimes that give up their WMD programs either by choice (see Muammar Gaddafi in Libya) or by circumstance (see Saddam Hussein in Iraq), and the security that Kim Jong Un has seemingly secured himself in North Korea, we have created every incentive for these regimes to build nuclear weapons.
5. That said, I don't think they were super close and I think there were enough incentives in place to try to negotiate a deal, which we were apparently doing. There is a good chance that Israel was worried those negotiations might progress and decided to keep that from happening.
6. Netanyahu really doesn't want the US to make a deal with Iran and, even more, wants to drag the US into this conflict. In his ideal world, he convinces the US to drop some bombs in Iran, Iran does something to one of the US bases in Iraq or the middle east that we are stupid and wasteful enough to still have their, maybe some US servicemembers die, and then we do the rest of Netanyahu's work for him by toppling the Iranian regime. It wouldn't be the first time. [We actually overthrew Iran's democratically elected regime in the 1950's](https://substack.com/redirect/ca91973d-1384-45cd-b106-d3986ef83135?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for British Petroleum when the Brits weren't able to accomplish it themselves.
7. The biggest wildcard here is obviously Donald Trump. Will he continue to pretend to be anti-war ([he has, in fact, been the opposite](https://substack.com/redirect/651def66-425a-46d0-bc5b-dc041321c4ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), basically the same as everyone else)? Will he see this as an opportunity to look tough? Will he see this as an opportunity to start a big enough war that he can use it as a pretext for positioning for that third term? There's no telling, honestly. Like everyone else, I have no special insight into his mind, so I'll just have to leave you with my expertise above and one last thing: Iran is huge, much bigger in population and size than Iraq and Afghanistan and we know what boots on the ground were like there and the lack of success there, both militarily and in the regime change. The Iranian people are deeply discontent with their government and most likely blame their government for what is happening right now. I would bet a large majority are even happy about some of their military leaders being killed. They want to move on and historically/culturally could easily align with the US some day if we don't mess it up by killing a bunch of civilians or supporting their killing. We should be expressing extreme support for the people of Iran right now and backing that up with actions that show we care about them.

Lucas

My perspective as a former arms control and counter-proliferation officer at the Pentagon | | | Jun 18 | | | | | | | | | | | | I've been getting a lot of questions/texts about what's happening with Israel and Iran right now. For background, as an active duty Marine I spent my third tour at the Pentagon on the Joint Staff working counter-proliferation and arms control portfolios. The counter-proliferation work gave me significant insight into Iran's proliferation efforts and the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (the JCPOA/2015 Iran nuclear deal) was in my arms control portfolio before we stopped participating in it. With that background, these are my hot takes jammed out in 30 minutes on a Wednesday morning. Lucas's Substack is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. 1. Iran has talked about the destruction of Israel for as long as I can remember and built or supported organizations that made it seem like they meant it (Hamas, Hezbollah, the Houthis to some extent). So it's no surprise that Israel wants to get rid of the current regime and weaken Iran's military. 2. Iran is at the weakest it has been in a long time. It's proxy network is absolutely decimated, Assad is gone in Syria, Russia is consumed by Ukraine, Israel knocked out a lot of their air defenses last October, and the economy has long been in shambles. It makes perfect sense militarily for Israel to strike right now, and probably makes great sense for Netanyahu politically and personally, so this isn't surprising. 3. There was an opportunity to get a better deal than the JCPOA and we trashed it. The last point on Iran's weakness, the state of the economy, was one of the reasons the JCPOA was accomplished and the reason that Iran (despite what hardliners in the US said) was following the JCPOA. Because they really needed sanctions lifted. Likewise, it's the basis for my belief that Iran would have been open to a second round of negotiations beyond the JCPOA during the first Trump administration. They really wanted to lift the banking/money sanctions at the time because the JCPOA didn't improve their economy the way they thought it would. We could tried to negotiate another deal, giving them more economic access for true guarantees and access to their facilities regarding nuclear weapons, but the administration chose to trash the deal instead and put us on this path. 4. Iran has long been a proliferator of missile technology and likely has nuclear weapon aspirations. Frankly, given our track record of taking out regimes that give up their WMD programs either by choice (see Muammar Gaddafi in Libya) or by circumstance (see Saddam Hussein in Iraq), and the security that Kim Jong Un has seemingly secured himself in North Korea, we have created every incentive for these regimes to build nuclear weapons. 5. That said, I don't think they were super close and I think there were enough incentives in place to try to negotiate a deal, which we were apparently doing. There is a good chance that Israel was worried those negotiations might progress and decided to keep that from happening. 6. Netanyahu really doesn't want the US to make a deal with Iran and, even more, wants to drag the US into this conflict. In his ideal world, he convinces the US to drop some bombs in Iran, Iran does something to one of the US bases in Iraq or the middle east that we are stupid and wasteful enough to still have their, maybe some US servicemembers die, and then we do the rest of Netanyahu's work for him by toppling the Iranian regime. It wouldn't be the first time. for British Petroleum when the Brits weren't able to accomplish it themselves. 7. The biggest wildcard here is obviously Donald Trump. Will he continue to pretend to be anti-war (, basically the same as everyone else)? Will he see this as an opportunity to look tough? Will he see this as an opportunity to start a big enough war that he can use it as a pretext for positioning for that third term? There's no telling, honestly. Like everyone else, I have no special insight into his mind, so I'll just have to leave you with my expertise above and one last thing: Iran is huge, much bigger in population and size than Iraq and Afghanistan and we know what boots on the ground were like there and the lack of success there, both militarily and in the regime change. The Iranian people are deeply discontent with their government and most likely blame their government for what is happening right now. I would bet a large majority are even happy about some of their military leaders being killed. They want to move on and historically/culturally could easily align with the US some day if we don't mess it up by killing a bunch of civilians or supporting their killing. We should be expressing extreme support for the people of Iran right now and backing that up with actions that show we care about them. Lucas PS- Sorry for any typos, no time to edit! Even with today's endless cavalcade of corruption and bad policy, it's impossible to get angry about everything. You'll lose your mind.1
It's fine--and justified--to be angry. But I encourage people to [focus on one or two things](https://substack.com/redirect/97359f02-e33e-4597-b963-f36380bc83c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), because that's the most impactful way to channel your energy.
**For me, one of those issues: vaccines.** The anti-vaccination movement is a moral and scientific outrage; people, children especially, are needlessly suffering and dying. That's [tragically on display in West Texas](https://substack.com/redirect/deb6fc85-7d66-4064-9715-0fd93a222b40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Sanity is losing right now. The science and pro-vaccine communities--that is to say, the people who are correct--are not doing a good job presenting their case. The anti-vaccine people are gaining ground because they're running a campaign on fear.
It's time to aggressively fight back.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTY1ODc0MjU0LCJzIjoyNDQwMzk4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzUwMjUxNDc4LCJleHAiOjE3NTI4NDM0NzgsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.KBXTBbZdVHoUrPS7KBgoGBWmohayo2NwQtj3pcz8PLw?)
### The miracle of vaccines
This should go without saying but I'll say it anyway: vaccines are miracles. They're an absolute scientific wonder; the eradication of smallpox is [arguably the most extraordinary accomplishment](https://substack.com/redirect/e5ad60e2-3667-41c5-ad24-392c08ad040d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the history of human civilization.2
Polio, measles, and rubella had all been eliminated in the U.S. The death rate from infectious diseases has [been in decline for decades](https://substack.com/redirect/3c51116b-abb1-40aa-8819-bb83940cb40f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), even with a recent COVID spike.
We slayed [one of the Four Horsemen](https://substack.com/redirect/681e9533-8cac-456d-ae0b-71f2263846fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the Apocalypse.3 And now, for no good reason, Bobby Kennedy, Jr. and the Trump Administration are bringing that Horseman back to life.
### The dangerously effective anti-vaccine movement
I mean this sincerely: Bobby Kennedy, Jr. is one of the worst people in America.4 But he's not dumb, at least in the sense that he knows how to get his (wrong and dangerous) message out there. [Skepticism around vaccines is as high as it's been](https://substack.com/redirect/cbe1cc55-ce46-493d-936e-0170d9101072?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on record.5
Why? Some of this is a function of people with platforms spreading misinformation: Bobby Kennedy, Jr., [Tucker Carlson](https://substack.com/redirect/383fa224-8dab-4215-91ed-3e413815aa88?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Ron Johnson](https://substack.com/redirect/7734feaa-72ac-44d3-9e06-f6b7bc053664?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Marianne Williamson](https://substack.com/redirect/0672c3ec-111b-4257-8ca2-309d88f2d517?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and others.6 And some of this is a function of silos on social media: people who consume diverse media are [much likelier to get vaccinated](https://substack.com/redirect/1a66dfeb-4d8f-4a89-b6da-4a3ec56fe402?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
But a lot of this comes down to the power of fear.
### Fear is a powerful--and lopsided--motivator
On July 29, 1944, my great-grandfather Leon wrote my grandmother Kit a letter. She was 12 years old and away at summer camp.
Leon was a collegiate swimmer and he'd stuck with the hobby for decades. But when he wrote the letter, he hadn't gone swimming in over a month. Why? An outbreak of "Infantile," shorthand for [infantile paralysis](https://substack.com/redirect/c8f436f5-3c72-470a-98e0-2771ba1c231c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--a disease we know today as polio.
"We are glad that you didn't go to North Carolina," my great-grandfather wrote in that letter, "because there are one thousand cases of Infantile in that state."
A family friend, who grew up in St. Louis and recently turned 100, mentioned a few years ago that several of her elementary-school classmates spent time in [iron lungs](https://substack.com/redirect/84876110-5ee8-49af-a336-78254d224ee4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Children and parents lived in fear of the iron lung for decades; they don't anymore.7
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/92275d02-4550-452d-a986-33cf152555b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A young child in an iron lung, from 1955. (Source: [World Health Organization](https://substack.com/redirect/92275d02-4550-452d-a986-33cf152555b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
What do parents fear today? Well, too many fear things that are patently untrue: that vaccines cause autism ([false](https://substack.com/redirect/497ef3c6-5a7c-4172-a080-d1760e9fb726?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) or that they alter your DNA ([false](https://substack.com/redirect/693a5255-bf6e-4b22-8c5d-401d6f7f8712?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) or that they infect you with diseases ([false](https://substack.com/redirect/079bdb28-6b72-416c-805b-43504723d2c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) or that they contain microchips to track or control you ([false](https://substack.com/redirect/d5685550-009d-4dea-80dd-a4488a596057?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
**But these are all real narratives, that real people --people trying to make the best, if misinformed, decisions for their children--believe. Their information is wrong but their fear is genuine.**
The average age of a mom giving birth in the U.S. today is [about 30 years old](https://substack.com/redirect/eadc41c3-2523-4de0-b577-6e7aefd7fec1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That means that she was born in 1995, [decades after the eradication](https://substack.com/redirect/430d1702-d90e-4a95-97e3-f15821b03262?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of yellow fever, smallpox, and polio in the U.S.
She's never experienced the fear that my grandmother and great-grandfather felt. As I've talked about before, when it comes to vaccines, we're [victims of our own success](https://substack.com/redirect/e5ad60e2-3667-41c5-ad24-392c08ad040d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But we need to make people fear these diseases, because [they're worth fearing](https://substack.com/redirect/50289445-9891-4d15-acb2-188dcb503b45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Gaines County, Texas--the [epicenter of the recent measles outbreak](https://substack.com/redirect/deb6fc85-7d66-4064-9715-0fd93a222b40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--has one of the [lowest measles vaccination rates](https://substack.com/redirect/067cf680-6810-45a7-aba8-fc39df56d004?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the country.8 But even in Gaines County--where there's demonstrable skepticism around vaccines--there's been a [spike in the number of children getting vaccinated](https://substack.com/redirect/d07a6801-7a3b-4e17-9f55-639fef0f2d7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Why? Fear is a powerful motivator, especially when the devil is on your doorstep.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=165874254&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTY1ODc0MjU0LCJpYXQiOjE3NTAyNTE0NzgsImV4cCI6MTc1Mjg0MzQ3OCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.kySNam_yGDMlPwS98hCbvx3p1HsyiPz4d2oqrkNch-A)
### Scientists: great at saving lives, bad at marketing
People should fear measles, fear polio, fear rubella, and fear other diseases. But scientists aren't conveying that message particularly well. Take a look at the CDC's websites for [measles](https://substack.com/redirect/1eb36c9c-b526-42d2-8c3b-e6b15d0df313?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [polio](https://substack.com/redirect/5e7a8e43-b7a6-4fd7-9213-d0287c9c1f22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).9
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b7648f28-d704-4afd-8faf-b043e08ca173?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Factual? Yes. But these websites are also boring, and I sincerely doubt they're changing anyone's mind. On top of that, [only 59% of Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/86bcb3e9-8845-494e-861d-56ac5e26d12e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) say that they trust the CDC,10 so they're starting from behind.
COVID-19 was a vicious disease. But it wasn't visually gruesome in the way that polio and measles are.
The pro-science people are often too in the weeds and too lost in the data. **We need to deploy some of the same tactics of fear that have been so successful for the anti-vaccination crusaders.**
This is what smallpox, polio, and measles look like. They were painful and unspeakably horrible diseases that, in many cases, hit children hardest. When you talk about this stuff--on social media, with vaccine skeptical friends and family--**you need to remind people how terrible these afflictions were**. We can start to do that by sharing pictures and stories more broadly than anything I'm seeing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1b29d13a-531b-4eae-8043-8b83e42bf2b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Two colorized photographs of children with smallpox. [Left, from 1901](https://substack.com/redirect/78e7983f-9860-4d1a-bc86-bfa207a409ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); [right, from the 1970s](https://substack.com/redirect/ebad9d65-6b9a-40c9-ae70-bb7846376894?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1bbdb075-e16f-417d-b76a-e86e94ff2614?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Left, a [polio ward filled with iron lungs](https://substack.com/redirect/9c1bc7e0-3e41-4419-8a89-a56ae6d0f346?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Right, a colorized photograph of a [child recovering from polio](https://substack.com/redirect/2c9b18b1-2a3e-4a39-b482-b62b0d4c2367?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/236b9142-0633-479b-b5b5-64012e842e8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Two](https://substack.com/redirect/173692f0-9b7d-48f9-a292-cab4bed91905?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [people](https://substack.com/redirect/2bc9fbcc-1175-47a2-9bc8-338a1544950d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) suffering from measles.
But it goes beyond that. Remember the panic at the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic?
That baseline level of panic, fear, and paranoia was a way of life--except these diseases are much likelier to kill children, and they were around much more consistently.
[Here's a quote from David Oshinsky](https://substack.com/redirect/9c1bc7e0-3e41-4419-8a89-a56ae6d0f346?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a historian who wrote _[Polio: An American Story](https://substack.com/redirect/d34e56bf-0386-4918-a0f8-376905f7ff4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ and lived through polio epidemics himself. (Emphasis added.)
> **The public was horribly and understandably frightened by polio. There was no prevention and no cure. Everyone was at risk, especially children. There was nothing a parent could do to protect the family.** I grew up in this era. Each summer, polio would come like The Plague. Beaches and pools would close -- because of the fear that the poliovirus was waterborne. Children had to stay away from crowds, so they often were banned from movie theaters, bowling alleys, and the like. My mother gave us all a 'polio test' each day: Could we touch our toes and put our chins to our chest? Every stomach ache or stiffness caused a panic. Was it polio? **I remember the awful photos of children on crutches, in wheelchairs and iron lungs. And coming back to school in September to see the empty desks where the children hadn't returned.**
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=165874254&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTY1ODc0MjU0LCJpYXQiOjE3NTAyNTE0NzgsImV4cCI6MTc1Mjg0MzQ3OCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.kySNam_yGDMlPwS98hCbvx3p1HsyiPz4d2oqrkNch-A)
We do not need to live with this level of fear--the success of vaccines is that we _don 't_ have to live that way. But we do need to remind people that all of this is just around the corner.
More assertively sharing these photos and stories is one way to do that.
All of this is pretty heavy, so I'll close this section with Police Chief Wiggum's guidance to scientists:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/410556cb-aef7-4bba-a90b-676ae60c3cd5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### Winning influence through (the right levels of) fear
I am supportive of vaccine mandates, especially for preventable childhood diseases like measles, but that's not even what I'm talking about here, exactly. [Americans are aggressively individualistic](https://substack.com/redirect/7f3a31fb-7ff9-4b7d-89c0-d628c7dd635a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and it's probably true that telling people that they have to get vaccinated makes people less likely to want to get vaccinated.
What I'm really pushing for: **we have to change the narrative such that people** _**want**_**to get their children vaccinated**.
I am, in general, against the politics of fear. But this is something we need to be fearful of. Not every day, but just enough to remember that our fragile truce with disease is always perilously close to crumbling--especially with the anti-vaccination movement gaining steam.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTY1ODc0MjU0LCJzIjoyNDQwMzk4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzUwMjUxNDc4LCJleHAiOjE3NTI4NDM0NzgsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.KBXTBbZdVHoUrPS7KBgoGBWmohayo2NwQtj3pcz8PLw?)
_**Feel free to share this post with someone who will find this interesting.** If you're reading this email because someone sent it to you, [please consider subscribing](https://substack.com/redirect/03989c96-0ee4-474c-8fb3-18b2b8774212?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)._
_Note: A few people have told me that these emails are sometimes going into spam folders. If you a)**mark the email as "not spam"** and b) **add bensamuels@substack.com to your contacts** , that should address the issue._
1
Or maybe you already have!
2
Below is one localized example of that. Data isn't as readily available going back to the 19th century and earlier, but [for literally centuries in London](https://substack.com/redirect/58c65579-04ca-4589-a9a9-0fd26e4edf5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), smallpox was one of the leading causes of death:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/58c65579-04ca-4589-a9a9-0fd26e4edf5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [Our World in Data](https://substack.com/redirect/58c65579-04ca-4589-a9a9-0fd26e4edf5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
For context (added into the graph above): [COVID-19 was responsible for about 10.3% of all deaths in 2020](https://substack.com/redirect/bb19e4a7-0499-4c9e-b85d-672efe4db100?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), at the height of the pandemic.
Take a moment to reflect on that: for 50 years, people in London were dealing with COVID-level death rates from smallpox basically _every single year_. (What's lost on this chart: far more of the deaths were children and young adults than was the case with COVID, and there were lots of other diseases going around too.) With the miracle of vaccines, no one in the world has died of smallpox [in nearly 50 years](https://substack.com/redirect/a869d859-d55d-4a83-85d8-6940bf42fc45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
3
h/t to [Randall Munroe and ](https://substack.com/redirect/d1b60476-8456-450a-82f7-31f5c86e7137?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[xkcd](https://substack.com/redirect/d1b60476-8456-450a-82f7-31f5c86e7137?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ for that framing.
4
I try not to resort to ad hominem attacks. But a) as I said above, this is one of the issues about which I am most passionate and most upset, and b) Bobby Kennedy, Jr. is responsible for needless deaths and needless suffering. He grew up with every privilege and educational opportunity in the world and should know better.
Because of this, I have no problem saying that of the 340 million of us, he's one of the worst. I'm defining this in the utilitarian sense, where he's singularly responsible for more harm than almost anyone else. He might not be the most evil, though [he's clearly got some of that in him too](https://substack.com/redirect/481f52dd-f3ce-430c-bd36-991f1e659b3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
5
In fairness, this phenomenon isn't limited to the United States. Take Japan, where [vaccine hesitancy](https://substack.com/redirect/4ab0b2ce-b24f-4744-b7e4-a8d21c7fec50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is high, and which had some of the [lowest and slowest COVID-19 vaccination rates](https://substack.com/redirect/63a04392-8af6-497c-941f-a26f2f172300?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It isn't just in the U.S. where we're victims of our own successes.
6
Notably: this is not cleanly a left-right issue. People on both sides of the aisle are susceptible to misinformation.
7
Paul Alexander, a polio survivor who [lived in an iron lung for seven decades](https://substack.com/redirect/2443c94a-ceaa-4e68-9281-74f877e3347b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), died just last year. He was one of the very last people still using an iron lung.
8
Unsurprisingly, Gaines County also had one of the [lowest COVID-19 vaccination rates](https://substack.com/redirect/5e28bc81-15a6-417a-92b3-a328a8de6f4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the U.S.
Frighteningly, the [MMR vaccination rate in St. Louis is shockingly low](https://substack.com/redirect/7a053efa-0aac-438d-aec4-2923ebe508ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and something in our own backyard that we have to address.
9
I confirmed, by the way, that Bobby Kennedy, Jr. didn't screw around with this webpage. Looking at an old vintage of the website ([for measles](https://substack.com/redirect/e5a64701-54e5-4607-a88e-778f040e07db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [for polio](https://substack.com/redirect/ef976ca1-8e37-4b38-ba6a-6bddd348412c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)), as far as I can tell, he hasn't.
10
To be precise, that counts people who trust the CDC "a great deal" or "a fair amount." People who trust the CDC "not much" and "not at all" were excluded from my count.
Obviously, the CDC has an enormous role to play in conducting research, finding cures, and funding life-saving efforts. It also informs how doctors talk to their patients--and [82% of Americans say that they trust their doctors](https://substack.com/redirect/86bcb3e9-8845-494e-861d-56ac5e26d12e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Dear Peter,

On Saturday, June 14, an extremist shot and killed a Minnesota state legislator and wounded another, both staunch supporters of social justice and abortion rights. The attacker's hit list also included abortion providers and advocates.

Just last week, members of Congress continued their push to repeal the Freedom of Access to Clinic Entrances (FACE) Act—[**the only federal law that protects reproductive health clinics and places of worship from violence and harassment.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109795993/552276973/734415106?sourceid=1150761&utm_campaign=25emius-0604aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=faceact&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTBkNmZiNS00NDRjLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e6U2VZ6cMOLauswPe9jeeJ09XxuL7W_D6ed3sgYS5Qg=&emci=6a8f7f56-aa4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=ea0d6fb5-444c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=954237)

We grieve for all those impacted by this targeted violence, and we are thankful all our clients in the area are safe... [**but repealing the FACE Act now gives a green light to those that would do providers harm.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109795995/552276974/734415106?sourceid=1150761&utm_campaign=25emius-0604aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=faceact&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTBkNmZiNS00NDRjLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e6U2VZ6cMOLauswPe9jeeJ09XxuL7W_D6ed3sgYS5Qg=&emci=6a8f7f56-aa4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=ea0d6fb5-444c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=954237) | [**TELL CONGRESS: NO REPEAL**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109795996/552276975/734415106?sourceid=1150761&utm_campaign=25emius-0604aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=faceact&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTBkNmZiNS00NDRjLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e6U2VZ6cMOLauswPe9jeeJ09XxuL7W_D6ed3sgYS5Qg=&emci=6a8f7f56-aa4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=ea0d6fb5-444c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=954237 "TELL CONGRESS: NO REPEAL")
---
Congress passed the FACE Act with strong bi-partisan support to protect reproductive health care clinics, staff, and patients in the wake of violence and blockades used by anti-abortion extremists in the 1990s. As we face a new wave of threats, [**the FACE Act must be enforced and strengthened, NOT repealed.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109795997/552276976/734415106?sourceid=1150761&utm_campaign=25emius-0604aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=faceact&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTBkNmZiNS00NDRjLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e6U2VZ6cMOLauswPe9jeeJ09XxuL7W_D6ed3sgYS5Qg=&emci=6a8f7f56-aa4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=ea0d6fb5-444c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=954237)

[**Peter, your advocacy is urgently needed. Please, contact your representatives and demand they defend the FACE Act.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109795998/552276977/734415106?sourceid=1150761&utm_campaign=25emius-0604aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=faceact&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTBkNmZiNS00NDRjLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e6U2VZ6cMOLauswPe9jeeJ09XxuL7W_D6ed3sgYS5Qg=&emci=6a8f7f56-aa4b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=ea0d6fb5-444c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=954237)

Nancy Northup

subject: A story about perseverance

body:
We’ve come so far since I was a kid, but it wasn’t always easy.
#
Peter,
**I’m Chris Pappas, Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate in New Hampshire.** State Democrats Committee said I could reach out to you today with a special message about Pride.
Growing up in New Hampshire, I often wondered if there would be a place for me here — if I’d be able to live openly and authentically in the state I love. I certainly never imagined I could one day be elected to public office as my authentic self.
But after I finished college, I came home and ran for the state legislature because I wanted to give back to the community that had given me so much.
**And somewhat to my surprise, not only did my community accept me, they gave me their trust and sent me to Concord to serve them in the legislature.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89993?refcode=em20250618-9026&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9026%2E614464%2Epg1SDa) _Celebrating with supporters on Election Night 2018_
I’ll never forget the first speech I made from the State House floor. At the time marriage equality was far from the law of the land, and the legislature was debating a bill that would have prohibited New Hampshire from recognizing same-sex marriages performed in other states.
I urged my colleagues, Republicans and Democrats alike, to vote this bill down.
I told them that it ran counter to the “Live Free or Die” spirit we’re so proud of in New Hampshire. And that we shouldn’t be legislating based on fear or hate or trying to punish people for who they love.
Unfortunately the bill passed, and we lost that fight. **But we didn’t give up.**
We persevered, and not long after we passed a new bill recognizing civil unions between same-sex partners. And a few years after that, New Hampshire became the first state in the nation to legalize marriage equality through legislative action.
**Then in 2018 I was elected to Congress as New Hampshire’s first openly gay member** — part of a rainbow wave that ushered in the most pro-equality majority in congressional history.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89993?refcode=em20250618-9026&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9026%2E614464%2Epg1SDa) _Delivering my victory speech on Election Night 2018_
**That’s the spirit of Pride, Peter.** It’s not just about celebrating — it’s about persevering in the face of what can seem like overwhelming odds and refusing to give up, even after a devastating loss.
**And although we’ve come a long way since I was growing up, we have to keep persevering today.** Because right now anti-equality extremists are renewing their attacks on LGBTQ+ rights, targeting trans kids, banning books, and spreading fear to divide us.
That’s one of the reasons I’m running for U.S. Senate. New Hampshire needs a voice in Washington who will stand strong for equality, dignity, and freedom — a voice who will continue to uphold our state’s “Live Free or Die” motto.
**I’ll never forget the trust my community has placed in me over the years, and I’ll _always_ keep up the fight to make sure every single person in New Hampshire and our country has the freedom to live openly, authentically, and with pride.**
**[If you’re with me, I hope you’ll split a donation to support my campaign and State Democrats Committee today. New Hampshire is going to be one of the most closely-watched races in the country, and I’m counting on your help to win.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89993?refcode=em20250618-9026&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=9026%2E614464%2Epg1SDa)**

[Contribute $5](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89994?refcode=em20250618-9026&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=5&t=4&akid=9026%2E614464%2Epg1SDa) [Contribute $15](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89994?refcode=em20250618-9026&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=15&t=5&akid=9026%2E614464%2Epg1SDa) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89994?refcode=em20250618-9026&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=6&akid=9026%2E614464%2Epg1SDa) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89994?refcode=em20250618-9026&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=7&akid=9026%2E614464%2Epg1SDa) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89994?refcode=em20250618-9026&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=8&akid=9026%2E614464%2Epg1SDa) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89994?refcode=em20250618-9026&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=9&akid=9026%2E614464%2Epg1SDa) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/89993?refcode=em20250618-9026&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=9026%2E614464%2Epg1SDa)

Peter, we saw an interesting study, and we wanted to talk about it.

The Center for American Women and Politics (CAWP) released a recent study that analyzed campaign finance data for 2024 elections by candidate gender. Unsurprisingly, it found key differences in political fundraising between women and men candidates.
* Women running for the U.S. House received more of their funds from small contributions compared to men, who more often were able to self-finance their campaigns.
* The average donation to _**male**_ congressional candidates was HIGHER than the average donation to _**female**_ congressional candidates.
* Male donors vastly outspent female donors in the total amount contributed to congressional races. **Men contributed 63% of all money contributed, women contributed just 37%.**

_As we know, women donors are much more likely to support women candidates – which puts women candidates at a serious disadvantage when women are donating less frequently._

**At a time when our rights are in serious danger – and, in many cases, have already seen a backslide, we are in urgent need of _more women_ in the rooms where decisions about _our_ bodies are being made. That’s why we are working to ensure that pro-choice, pro-_women_ women candidates do not fall behind their male opponents in _fundraising_ * – but we need your help. **

[**Peter, let’s change these fundraising trends once and for all. clean_body: Findings from a recent study show an unsurprising difference in the...| | | | | = Peter, we saw an interesting study, and we wanted to talk about it. The Center for American Women and Politics (CAWP) released a recent study that analyzed campaign finance data for 2024 elections by candidate gender. Unsurprisingly, it found key differences in political fundraising between women and men candidates. Women running for the U.S. House received more of their funds from small contributions compared to men, who more often were able to self-finance their campaigns. The average donation to male congressional candidates was HIGHER than the average donation to female congressional candidates. Male donors vastly outspent female donors in the total amount contributed to congressional races. Men contributed 63% of all money contributed, women contributed just 37%. As we know, women donors are much more likely to support women candidates – which puts women candidates at a serious disadvantage when women are donating less frequently. At a time when our rights are in serious danger – and, in many cases, have already seen a backslide, we are in urgent need of more women in the rooms where decisions about our bodies are being made. That’s why we are working to ensure that pro-choice, pro-women women candidates do not fall behind their male opponents in fundraising – but we need your help. Last night we won our primary making me the Democratic Nominee for HD 49.

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/eed0f65edb99/weve-waited-25-years-for-this-moment-4768252?e=606d7e9aa2)

|

**Dear Friend,**

Last night, we did something incredible together, **we won the Democratic Primary for the 49th House of Delegates District**! Thanks to my opponent, Jasmine Libscomb, for running a strong and spirited race. I’m deeply grateful for every supporter, volunteer, and neighbor who made this victory possible. This win belongs to all of us.
[But I’m writing to you today because the fight is **far from over**. In fact, it’s just begun.](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=23804188eb&e=606d7e9aa2)
This seat has been out of reach for 25 years, but tonight, we’ve proven that when everyday people come together, we can defy the odds. Now, since **this is an open seat** we have a real chance to flip this district and make sure Southside Virginia has a leader who puts people over politics, every single time.
Let me be clear: **this race matters for everyone in Virginia** , no matter your zip code. When we win here, we get one seat closer to a House of Delegates that protects our public schools, defends access to affordable healthcare, invests in rural communities, and stands up to the reckless chaos coming out of Washington.
I’m ready to bring my **lifetime of service** , as a doctor, a small business owner, and a community leader, to Richmond to fight for what’s right. But I cannot do it alone.
We’re up against well-funded special interests who would love nothing more than to buy this seat back and silence the voice of everyday families. We need every corner of Virginia to stand up and say **not this time.**
[**Will you stand with us?
**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=46d0939743&e=606d7e9aa2)
Your continued support, your time, your energy, your contributions will help us take this fight to November and **win for Southside and for Virginia**.
Thank you for believing in this campaign and in the power of people coming together to do big things. Let’s keep the momentum going and **finish what we started.**
With deep gratitude and determination,
**Dr. Gary Miller**
Democratic Nominee for House of Delegates, District 49

name: Terry Tracy
subject: Two legal wins. One powerful message: we won’t back down.
body:
The Shapiro administration tried to bury the truth. We took them to court — and won. Help us keep fighting. | | | | [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0a54ae4bd7&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
| | | Dear Reader:
I want to share something that doesn’t happen every day in journalism — _Broad + Liberty_ just won [two major court decisions](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=84be0ab6c8&e=b7b3eddce2) in our battle to hold the Shapiro administration accountable.
Over the last year, we filed multiple Right-to-Know requests asking for documents related to a sexual harassment scandal that drove a top official from Governor Shapiro’s cabinet. The Governor’s Office claimed they had nothing to disclose — or worse, that what they did have was too privileged for the public to see.
We didn’t accept that. We took them to court.
And we won.
A Commonwealth Court judge recently ruled that the Shapiro administration improperly withheld key records, including emails sent by the very official at the center of the scandal. The court also agreed with us on a critical point: that high-ranking government officials cannot automatically shield their communications from public review just because of their title.
This was a victory not just for _Broad + Liberty_ , but for every Pennsylvanian who believes in honest, transparent government.
But these wins come at a cost. Filing lawsuits, challenging denials, and pursuing appeals takes real time and money. While some outlets chase clicks, we chase accountability — and the process isn’t cheap. If you believe this work matters — if you think the public deserves the truth even when it’s inconvenient for those in power — I’m asking you to support us with a contribution today.
This fight is far from over. But your donation keeps us in the fight.
**If you agree that the media must hold our state establishment to account, and support our fearless journalism, please make your best** **[tax-deductible donation](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9d7e78621c&e=b7b3eddce2)** **today.**
Thank you, and onwards!

The Editors at _Broad + Liberty_

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Texas students make gains in reading but struggle with math, STAAR scores show,** " Texas Tribune's**Sneha Dey** - "Texas' students saw some wins in reading but continued to struggle to bounce back from pandemic-related learning losses in math, state testing results released Tuesday showed.

Elementary students who took the State of Texas Assessments of Academic Readiness exam this year made the biggest gains in reading across grade levels. Third graders saw a three percentage point increase in reading, a milestone because early literacy is a strong indicator of future academic success. Progress among middle students in the subject, meanwhile, slowed.

"These results are encouraging and reflect the impact of the strategic supports we've implemented in recent years," said Texas Education Agency Commissioner **Mike Morath**. "We are seeing meaningful signs of academic recovery and progress."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/931a05dd-b538-4095-a945-1063caa46b30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This year's third grade test takers have benefited from state investments in early literacy in recent years. Teachers in their classrooms have completed state-led training in early literacy instruction, known as reading academies. The state also expanded pre-K access and enrollment in 2019.

Morath did acknowledge students needed more help to make similar gains in math. Five years after pandemic-related school closures, students are still struggling to catch up in that subject, the results showed. About 43% of students met grade-level standards for math, a 2 percentage point increase from the previous year, but still shy of the 50% reached in 2019.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/931a05dd-b538-4095-a945-1063caa46b30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Low performance in math can effectively shut students out of high-paying, in-demand STEM careers. Economic leaders have been sounding the alarm about the implications that weak math skills can have on the state's future workforce pipeline.

The STAAR exam tests all Texas public school students in third through eighth grade in math and reading. A science test is also administered for fifth and eighth graders, as well as a social studies test for eighth graders. Science performance improved among fifth and eighth grades by 3 and 4 percentage points respectively, but students in those grades are still below where they were before the pandemic.

Students in special education also made small gains. English learners, meanwhile, saw drops in all subjects but one -- a 4% decrease in reading, a 2% decrease in math, and a 2% decrease in social studies.

The test scores give families a snapshot of how Texas students are learning. School accountability ratings -- which the Texas Education Agency gives out to each district and campus on an A through F scale as a score for their performance -- are also largely based on how students do on the standardized tests.

The test often casts a shadow over classrooms at the end of the year, with teachers across the state saying they lose weeks of valuable instructional time preparing children to take the test. Some parents also [don't like the test](https://substack.com/redirect/d30cbbc9-0ea2-4855-a1bc-eaa5ce7c9728?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because of [its high-stakes nature](https://substack.com/redirect/bb41e9a9-2370-4658-8da9-cbebe66af8e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They have said their kids [don't want to go school](https://substack.com/redirect/2bec57d5-0a0d-4f00-98f9-6358ff25bbba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because of the enormous pressure the hours-long, end-of-year test puts on them.

A bill that would have scrapped the STAAR test died in the last days of the 2025 legislative session. Both Republican and Democratic legislators expressed a desire to overhaul STAAR, but in the end, the House and Senate could not align on what they wanted out of an alternative test.

Legislators this session did approve a sweeping school finance package that included academic intervention for students who are struggling before they first take their STAAR test in third grade. The package also requires teachers get training in math instruction, mirroring existing literacy training mandates.

Parents can look up their students' test results [here](https://substack.com/redirect/20183003-b2d4-4cb1-b7e2-d2f81df7d7ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." TOP NEWS "Texas students make gains in reading but struggle with math, STAAR scores show, " Texas Tribune'sSneha Dey - "Texas' students saw some wins in reading but continued to struggle to bounce back from pandemic-related learning losses in math, state testing results released Tuesday showed. Elementary students who took the State of Texas Assessments of Academic Readiness exam this year made the biggest gains in reading across grade levels. Third graders saw a three percentage point increase in reading, a milestone because early literacy is a strong indicator of future academic success. Progress among middle students in the subject, meanwhile, slowed. "These results are encouraging and reflect the impact of the strategic supports we've implemented in recent years," said Texas Education Agency Commissioner Mike Morath. "We are seeing meaningful signs of academic recovery and progress." This year's third grade test takers have benefited from state investments in early literacy in recent years. Teachers in their classrooms have completed state-led training in early literacy instruction, known as reading academies. The state also expanded pre-K access and enrollment in 2019. Morath did acknowledge students needed more help to make similar gains in math. Five years after pandemic-related school closures, students are still struggling to catch up in that subject, the results showed. About 43% of students met grade-level standards for math, a 2 percentage point increase from the previous year, but still shy of the 50% reached in 2019. Low performance in math can effectively shut students out of high-paying, in-demand STEM careers. Economic leaders have been sounding the alarm about the implications that weak math skills can have on the state's future workforce pipeline. The STAAR exam tests all Texas public school students in third through eighth grade in math and reading. A science test is also administered for fifth and eighth graders, as well as a social studies test for eighth graders. Science performance improved among fifth and eighth grades by 3 and 4 percentage points respectively, but students in those grades are still below where they were before the pandemic. Students in special education also made small gains. English learners, meanwhile, saw drops in all subjects but one -- a 4% decrease in reading, a 2% decrease in math, and a 2% decrease in social studies. The test scores give families a snapshot of how Texas students are learning. School accountability ratings -- which the Texas Education Agency gives out to each district and campus on an A through F scale as a score for their performance -- are also largely based on how students do on the standardized tests. The test often casts a shadow over classrooms at the end of the year, with teachers across the state saying they lose weeks of valuable instructional time preparing children to take the test. Some parents also because of . They have said their kids because of the enormous pressure the hours-long, end-of-year test puts on them. A bill that would have scrapped the STAAR test died in the last days of the 2025 legislative session. Both Republican and Democratic legislators expressed a desire to overhaul STAAR, but in the end, the House and Senate could not align on what they wanted out of an alternative test. Legislators this session did approve a sweeping school finance package that included academic intervention for students who are struggling before they first take their STAAR test in third grade. The package also requires teachers get training in math instruction, mirroring existing literacy training mandates. Parents can look up their students' test results ."
