* **TOP NEWS**

"**Texas students make gains in reading but struggle with math, STAAR scores show,** " Texas Tribune's**Sneha Dey** - "Texas' students saw some wins in reading but continued to struggle to bounce back from pandemic-related learning losses in math, state testing results released Tuesday showed.

Elementary students who took the State of Texas Assessments of Academic Readiness exam this year made the biggest gains in reading across grade levels. Third graders saw a three percentage point increase in reading, a milestone because early literacy is a strong indicator of future academic success. Progress among middle students in the subject, meanwhile, slowed.

"These results are encouraging and reflect the impact of the strategic supports we've implemented in recent years," said Texas Education Agency Commissioner **Mike Morath**. "We are seeing meaningful signs of academic recovery and progress."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/97bdf52f-03b9-49d6-9533-f1da3788a334?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This year's third grade test takers have benefited from state investments in early literacy in recent years. Teachers in their classrooms have completed state-led training in early literacy instruction, known as reading academies. The state also expanded pre-K access and enrollment in 2019.

Morath did acknowledge students needed more help to make similar gains in math. Five years after pandemic-related school closures, students are still struggling to catch up in that subject, the results showed. About 43% of students met grade-level standards for math, a 2 percentage point increase from the previous year, but still shy of the 50% reached in 2019.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/97bdf52f-03b9-49d6-9533-f1da3788a334?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Low performance in math can effectively shut students out of high-paying, in-demand STEM careers. Economic leaders have been sounding the alarm about the implications that weak math skills can have on the state's future workforce pipeline.

The STAAR exam tests all Texas public school students in third through eighth grade in math and reading. A science test is also administered for fifth and eighth graders, as well as a social studies test for eighth graders. Science performance improved among fifth and eighth grades by 3 and 4 percentage points respectively, but students in those grades are still below where they were before the pandemic.

Students in special education also made small gains. English learners, meanwhile, saw drops in all subjects but one -- a 4% decrease in reading, a 2% decrease in math, and a 2% decrease in social studies.

The test scores give families a snapshot of how Texas students are learning. School accountability ratings -- which the Texas Education Agency gives out to each district and campus on an A through F scale as a score for their performance -- are also largely based on how students do on the standardized tests.

The test often casts a shadow over classrooms at the end of the year, with teachers across the state saying they lose weeks of valuable instructional time preparing children to take the test. Some parents also [don't like the test](https://substack.com/redirect/6230f3cd-91a6-45e8-b426-8d39fc21df03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because of [its high-stakes nature](https://substack.com/redirect/827ba3ac-d02e-4a06-869e-60f59684d083?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They have said their kids [don't want to go school](https://substack.com/redirect/4075d471-5701-41e5-87d2-fc05005d98f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because of the enormous pressure the hours-long, end-of-year test puts on them.

A bill that would have scrapped the STAAR test died in the last days of the 2025 legislative session. Both Republican and Democratic legislators expressed a desire to overhaul STAAR, but in the end, the House and Senate could not align on what they wanted out of an alternative test.

Legislators this session did approve a sweeping school finance package that included academic intervention for students who are struggling before they first take their STAAR test in third grade. The package also requires teachers get training in math instruction, mirroring existing literacy training mandates.

TOP NEWS "Texas students make gains in reading but struggle with math, STAAR scores show, " Texas Tribune'sSneha Dey - "Texas' students saw some wins in reading but continued to struggle to bounce back from pandemic-related learning losses in math, state testing results released Tuesday showed. Elementary students who took the State of Texas Assessments of Academic Readiness exam this year made the biggest gains in reading across grade levels. Third graders saw a three percentage point increase in reading, a milestone because early literacy is a strong indicator of future academic success. Progress among middle students in the subject, meanwhile, slowed. "These results are encouraging and reflect the impact of the strategic supports we've implemented in recent years," said Texas Education Agency Commissioner Mike Morath. "We are seeing meaningful signs of academic recovery and progress." This year's third grade test takers have benefited from state investments in early literacy in recent years. Teachers in their classrooms have completed state-led training in early literacy instruction, known as reading academies. The state also expanded pre-K access and enrollment in 2019. Morath did acknowledge students needed more help to make similar gains in math. Five years after pandemic-related school closures, students are still struggling to catch up in that subject, the results showed. About 43% of students met grade-level standards for math, a 2 percentage point increase from the previous year, but still shy of the 50% reached in 2019. Low performance in math can effectively shut students out of high-paying, in-demand STEM careers. Economic leaders have been sounding the alarm about the implications that weak math skills can have on the state's future workforce pipeline. The STAAR exam tests all Texas public school students in third through eighth grade in math and reading. A science test is also administered for fifth and eighth graders, as well as a social studies test for eighth graders. Science performance improved among fifth and eighth grades by 3 and 4 percentage points respectively, but students in those grades are still below where they were before the pandemic. Students in special education also made small gains. English learners, meanwhile, saw drops in all subjects but one -- a 4% decrease in reading, a 2% decrease in math, and a 2% decrease in social studies. The test scores give families a snapshot of how Texas students are learning. School accountability ratings -- which the Texas Education Agency gives out to each district and campus on an A through F scale as a score for their performance -- are also largely based on how students do on the standardized tests. The test often casts a shadow over classrooms at the end of the year, with teachers across the state saying they lose weeks of valuable instructional time preparing children to take the test. Some parents also because of . They have said their kids because of the enormous pressure the hours-long, end-of-year test puts on them. A bill that would have scrapped the STAAR test died in the last days of the 2025 legislative session. Both Republican and Democratic legislators expressed a desire to overhaul STAAR, but in the end, the House and Senate could not align on what they wanted out of an alternative test. Legislators this session did approve a sweeping school finance package that included academic intervention for students who are struggling before they first take their STAAR test in third grade. The package also requires teachers get training in math instruction, mirroring existing literacy training mandates. Parents can look up their students' test results ." “**Texas students make gains in reading but struggle with math, STAAR scores show,** ” Texas Tribune's**Sneha Dey** – “Texas’ students saw some wins in reading but continued to struggle to bounce back from pandemic-related learning losses in math, state testing results released Tuesday showed.

Elementary students who took the State of Texas Assessments of Academic Readiness exam this year made the biggest gains in reading across grade levels. Third graders saw a three percentage point increase in reading, a milestone because early literacy is a strong indicator of future academic success. Progress among middle students in the subject, meanwhile, slowed.

“These results are encouraging and reflect the impact of the strategic supports we’ve implemented in recent years,” said Texas Education Agency Commissioner **Mike Morath**. “We are seeing meaningful signs of academic recovery and progress.”

Low performance in math can effectively shut students out of high-paying, in-demand STEM careers. Economic leaders have been sounding the alarm about the implications that weak math skills can have on the state’s future workforce pipeline.

The STAAR exam tests all Texas public school students in third through eighth grade in math and reading. A science test is also administered for fifth and eighth graders, as well as a social studies test for eighth graders. Science performance improved among fifth and eighth grades by 3 and 4 percentage points respectively, but students in those grades are still below where they were before the pandemic.

Students in special education also made small gains. English learners, meanwhile, saw drops in all subjects but one — a 4% decrease in reading, a 2% decrease in math, and a 2% decrease in social studies.

The test scores give families a snapshot of how Texas students are learning. School accountability ratings — which the Texas Education Agency gives out to each district and campus on an A through F scale as a score for their performance — are also largely based on how students do on the standardized tests.

The test often casts a shadow over classrooms at the end of the year, with teachers across the state saying they lose weeks of valuable instructional time preparing children to take the test. Elementary students who took the State of Texas Assessments of Academic Readiness exam this year made the biggest gains in reading across grade levels. Third graders saw a three percentage point increase in reading, a milestone because early literacy is a strong indicator of future academic success. Progress among middle students in the subject, meanwhile, slowed. “These results are encouraging and reflect the impact of the strategic supports we’ve implemented in recent years,” said Texas Education Agency Commissioner Mike Morath. “We are seeing meaningful signs of academic recovery and progress.” » This year’s third grade test takers have benefited from state investments in early literacy in recent years. Teachers in their classrooms have completed state-led training in early literacy instruction, known as reading academies. The state also expanded pre-K access and enrollment in 2019. Morath did acknowledge students needed more help to make similar gains in math. Five years after pandemic-related school closures, students are still struggling to catch up in that subject, the results showed. About 43% of students met grade-level standards for math, a 2 percentage point increase from the previous year, but still shy of the 50% reached in 2019. » Low performance in math can effectively shut students out of high-paying, in-demand STEM careers. Economic leaders have been sounding the alarm about the implications that weak math skills can have on the state’s future workforce pipeline. The STAAR exam tests all Texas public school students in third through eighth grade in math and reading. A science test is also administered for fifth and eighth graders, as well as a social studies test for eighth graders. Science performance improved among fifth and eighth grades by 3 and 4 percentage points respectively, but students in those grades are still below where they were before the pandemic. Students in special education also made small gains. English learners, meanwhile, saw drops in all subjects but one — a 4% decrease in reading, a 2% decrease in math, and a 2% decrease in social studies. The test scores give families a snapshot of how Texas students are learning. School accountability ratings — which the Texas Education Agency gives out to each district and campus on an A through F scale as a score for their performance — are also largely based on how students do on the standardized tests. The test often casts a shadow over classrooms at the end of the year, with teachers across the state saying they lose weeks of valuable instructional time preparing children to take the test. Some parents also because of . They have said their kids because of the enormous pressure the hours-long, end-of-year test puts on them. A bill that would have scrapped the STAAR test died in the last days of the 2025 legislative session. Both Republican and Democratic legislators expressed a desire to overhaul STAAR, but in the end, the House and Senate could not align on what they wanted out of an alternative test. Legislators this session did approve a sweeping school finance package that included academic intervention for students who are struggling before they first take their STAAR test in third grade. The package also requires teachers get training in math instruction, mirroring existing literacy training mandates. name: Americans for Responsible Innovation
subject: ARI Launches New AI Law Ban Website
body:
As spring turns into summer, D.C. lawmakers are in a last sprint to move AI policy before the August recess.

| | | | | |
---
|
---
[|
---](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=115142fbe0&e=a07d75591f)
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Team,As spring turns into summer, D.C. lawmakers are in a last sprint to move AI policy before the August recess. From the proposed AI regulatory moratorium to new legislation that would create an “AI Security Playbook,” the capital is a hive of activity when it comes to tech. Check out today’s newsletter to keep up with the latest ⬇️
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
|
### **Who’s Speaking Out Against the AI Law Moratorium?**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | First, it was [Sen. Josh Hawley.](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=f69262f8fb&e=a07d75591f) Then, [state lawmakers.](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=4b1c3d88b8&e=a07d75591f) Now, [MTG](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=537f6076ea&e=a07d75591f), [Rep. Massie](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=63f757f59e&e=a07d75591f), and [Sen. Murphy](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=c70f96ac59&e=a07d75591f) have joined the fray in speaking out against the proposed 10-year moratorium on state AI legislation.
Having trouble staying up-to-date with all the lawmakers who’ve said NO to the moratorium? You’re not alone. That’s why we created [**NoAILawBan.org**](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=f2ec240f00&e=a07d75591f) \- a website tracking the lawmakers, thought leaders and coalitions speaking out against the moratorium effort. Think of it as a one-stop shop for seeing who is saying what.
---
| [NoAILawBan.Org](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=6b92f5e1fb&e=a07d75591f)
---
| Know a lawmaker who should be on the list but isn’t there yet - email us at [media@ari.us](mailto:media@ari.us).
If you’re just tuning in to the fight over a proposed 10-year ban on state laws covering AI technologies, we have some more resources for you as well. [Read up on the state lawmakers](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=d574a7c123&e=a07d75591f) who’ve urged Congress to reject the moratorium, or [check out our report ](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=26c1132146&e=a07d75591f)on which state laws would be impacted by the proposed AI regulatory ban.
---
|
---
|
### **Securing Frontier AI Labs**
---
| Frontier AI labs are developing some of the most powerful technologies in the world, yet many lack the security protocols to protect against theft and sabotage. As geopolitical tensions rise and adversarial actors seek to acquire advanced AI capabilities, ARI is advocating for public policy that strengthens security at our nation’s leading AI labs.ARI President Brad Carson recently spoke with Bloomberg TV about the need for hardening lab security in the face of foreign competition and espionage, making it clear that security is essential for U.S. leadership on AI.
---
[|
---](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=461237b9bd&e=a07d75591f)
| Now, a group of bipartisan lawmakers have introduced legislation that would do precisely that. The Advanced AI Security Readiness Act tasks the NSA with developing an “AI Security Playbook” that identifies vulnerabilities in America’s AI infrastructure and works towards preparing AI labs to defend against attacks.
---
| [Our Statement on the Advanced AI Security Readiness Act](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=ffb888f64c&e=a07d75591f)
---
|
---
|
### **Promoting Transparency in the AI Industry**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | AI innovation is advancing at a breathtaking speed, and it’s vital that policymakers avoid repeating the mistakes of the social media era, where Big Tech companies operated with little to no transparency until it was too late.ARI has joined with over 20 tech advocacy groups in urging Congress to pass the AI Whistleblowers Protection Act. Protecting employees of the AI industry who come forward not only strengthens public trust and technological integrity but is also a national security imperative.
---
| [The Letter in Bloomberg Government](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=1ed38d536e&e=a07d75591f)
---
| The coalition letter was signed by ARI, Demand Progress, the National Consumers League, the Young People’s Alliance, Public Knowledge, and other organizations.
---
[|
---](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=9865e38f08&e=a07d75591f)
|
---
|
### **Forbes Op-Ed**
---
| ARI Executive Director and Co-Founder Eric Gastfriend authored an opinion piece in Forbes that explores the disconnect between economists and technologists regarding AI’s impact on the workforce and potential job losses.
---
[|
---](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=98d9d031fd&e=a07d75591f)
| Firms like McKinsey have estimated that there will be a net gain in overall available jobs, as jobs where AI replaces human workers will, in turn, create even more human jobs. However, this assessment overlooks the unprecedented flexibility that AI systems have demonstrated they’re capable of and the potential they have for absorbing new work.
---
| [Eric’s Forbes Op-Ed](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=5eeabf985f&e=a07d75591f)
---
| Using our new Dynamic General Purpose Technology framework, [ARI’s latest research assesses AI’s future impact on the workforce](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=f913337dec&e=a07d75591f) more accurately, and we’re already starting to see those changes emerge.
---
|
---

Arnold Schwarzenegger **[told Joy Behar an uncomfortable truth](https://substack.com/redirect/5a04ea40-98a7-4a6b-86ba-7584a54eb627?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** live on "The View" after she asked if he was upset, as an immigrant himself, at I.C.E for deporting illegal migrants.
This backfired on her immediately...
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/5a04ea40-98a7-4a6b-86ba-7584a54eb627?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

"You're an immigrant in this country, did you have a viseral reaction when you see what I.C.E is doing when you see the videos of it?" Behar asked Schwarzenegger.
The notorious bodybuilder and former California Governor did not give the answer she expected.
"I am so proud and happy that I was embraced by the American people," he explained, citing his extensive and impressive career in many areas from acting, to bodybuilding, to politics. "In no other country in the world could you do that,... all of this is because of America!"
**["The key thing is that we got to do things legal,"](https://substack.com/redirect/5a04ea40-98a7-4a6b-86ba-7584a54eb627?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** he continued. "Those people that are doing illegal things in America,... they are not smart because when you come to America, you're a guest, and you have to behave like a guest!"
"I think the important thing is, when you become an immigrant, think 'okay I want to use America for the great opportunities that America has'... okay, **[if I get all of those things from America then I have to give something back!"](https://substack.com/redirect/5a04ea40-98a7-4a6b-86ba-7584a54eb627?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Schwarzenegger said, not letting the hosts interject to derail his statement.

# Iran rejects Trump's demand for surrender, warns U.S. - Don't get involved
Iran **[warned it will respond firmly](https://substack.com/redirect/437808f9-b516-4a7b-9ee9-024ea8bb1eae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** if the U.S. becomes directly involved in Israel's military campaign.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e814d6f4-c334-433b-8fe4-85e315d75916?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Iranian UN Ambassador Ali Bahreini** told reporters that Iran considers the U.S. "complicit in what Israel is doing" and will set a red line, promising to respond if America crosses it, though he didn't specify what actions would trigger retaliation.
* **Iran called Trump's demand for "unconditional surrender" hostile and unwarranted** \- Bahreini described Trump's Tuesday remarks as "completely unwarranted and very hostile," saying Iran "cannot ignore them" and will include the president's statements in their "calculations and assessments" going forward.
* **The U.S. is increasing military presence while thousands flee Iranian cities** \- America has deployed more fighter aircraft to the Middle East and helped shoot down missiles fired at Israel, while Iranian media reported thousands of people fleeing Tehran and other major cities as Iran and Israel continue exchanging missile strikes.

* * *
# Trump says he knows exactly where Iran's "Supreme Leader" is hiding, "He is an easy target"
President Donald Trump **[posted on Truth Social](https://substack.com/redirect/8eb198a3-1a53-4bc7-ae1a-1b3541fba372?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that Iranian "Supreme Leader" Ali Khamenei is "an easy target," warning that continued Iranian missile attacks on civilians or American soldiers could push him over the edge.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8eb198a3-1a53-4bc7-ae1a-1b3541fba372?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump asserted the U.S. has "complete and total control of the skies over Iran"** \- Trump said that American-made defense technology is superior to Iran's "sky trackers and other defensive equipment," saying "nobody does it better than the good ol' USA" while demanding Iran's "unconditional surrender."
* **The threats come as Israel continues strikes on Iranian nuclear sites and military targets** \- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu has explained that Iran's refusal to halt nuclear weapons development left him "no choice but to stop them by force," with ongoing attacks targeting both Iran's nuclear program and military commanders.

* * *
# Zero illegal immigrants released into the U.S. last month by CBP
Customs and Border Protection **[released zero illegal immigrants into the United States during May,](https://substack.com/redirect/007a574a-1793-423e-8ad7-6f54f4b3d0e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** marking a dramatic shift from the same month last year when approximately 62,000 were released under the Biden administration, according to new federal data showing a 93% decline in border encounters.
* **Border encounters dropped 93% from last year, with only 8,725 illegal aliens encountered** \- CBP agents encountered just 8,725 people attempting to cross illegally between ports of entry in May, a massive decline from the more than 117,000 encounters recorded in May 2024 under the previous administration.
* **Acting CBP Commissioner praised Trump's "historic support" for border security efforts** \- Pete Flores credited the administration's leadership for achieving what he called "historic lows" in border crossings and "the fastest improvement in American border security of all time," with numbers not seen since the 1960s according to immigration experts.
* **Drug seizures increased significantly even as border crossings plummeted** \- Despite fewer border encounters, CBP seized 718 pounds of fentanyl and saw cocaine seizures jump 19% from April to May, while heroin seizures surged 191%, suggesting enhanced enforcement capabilities under the new administration's policies.

[] [] [] June 17, 2025 • Newsletter Tim Ballard - The Threat of Open Borders Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] [] Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] Moms for America sat down with Tim Ballard, the former Homeland Security agent who inspired the hit movie "Sound of Freedom." After 10 years working undercover to fight human trafficking, Tim founded Operation Underground Railroad, a non-profit that rescues children from sex trafficking. What he has to say about Biden's open border policy will shock you! Plus, we spoke with John Ferguson about his viral videos regarding the giant drones on the coast of New Jersey. Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. clean_body: Undermine the rule of law. Demonize law enforcement. Accuse ordinary Americans of extremism for wanting basic security. | Fellow Conservative, You don’t call law enforcement Nazis unless you’ve decided you don’t believe in laws. That’s what Tim Walz did. He compared ICE agents—Americans who risk their lives enforcing the law—to the Gestapo. Let that sink in. These aren’t slip-ups. This is the modern Left’s playbook: Undermine the rule of law. Demonize law enforcement. Accuse ordinary Americans of extremism for wanting basic security. And then they call you a radical. I’m Adam Schwarze. I’m a former Navy SEAL and Marine who deployed nine times, including in Iraq and Africa, and I’m running for U.S. Senate to stop this madness. I didn’t spend 21 years defending this country just to come home and be called a Nazi by politicians who couldn’t even defend their own cities. While Minneapolis was burning in the summer of 2020,Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, my opponent in the Minnesota Senate race , was working on a lawsuit against the police. That tells you everything you need to know. Democrats hide behind lawsuits and frivolous social media posts; Republicans rally behind the American flag and the men and women serving our communities in uniform. What they did to our cities was shameful. What they’re doing to our border is dangerous. And what they’re saying about veterans, police officers, and law-abiding citizens is disgusting. So here’s the truth: Enforcing immigration law is not fascism. It’s federal law. Wanting to deport criminals who prey on Americans is not bigotry. It’s basic decency. Demanding accountability from a government that lets cities burn is not extreme. It’s patriotism. If you're as outraged as I am, I need your help now. I'm starting out this race with no money and little name recognition - what I do have is a deep love of this country, and an exemplarily military record. I would be humbled if you could spare a few dollars today to ensure my campaign for the U.S. Senate gets off the ground. This is the battle. Right here. Right now. Tim Walz and his radical, militant left-wing lieutenant governor think they can shame us into silence. They think they can call us names until we stop pushing back. They are wrong. I didn’t come from wealth. I wasn’t groomed for politics. I earned everything —from my SEAL trident to my Harvard and Johns Hopkins degrees—through service and sacrifice. And I’m bringing that same grit to this pivotal U.S. Senate race. But I need reinforcements. And that starts with you, Fellow Conservative. If you’re tired of watching cities fall apart, borders erased, and law enforcement demonized. And if you’re tired of being told that loving your country makes you a villain, Because we’re not the extremists. We’re the ones standing between America and collapse. With resolve, Adam Schwarze Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate - Minnesota FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate Adam Schwarze is a former Navy SEAL and Marine. I'm a human rights lawyer. I have represented immigrants and asylum seekers my entire career. Earlier this week [I wrote a thorough article on how ordinary US citizens like you and me can be an ally to protect immigrants from ICE and CBP abuse](https://substack.com/redirect/0fb62125-f505-4f05-870e-919c5bd3d12d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In response, I received a number of questions from readers asking me to debunk anti-immigrant propaganda. It is critical we recognize the disinformation and misinformation spewing out of the White House for what it is, as only then can we properly change the narrative to one of true justice and human rights. So let's dive in to debunk seven of the most common anti-immigrant myths. **Let 's Address This.**
**Let's Address This is made possible by you, the thoughtful person reading this. Join us and become a free or paid subscriber.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WG8DWwPQKSl1JgOjJhjKEoUe4f4ewCrtZMBB_z_5tMY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=165792442)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4d23b347-9b32-4db9-b5f0-5e696a224039?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A woman holds a sign that declares "immigrants make America great." Credit: The Globe Post
### Claim 1: Immigrants increase crime
**Fact:** False. Immigrants, including undocumented immigrants, have lower crime rates than native-born U.S. citizens. This has been consistently documented over not just decades, but over centuries. A Northwestern University study looked at [data going back to 1870 and found](https://substack.com/redirect/22cbcabc-2060-4fc8-87f1-f66fde4a46d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Using incarceration rates as a proxy for crime, a team of economists analyzed 150 years of U.S. Census data and found immigrants were consistently less likely to be incarcerated than people born in the U.S. They also found beginning in 1960, the incarceration gap widened such that immigrants today are 60% less likely to be incarcerated than the U.S.-born. "Our study shows that since 1870, it has never been the case that immigrants as a group have been more incarcerated than the U.S.-born," Jacome said.
In other words, the more immigrants you have in your neighborhood, the statistically safer is your neighborhood.
### Claim 2: Undocumented immigrants are, by definition, criminals
**Fact:** False. The rhetoric that undocumented immigrants are "criminals" simply by virtue of being undocumented is misleading and disingenuous. Crossing the border without proper documentation is a civil violation, not a criminal one. It's comparable to receiving a parking ticket or speeding ticket--a misdemeanor, not a felony. Moreover, the process to apply for asylum--which is a legal act protected by U.S. and international law--necessarily requires crossing the border without documentation and then applying. Asylum is legal immigration, and undocumented immigration is not a criminal act.
And given that every MAGA accusation seems to be a confession, remember that [Elon Musk was an undocumented immigrant](https://substack.com/redirect/d5534b98-6aa1-46e2-ae5d-c8acd70c8a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) himself. You can watch the short clip linked below from 2013, [where Musk's brother admits they were both "illegal immigrants.](https://substack.com/redirect/c21c147f-c884-4e87-8163-10d758fb4685?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"
[](https://substack.com/redirect/e164be4f-a862-420e-a333-93d88756f608?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
These "illegal immigrants" illegally slept at their office (i.e. were homeless) and didn't even have a car (i.e. low income). Yet now Musk seems to have a short term memory as he demonizes immigrants, particularly undocumented immigrants.
**If you 're finding value in this research, support our advocacy as a free or paid subscriber.**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WG8DWwPQKSl1JgOjJhjKEoUe4f4ewCrtZMBB_z_5tMY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=165792442)
### Claim 3: Undocumented immigrants bring drugs
**Fact:** False. The data is truly staggering at how much drugs are a U.S. citizen problem for which immigrants are being unfairly maligned, and how U.S. policies to restrict documented immigration has exacerbated the drug crisis. Brookings [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/41986d14-a828-4cd1-ae42-0997786e30e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
* Annually 88% of drug trafficking is conducted by U.S. citizens, not by immigrants.
* Out of those arrested by Border Patrol for illegal crossings, only 0.02% were found with any fentanyl.
* Annual deaths from fentanyl doubled between 2019 and 2021--after the U.S. government banned asylum, a policy that did nothing to curb the problem.

The Brookings report went on to find:
> Traffickers also extensively hide fentanyl and other drugs within legal cargo entering the United States through legal ports of entry.
In other words, building a vanity wall would do nothing to actually stop the flow of narcotics. The real solution to America's drug crisis requires comprehensive drug policy reform, smarter border management to target actual traffickers, and a humane immigration system built on justice. Demonizing immigrants achieves none of this.
### Claim 4: Immigrants drain the economy
**Fact:** False. Countless studies quantify the immense economic benefit immigrants, and undocumented immigrants, contribute to the U.S. economy. Far from "taking Black jobs," [as Trump claims](https://substack.com/redirect/06135bf9-2ea0-4333-a8c5-db846ced5417?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), immigrants ignite the economy and decrease overall unemployment. And while I can cite numerous studies, I'll opt to cite one by the George W. Bush Institute, lest someone accuse me of cherry picking a left leaning organization. The [Bush study concludes](https://substack.com/redirect/e939ec8d-7ac4-4ec4-815a-201fa1079cda?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Immigration fuels the economy. When immigrants enter the labor force, they increase the productive capacity of the economy and raise GDP. Their incomes rise, but so do those of natives. It's a phenomenon dubbed the "immigration surplus," and it amounts to $36 to $72 billion per year.
But what about undocumented immigrants? The Institute of Taxation and Economic Policy ("ITEP") reports a shocking fact that no fair minded person could argue is bad for the economy. [ITEP concludes](https://substack.com/redirect/38985ff6-00ba-463b-b68b-c1c762bbc7e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Undocumented immigrants paid $96.7 billion in federal, state, and local taxes in 2022. Most of that amount, $59.4 billion, was paid to the federal government while the remaining $37.3 billion was paid to state and local governments.
For perspective, undocumented immigrants pay more in taxes than the entire GDP of at least 10 U.S. states. These are taxes they pay towards our Medicare, Medicaid, and social service programs, for which they receive no benefit whatsoever. That's also more in taxes annually than Musk or Trump will ever pay in a lifetime.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WG8DWwPQKSl1JgOjJhjKEoUe4f4ewCrtZMBB_z_5tMY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=165792442)
### Claim 5: Immigrants are lazy & collect welfare.
**Fact:** False. Most immigrants, [including undocumented immigrants, are ineligible for federal public benefits](https://substack.com/redirect/a8eb7ed3-be4c-46bf-9cc2-ae14981b5132?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) such as welfare, food stamps (SNAP), Medicaid, and Supplemental Security Income (SSI). According to U.S. law, lawful permanent residents (green card holders) must wait at least five years before they can access these benefits. Undocumented immigrants and certain temporary visa holders are entirely ineligible for most federal welfare programs.
It's fascinating how immigrants are somehow both lazy and collect welfare, and also stealing our jobs. Behold, _Schr odinger's immigrant_!
### Claim 6: Immigrants bring diseases into the U.S.
**Fact:** False. [Immigrants have higher vaccination rates than U.S. citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/388ec221-241e-484d-8c32-0ccf92d160b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). So not only are they less likely to carry diseases, they are also more likely to help prevent the spread of illnesses. This myth is particularly dangerous because the Trump administration is using it to literally "find a disease" they can use as an excuse to invoke Title 42 and close the border to all new immigration.
### Claim 7: Immigrants hurt American innovation.
**Fact:** False. Immigrants have long been drivers of American entrepreneurship and innovation. Did you know that [44% of Fortune 500 companies were founded by immigrants or their children](https://substack.com/redirect/dfcd9263-30f9-443a-aab9-83e7b510721f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)? That's 224 of the most successful companies in America today. These companies create jobs, stimulate growth, and solidify the U.S. as a leader in the global economy. Millions of Americans are employed today, most of whom are U.S. citizens, due to immigrant ingenuity. Instead of stifling economic progress, immigrants are at the forefront of ensuring our economic success.
## **Bonus: Immigrants don 't qualify for due process of law.**
**Fact:** False. The United States Constitution is explicitly clear that every person in the United States, regardless of citizenship, immigration, or documentation status, is guaranteed full constitutional rights and protections. For example, the Fifth Amendment declares "_No person shall be held to answer for a capital, or otherwise infamous crime, unless on a presentment or indictment of a Grand Jury_." The Constitution uses the word "person," not citizen, in defining who gets rights. The Supreme Court has additionally and repeatedly ruled that all people in this country qualify for due process. Any and all claims by the Trump regime that immigrants can be denied full constitutional protections is a dangerous fabrication that has no legal standing.
## Conclusion
The truth is clear: immigrants do not threaten the American dream--they are essential to it. And yet, with every election cycle and every cynical press release from the Trump regime, these same tired lies are repackaged and recycled to justify cruelty. Lies used to justify detaining children, splitting up families, and violently raiding communities under the pretense of "law and order." But there is no justice in scapegoating the most vulnerable. There is no honor in punishing people for seeking a better life.
I became a human rights lawyer to fight precisely this kind of injustice--rooted in fear, disinformation, and bigotry. And I cannot do it alone. If you found value in this article, I ask you to join me in this work. Share these truths. Challenge these myths. And if you're able, support this platform as a free or paid subscriber so I can keep publishing facts and defending those whose voices are so often silenced.
Because the facts are on our side. The law is on our side. Now we need to ensure the people are, too.

According to U.S. law, lawful permanent residents (green card holders) must wait at least five years before they can access these benefits. Undocumented immigrants and certain temporary visa holders are entirely ineligible for most federal welfare programs. It's fascinating how immigrants are somehow both lazy and collect welfare, and also stealing our jobs. Behold, Schr odinger's immigrant! Claim 6: Immigrants bring diseases into the U.S. Fact: False. . So not only are they less likely to carry diseases, they are also more likely to help prevent the spread of illnesses. This myth is particularly dangerous because the Trump administration is using it to literally "find a disease" they can use as an excuse to invoke Title 42 and close the border to all new immigration. Claim 7: Immigrants hurt American innovation. Fact: False. Immigrants have long been drivers of American entrepreneurship and innovation. Did you know that ? That's 224 of the most successful companies in America today. These companies create jobs, stimulate growth, and solidify the U.S. as a leader in the global economy. Millions of Americans are employed today, most of whom are U.S. citizens, due to immigrant ingenuity. Instead of stifling economic progress, immigrants are at the forefront of ensuring our economic success. Bonus: Immigrants don 't qualify for due process of law. Fact: False. The United States Constitution is explicitly clear that every person in the United States, regardless of citizenship, immigration, or documentation status, is guaranteed full constitutional rights and protections. For example, the Fifth Amendment declares "No person shall be held to answer for a capital, or otherwise infamous crime, unless on a presentment or indictment of a Grand Jury." The Constitution uses the word "person," not citizen, in defining who gets rights. The Supreme Court has additionally and repeatedly ruled that all people in this country qualify for due process. Any and all claims by the Trump regime that immigrants can be denied full constitutional protections is a dangerous fabrication that has no legal standing. Conclusion The truth is clear: immigrants do not threaten the American dream--they are essential to it. And yet, with every election cycle and every cynical press release from the Trump regime, these same tired lies are repackaged and recycled to justify cruelty. Lies used to justify detaining children, splitting up families, and violently raiding communities under the pretense of "law and order." But there is no justice in scapegoating the most vulnerable. There is no honor in punishing people for seeking a better life. I became a human rights lawyer to fight precisely this kind of injustice--rooted in fear, disinformation, and bigotry. And I cannot do it alone. If you found value in this article, I ask you to join me in this work. Share these truths. Challenge these myths. And if you're able, support this platform as a free or paid subscriber so I can keep publishing facts and defending those whose voices are so often silenced. Because the facts are on our side. The law is on our side. Now we need to ensure the people are, too. Quick Ask! I am doing everything in my power to stave off fascism in the United States, and I need your support. Immigration policy should serve America, not exploit it
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
🎉 **Our Mountain Majesty Gala is officially SOLD OUT** —thank you to everyone who’s joining us this Saturday to celebrate Colorado patriots and freedom fighters!
Are you a grassroots leader in Colorado? This Sunday in Golden, our friends at the Road to Red Initiative are hosting an incredible day of workshops from 8-2 on how to lead a grassroots movement/group of your own and how to be an effective change maker in your community. It’s $49 which covers lunch, join us! A few tickets are still available 👉 **[RSVP here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
Now let's get into the news. Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A Grand Junction family business says it was blindsided by a [city-led eminent domain deal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with their property used in a federal grant app without notice. In Denver, MyPillow CEO Mike Lindell was hit with [a $2.3 million defamation ruling](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) over 2020 election claims—raising free speech concerns. Meanwhile, housing costs continue to [push out seniors](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [TRACER has been paused](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after a Minnesota political assassination, and [violent protesters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) once again clashed with Denver police.
🇺🇸 **On the National Stage...** Declassified FBI docs allege the CCP plotted to mass-produce fake U.S. IDs and [cast fraudulent mail-in ballots](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for Biden in 2020—claims now under Senate review. Meanwhile, media spin on an [ICE raid in Nebraska](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is unraveling after Americans lined up to take the jobs illegal workers left behind.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** Barstnar and Milo warn that energy mandates are [driving up housing costs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Garbo calls for [immigration policy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) that protects Americans. Hardin highlights the [NRA-ILA’s fight for gun rights.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) And Knutzen spotlights Colorado’s youth excelling in [shooting sports](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) rooted in safety and tradition.
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, June 18, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Garbo: Immigration policy should serve America, not exploit it](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY C. J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Let’s set the record straight. Immigration is not a right. Not under the U.S. Constitution. Not under international law. Not by any moral, legal, or civil standard._
_It is a privilege, and one granted by a sovereign nation to those who respect its laws, value its principles, and are willing to contribute to its future._
_That privilege, once respected and coveted as one of the greatest honors in the world, is now under relentless attack – distorted by entitlement, corrupted by politics, and weaponized by those who seek to benefit without belonging._
_To understand this clearly, let’s use a comparison everyone can relate to: driving a car._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Hardin: Why the NRA-ILA legislative roundups matter more than ever](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Two NRA-ILA roundups in Colorado—one in Lakewood and another in Fort Morgan—mobilized gun owners against sweeping new gun laws, including SB25-003, which requires permits and training to buy many semi-automatic firearms.
* Lawmakers and law enforcement joined the events, emphasizing that freedom is won at the ballot box—and warning that silence only helps the opposition.
* The events mark the beginning of a larger grassroots push to organize, educate, and reclaim Colorado’s Second Amendment rights before the new laws take effect in 2026.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

|

**[Property Rights Violated? GJ Business Says City Crossed the Line](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE BUSINESS TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Mike and Amber Martinez say they were blindsided when CDOT and the City of Grand Junction planned a transit hub on their auto dealership property—using their address in a federal grant without notice.
* The couple only learned about the project after seeing their business labeled on a public map and say they had already invested in renovations, unaware of the city’s intentions.
* Despite emotional appeals and years of ownership, they claim CDOT dismissed the property’s sentimental value, forcing them to accept a buyout just before condemnation proceedings.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Knutzen: Northeastern Clay Busters rack up top medals in Skeet, Sporting Clays and Trap](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY BRUCE KNUTZEN****| COMMENTARY | JUNE 17** _Over the weekend of June 6th, 7th, and 8th, members of the Northeastern Clay Busters SCTP team attended a three-day state tournament. The Scholastic Clay Target Program (SCTP) is open to youth from elementary grades through college to participate in the safe, educational, and enjoyable SCTP clay target sports of American Trap, American Skeet, and Sporting Clays._ __
**[Ganahl: Local voices, local values, local control–Home Rule for Douglas County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY HEIDI GANAHL | COMMENTARY | JUNE 16** _By now, you’ve probably received your ballot—and with it, an opportunity that could redefine how we govern ourselves. This vote will decide who sits on the commission responsible for drafting our Home Rule Charter. That document will set the tone for the future of Douglas County, and I believe it’s time we step up and take control of that future ourselves._
__
**[DiGirolamo: Undercover as a 13-year-old, an officer finds what parents fear most](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JOHN DIGIROLAMO | COMMENTARY | JUNE 16** _You wouldn’t let your middle schooler wander the mall by herself, so why would you let her wander the Internet alone? If your child has online access, then every predator all over the world potentially can contact your kid. Is this a risk that parents should be worried about?_ __

clean_body: The Guardian: Trump’s justice department appointees remove leadership of voting unit| | | Back in January the voting section of the civil rights division had seven managers overseeing around 30 attorneys. Since then, one manager was detailed to a task force, one retired, and the other five were all reassigned to the "complaint adjudication office", a little-known part of the justice department that handles employee complaints. There are reportedly just three lawyers left in the whole department. | | | This speaks for itself, folks. Straight from The Guardian : "Donald Trump’s appointees at the Department of Justice have removed all of the senior civil servants working as managers in the department’s voting section and directed attorneys to dismiss all active cases, according to people familiar with the matter, part of a broader attack on the department’s civil rights division. " This action represents a dramatic escalation in Trump's war on voting, coming after he ordered a permanent litigation freeze on voting cases back in January and then issued his suppressive, anti-voting executive order last month. It's worth noting that the staff removed are nonpartisan civil servants -- lawyers who are career DOJ employees and serve regardless of who is president. Any partisan presidential appointees from the Biden administration ended their jobs when Trump was inaugurated and have been gone for months. Are we surprised? No. But this action -- though expected, based on how this division was sidelined in Trump's first four years \-- highlights how badly we need to fight for our fundamental rights as citizens , from the outside of government. name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: A moment I won’t forget
body:
It was November of 1989. My brother, sister, and I were in the waiting room at Presbyterian Hospital, awaiting the surgeon’s report on my father.

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zq5g5b9e7ds9vo349vruldvut6l3odskf0ha066o_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9jm2p36cdh2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

It was November of 1989. My brother, sister, and I were in the waiting room at Presbyterian Hospital, awaiting the surgeon’s report on my father. My dad had been complaining for several months that he just wasn’t feeling well. The doctors couldn’t find anything, so they suggested exploratory surgery. When the surgeon came back into the waiting room, he said, “We found that he has pancreatic cancer, and it has spread everywhere. There is nothing we can do.”

Of course, my brother, sister, and I asked the inevitable question that every doctor hates to answer: “How long does my dad have, do you think, Doctor?” He replied, “Well, it’s impossible to know. It could be weeks. It could be a few months. It might even be a year. But attitude is everything.”

That struck me. With all the medical technologies available, the doctor was saying that the greatest variable in my father’s longevity would be something immeasurable but very real: his attitude. I immediately thought of a comment by William James: “Perhaps the greatest discovery of this century is that if you can change your attitude, you can change your life.”

That statement inspired me to preach a series and write a book about the attitudes Christians should strive to adopt instead of those that come naturally. I’m talking about choosing things like:
---
* Purpose over aimlessness
* Perserverance over defeat
* Faith over worry

---
My book, _Choose Your Attitudes, Change Your Life_ , is being sent as a thank-you gift to anyone who donates to _Pathway to Victory's_ ministry work this month.

Each one of us has the opportunity to adjust our attitudes and choose what is noble and good. When we make that decision, the ramifications to our life and the lives of those around us are significant. I want to help you make the right choices.
---

I pray that it alters the very trajectory of your life and ministry as a believer!

Thank you, Friend, for supporting the proclamation of the gospel and the teaching of God’s Word worldwide. We simply can’t do it without you.

Dr. Robert Jeffress

subject: As the first openly trans member of Congress, I knew there would be times like this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Yassamin Ansari for Congress
body:
I’ve never felt alone because I have people like you standing with me. |
---
Hi Peter, it’s Congresswoman Sarah McBride. Right now, the GOP is using LGBTQ+ people as pawns. They’re not offering solutions to make everyone's lives better. Instead, they’re busy launching attacks — on our rights and yes, on me. **As the first openly trans member of Congress, I knew there would be moments like this. But I didn’t run for Congress to debate which bathroom I use or entertain cruelty from my Republican colleagues. ** I ran to deliver for working families. To fight for paid leave. To protect our freedoms. And I will never stop defending the LGBTQ+ community from attacks, manufactured distractions, and the hostility too many of us endure every day. I won’t let the GOP’s pettiness and bullying derail my work. Has it been easy? No. These fights never are. clean_body: I’ve never felt alone because I have people like you standing with me. | Hi Peter, it’s Congresswoman Sarah McBride. Right now, the GOP is using LGBTQ+ people as pawns. They’re not offering solutions to make everyone's lives better. Instead, they’re busy launching attacks — on our rights and yes, on me. As the first openly trans member of Congress, I knew there would be moments like this. But I didn’t run for Congress to debate which bathroom I use or entertain cruelty from my Republican colleagues. I ran to deliver for working families. To fight for paid leave. To protect our freedoms. And I will never stop defending the LGBTQ+ community from attacks, manufactured distractions, and the hostility too many of us endure every day. I won’t let the GOP’s pettiness and bullying derail my work. Has it been easy? No. These fights never are. But I’ve never felt alone — because I have people like you and Yassamin Ansari standing with me. = | = Growing up, I couldn’t imagine a future like mine. I wasn’t sure this country’s heart was big enough to love someone like me. Over the last decade, though, I’ve been able to bear witness to change that once seemed so impossible to me as a kid that it was almost incomprehensible. Because people believed it could. Because we fought for it. That’s what Pride means to me. It's a call to action and a reminder that even in the face of hate, we have the power to fight back with love, with truth, and with unshakable resolve. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Sarah McBride and Yassamin Ansari will go through immediately: | = = | = = | = = Thank you and Happy Pride! subject: BREAKING: The general election is ON in Virginia
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee
body:
This is what momentum looks like.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109818614/552345807/1328794144?refcode=ea.706d027e-5d4c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ms=ea.706d027e-5d4c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjcwNmQwMjdlLTVkNGMtZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KrxXND1X5My24zNlnWTNd3qlboGj9UTFCt_ChooguAk=&emci=e178bc52-a84b-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=706d027e-5d4c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=4823105)
---
We’re officially headed to the general election in Virginia — and the fight just got _real._ In a major upset, our endorsed candidate for Attorney General, Jay Jones, **defeated** a Dominion Energy-backed opponent who accepted an astounding $800,000 from Virginia’s largest corporate polluter. This is a _massive_ win for the climate movement — and a clear sign that voters are done letting Big Oil call the shots. Now, with every seat in the Virginia House on the ballot this November, our full slate of climate champions is officially headed to the general election. They didn’t face primary challengers, but they’re up against well-funded Republican opponents. That’s why we need to dig deep now, while there’s still time to prepare for everything our opponents throw at us. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109818615/552345808/2105508926?refcode=ea.706d027e-5d4c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ms=ea.706d027e-5d4c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjcwNmQwMjdlLTVkNGMtZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KrxXND1X5My24zNlnWTNd3qlboGj9UTFCt_ChooguAk=) Look, the stakes couldn’t be higher:
* Everyone – pundits, politicians, Big Oil – is eyeing Virginia as an early test of how Trump’s agenda is resonating with voters ahead of the midterms.

name: Matt Diemer
subject: Democracy doesn’t rest
body:
| |
---
My friends, let's be clear: the fight for our future is far from over. In fact, it's only just begun -- and you are the key. We are living through a moment of overwhelming complexity. The headlines are heavy. The stakes are high. Despair is easy. Apathy is even easier. But the only thing that has ever changed the course of history -- the only force that has ever bent the arc of the moral universe toward justice -- is ordinary people refusing to give up. I know some of you are tired. I've felt it too. I've taken a step back these past few months -- not because I've lost hope, but because even those who fight need time to breathe. And yes, I've seen more people tuning out, turning off their phones, stepping away from the noise. That may be good for your peace of mind -- and I encourage it when needed -- but understand this: **Democracy doesn 't rest. Freedom doesn't pause. Progress doesn't wait.** So take your rest. Then rise. Speak out. Stand up. Organize. Agitate. Advocate for what you believe with every ounce of strength you've got. Because if you don't, who will? Too often, we confuse compromise with surrender. Cooperation is noble. But sacrificing your truth -- silencing your convictions for the sake of comfort -- that is not compromise. That is capitulation. And it erodes the very foundation of the world we are trying to build. Be bold in your beliefs. Be unwavering in your pursuit of justice. Be unafraid to ruffle feathers or challenge the status quo. Your voice matters now more than ever -- not just for you, but for the communities that need you, for the future that depends on you. Over the past few months, I've been meeting with candidates, community leaders, and everyday people across this state. And I'll tell you what gives me hope: **there are still people in this fight. Still people stepping up, running for office, raising their hands, and saying, "Put me in."** Even in the face of vitriol. Even when the odds are long. I believe in them. And I believe in you. Democracy is not a spectator sport. It is messy. It is hard. But when more people get involved -- when more voices join the chorus -- we move forward. We build something better. I'll have more to say soon about what's next. But know this: I'm not done. Not even close. And neither are you. Reach out. Ask me anything. Share your thoughts. If you want to talk, send me your number -- I'll call you myself. Because this isn't about one person. This is about all of us. In solidarity, always.
Matt

| | Dear Friend,

The federal experiment in education has failed.

American students, once the best, now lag behind their peers--thanks in large part to the Department of Education's corruption of learning.

name: Justice Democrats
subject: BREAKING: Bernie Sanders endorsed a Justice Democrat
body:
Senator Bernie Sanders just endorsed our first candidate of 2026.
#
BREAKING, Peter:
**U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders just endorsed Donavan McKinney for Congress — Justice Democrats’ first new candidate of the 2026 cycle!**
This is a huge moment for Donavan’s campaign that cements his status as the progressive frontrunner in this race. He’s building tons of momentum to take on multimillionaire Shri Thanedar, the do-nothing Democrat currently representing Michigan’s 13th district, and fight for bold, progressive change.
**[Let’s help him build the resources he needs to win this race. Join Bernie on Team Donavan by splitting a donation to Donavan's campaign and Justice Democrats now →](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250618-dm?refcode=em20250618-36769&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36769_1203867_1ji1Og&akid=36769%2E1203867%2E1ji1Og)**
**[Contribute $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250618-dm?refcode=em20250618-36769&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36769_1203867_1ji1Og&akid=36769%2E1203867%2E1ji1Og)**
Bernie knows Donavan is up against the exact same oligarchy he’s been rallying against across the country — billionaires and multimillionaires like Shri buying elections and seats in Congress. While Donald Trump and the billionaire class are ripping apart the safety net programs so many of us rely on, with far too many corporate Democrats standing by and letting it happen, Donavan is exactly the kind of leader we need in Congress fighting for the working class.
**We have to clean house in the Democratic Party now.** Replacing out-of-touch incumbents like Thanedar with working-class, progressive leaders like Donavan is exactly how we fight back — [**but we can’t beat a self-funded multimillionaire without grassroots support from folks like you.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250618-dm?refcode=em20250618-36769&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36769_1203867_1ji1Og&akid=36769%2E1203867%2E1ji1Og)
We can count on Donavan because he’s been in this fight for years. He served on Michigan’s first-ever Environmental Justice Council and was a labor leader at SEIU Healthcare Michigan — both roles where he fought tirelessly to secure victories for the working class.
Now, as the State Representative for the poorest district in Michigan, Donavan’s working to pass legislation to fix Michigan’s public schools and bring justice to the legal system. If we elect Donavan, he will put that experience to work for working people in MI-13 and across the country in Washington.
So many of our biggest goals — _Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and a living wage_ — are being blocked by the very same interests that helped elect Thanedar. But with Donavan in this race, we have the chance to take on the dark money and give the people a leader who will actually fight for them.
**Bernie knows this moment demands candidates who are unapologetically progressive and brave enough to stand up for working people. He’s in this fight for Donavan — now, he’s asking you to step up and join him.**
**[Help us elect Donavan by pitching in $5 to his campaign and Justice Democrats right now. We have the power to reshape Congress in next year’s elections, but only if we organize and fight together NOW.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250618-dm?refcode=em20250618-36769&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36769_1203867_1ji1Og&akid=36769%2E1203867%2E1ji1Og)**
**[Contribute $5](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250618-dm?refcode=em20250618-36769&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36769_1203867_1ji1Og&akid=36769%2E1203867%2E1ji1Og)**
In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

subject: There Is a War on Public Media. Act Today!
body:
The U.S. House—including Alaska’s own Rep. Nick Begich III—voted to gut public media. The bill would claw back $1.1 billion in federal funding from the Corporation for Public Broadcasting (CPB). Now, the Senate is next—and the stakes couldn’t be higher. This is not just about Big Bird (while he’s important!)| | |
---
| | Dear Supporter, The U.S. House—including Alaska’s own Rep. Nick Begich III—[voted to gut public media](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109822557/552358899/1159972277?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDFmYjcyMy02NTRjLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NyTzraqxHjmjIhS2Zqno_TRdm4oWKDCQKOFrfig7Qv8=&emci=3e3b9ff2-5b4c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=9d1fb723-654c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=9512399). The legislation would claw back **$1.1 billion** in federal funding from the Corporation for Public Broadcasting (CPB). Now, the Senate is next—and the stakes couldn’t be higher. This is not just about Big Bird (while he is important!) For Alaskans—and for Americans living in rural areas across the country—**public media is the only connection to trusted, fact-based information.** It’s how families access educational programming without ads. It’s how communities hear about weather, disasters, and government actions. And it’s how our democracy reaches places where broadband doesn’t. **Here in Alaska:**
* **KYUK in Bethel** gets 70 percent of its funding from CPB. It’s the voice of the Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta.
* **KUCB in Unalaska** says it would have to drop most of its local programming.
* Stations like **KSKO in McGrath** , **KOTZ in Kotzebue** , and **KRBD in Ketchikan** keep Alaskans informed across regions where no commercial newsroom exists.

These stations form the backbone of **Alaska News Nightly** , delivering diverse local stories to the whole state. If these cuts go through, we don’t just lose shows—we lose **connection, context, and community.** And it’s not just Alaska. In rural Appalachia, tribal lands in the Southwest, and agricultural towns in the Midwest, public media is a lifeline. **This isn’t a budget cut. It’s an attempt to dismantle the most trusted, cost-effective public communications system in America.** For just $1.60 per person per year, public media delivers education, emergency response, civic news, and storytelling that reflects our local values. **Take action now:** 📞 **Call Senators Murkowski** at **202-224-6665** **and Sullivan** at **202-224-3004** and urge them to vote **NO** on rescinding public media funds!
📨 **Email senators** from anywhere in the U.S. at [ProtectMyPublicMedia.org](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109822558/552358900/1064899830?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDFmYjcyMy02NTRjLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NyTzraqxHjmjIhS2Zqno_TRdm4oWKDCQKOFrfig7Qv8=&emci=3e3b9ff2-5b4c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=9d1fb723-654c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=9512399) At **[Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109822559/552358901/1533895835?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDFmYjcyMy02NTRjLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NyTzraqxHjmjIhS2Zqno_TRdm4oWKDCQKOFrfig7Qv8=&emci=3e3b9ff2-5b4c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=9d1fb723-654c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=9512399)** , we believe democracy starts with access to the truth—**not spin, not disinformation, but fact-based reporting that reflects our communities.** Public media is one of the last remaining systems that still delivers that truth—especially in places like Alaska, where local news deserts are growing, broadband is limited, and private media doesn’t reach. When public media is under attack, the ability of Alaskans—and all Americans in rural and remote communities—to make informed decisions about their lives, health, economy, and government is also under attack. That’s why we’re fighting to protect this system. And that’s why we need you with us—right now. Let’s make sure Alaskans in places like Whale Pass and Wales, and Americans in every rural corner of the country, can continue to rely on public media. This isn’t just a fight over funding. It’s a fight for connection, trust, and democracy. With gratitude,
**The Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund Team**

body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | |
---
| | Dear Friend, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---

---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to support the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zc228143c01afrhrm1jo00kgbilv1vr28ojpmp80_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge0ob4c1h2bs) And it’s only possible with the help of grandparents and seniors like you. Introducing:_ Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.This ground-breaking live-action television show captivates children... ...but more importantly, it builds their character at the same time. Imagine a children’s show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of the truth. Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. Imagine a children’s show that brings families together instead of driving them apart. Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. **[Because I can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z98sumidtbcbkbjrke6kgc3d9aiuempnnspfknt0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge0ob4c1h2bs)** Millions of families are already watching Season One of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ on our streaming service BRAVE+, YouTube, and on DVD. And the reviews from parents, grandparents, and kids are incredible. One Mom of three little girls told us: “Our family was struggling through a pretty difficult day. But I turned on _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ and that was exactly what my heart needed as much as theirs.” It’s amazing that your simple response to this letter can make that kind of difference for a family. Each episode costs around $70,000 to produce. I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously we won’t work through Hollywood. Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children. We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. [**That’s why I’m asking you to help us finish Season Two of**** _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_****by giving a gift of $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $70,000 per episode.**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z6h3t99ng8ndqdh6ja0jfcm342jcca2167p9br0g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge0ob4c1h2bs)**** Whether you can send $35, $25,000, anything in between, or anything higher or lower – please know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated. As a special “Thank You” for your **[gift of $50 or more](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z5abnq4bhurj6asripsiq2135094uhh174m4o6f0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge0ob4c1h2bs)** , I’ll send you Season One of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ for your family to enjoy FREE on DVD. And with your [**gift of $100 or more**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z9g214matdlk13vasfnmqrq2mffbs9ebubmshi8g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge0ob4c1h2bs), I’ll also send you a copy of my children’s book: Pride Comes Before the Fall which teaches children to be humble before God instead of prideful. I wrote Pride Comes Before the Fall with the great team at BRAVE books – the same God-focused conservative team that’s bringing _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ to life. Maybe you’ve seen me and other BRAVE Books authors on Fox News, Newsmax, TBN or other media outlets. Unabashed conservatives like Riley Gaines, Lara Trump, Kevin Sorbo, Missy Robertson, Dinesh D’Souza, John Solomon, Jack Posobiec, and so many more have written a BRAVE Book to stop the Hollywood groomers. Supported by you, BRAVE Books gives parents the tools they need to rebuild our families and reclaim America with the Biblical values our country was founded upon. Now I know there are a lot of places you can spend your money in the next ten minutes. **[But I hope you’ll be a part of history by supporting _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_. ](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zqkj57isrmkq6ickhglili5v9gih7kpcdio1oii8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge0ob4c1h2bs)** Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes. And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth. Thank you for joining us in the fight.
