Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jfmu0q0fzzl6abb85dxhbja74txjhkmgl113412wsst423vpqrefxy1bmju5lm9lwe7b8tf5mgxd9ofaquy9l4gnhg66jxhfga27m6c8kz24minievepkhka9moy402g9l9pnpk4816bt5e38fb3&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sy2ap5&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sy2ap5&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sy2ap5&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jfmu0q0fzzl6abb85dxhbja7q4aq3c8bck8uf7s7yf2kiq9n4zrle5u7tsxhrhb1sbm19190pus2xsvv7zc5xd42wcl5gw6fdqj24achn33yxg13gsi0xhwjk7yvwfyqy8kc3gx432iqkghq6u5i&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sy2ap5&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

Peter,

It’s official: this November, Virginia will make history by electing its first woman governor.

But here’s the truth: not every woman candidate stands for progress.

The race is between Emerge alum Abigail Spanberger and an anti-choice, anti-LGBTQ, pro-Trump woman whose values couldn’t be further from what we fight for.

Emerge isn’t here just to recruit and train women. We’re here to train women who believe in:
* Protecting reproductive freedom

* Expanding access to healthcare and childcare

* Defending democracy and voting rights

* Creating opportunities for every community

* Standing up to extremism in every form

Abigail Spanberger represents the very best of what it means to be an Emerge woman. She’s a former CIA officer and member of Congress, and a proven fighter for Virginia families. Her race is personal for me, as she represented me in Congress, and I had the privilege of working on her first re-election campaign to Congress in 2020.

And now, she’s running to make history and stop Trump’s agenda from taking hold in the last Southern state protecting basic reproductive freedoms.

[_**Will you contribute today to help Emerge train and support more women like Abigail?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109824530/552365976/1143593133?refcode=BLU_EM_EMRG_2025-06-18_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkVNUi8xLzgxMzIxIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU5NWE3OTM0LTY4NGMtZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=U6ZZY5NZFQQbP99c8ZSx9X36T4OaRj2I57E51hZ0-h8=)

subject: The #1 thing you can do today to stop the Hollywood groomers
body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | |
---
| | Dear Friend, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zkh2rgo951lg6q6c5njp50iitmepdedvg4suvrsg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge8pj1chh2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to support the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z6tl6h8t0hkdhfsldv9bb35e6n0208986jqvi968_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge8pj1chh2bs) And it’s only possible with the help of grandparents and seniors like you. Introducing:_ Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.This ground-breaking live-action television show captivates children... ...but more importantly, it builds their character at the same time. Imagine a children’s show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of the truth. Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. Imagine a children’s show that brings families together instead of driving them apart. Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. **[Because I can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zinmsavkteau399g4ulekppeg8n9f0jaid7aeb80_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge8pj1chh2bs)** Millions of families are already watching Season One of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ on our streaming service BRAVE+, YouTube, and on DVD. And the reviews from parents, grandparents, and kids are incredible. One Mom of three little girls told us: “Our family was struggling through a pretty difficult day. But I turned on _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ and that was exactly what my heart needed as much as theirs.” It’s amazing that your simple response to this letter can make that kind of difference for a family. Each episode costs around $70,000 to produce. I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously we won’t work through Hollywood. Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children. We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. [**That’s why I’m asking you to help us finish Season Two of**** _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_****by giving a gift of $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $70,000 per episode.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z2ik7odo3r7lrkqf4v1257lflikv481op0im5cv0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge8pj1chh2bs)**** Whether you can send $35, $25,000, anything in between, or anything higher or lower – please know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated. As a special “Thank You” for your **[gift of $50 or more](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zc1hurfml8bt8vqi6tg1p0p3edshvossblg1v528_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge8pj1chh2bs)** , I’ll send you Season One of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ for your family to enjoy FREE on DVD. And with your [**gift of $100 or more**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zikcr5imc3nu2k26vb31891pjk5jkbsu1fit3f3g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge8pj1chh2bs), I’ll also send you a copy of my children’s book: Pride Comes Before the Fall which teaches children to be humble before God instead of prideful. I wrote Pride Comes Before the Fall with the great team at BRAVE books – the same God-focused conservative team that’s bringing _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ to life. Maybe you’ve seen me and other BRAVE Books authors on Fox News, Newsmax, TBN or other media outlets. Unabashed conservatives like Riley Gaines, Lara Trump, Kevin Sorbo, Missy Robertson, Dinesh D’Souza, John Solomon, Jack Posobiec, and so many more have written a BRAVE Book to stop the Hollywood groomers. Supported by you, BRAVE Books gives parents the tools they need to rebuild our families and reclaim America with the Biblical values our country was founded upon. Now I know there are a lot of places you can spend your money in the next ten minutes. **[But I hope you’ll be a part of history by supporting _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_. ](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zvngdt5sinqar1n90u74rfufb4liufmqv31vk7j8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge8pj1chh2bs)** Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes. And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth. Thank you for joining us in the fight.
---
Sincerely,

body:
https://www.politivistaction.com [https://www.politivistaction.com]
Peter,
Did you know that over half of all members of Congress are millionaires?
Let that sink in.
While families face tariffs, ration groceries, skip medical care, and work multiple jobs just to make ends meet, the people in power—the ones writing our laws—are sitting very comfortably.
And let’s be real: a lot of them aren’t fighting for our families or our communities. They don’t want us to realize how they hoard wealth, buy influence, and manipulate power. But we see through it, and we have a feeling you do, too.
Meanwhile, the few champions we DO have in Congress— who know firsthand what it’s like to struggle —are fighting to tax the rich, fund our communities, and build a government that actually serves the people.
But Republicans— and some bought-and-paid-for Democrats—would rather protect billionaire tax breaks and corporate loopholes than expand food assistance or ensure health care access for low-income families.

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: The #1 thing you can do today to stop the Hollywood groomers
body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | |
---
| | Dear Friend, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zjc8j3644ubn30lgoav82i8creosaccfgdmjtg8g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge4oj2c1h2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to support the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zvevc123b11dbvlhbaeshsgll4ghbsnpbosa8epo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge4oj2c1h2bs) And it’s only possible with the help of grandparents and seniors like you. Introducing:_ Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.This ground-breaking live-action television show captivates children... ...but more importantly, it builds their character at the same time. Imagine a children’s show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of the truth. Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. Imagine a children’s show that brings families together instead of driving them apart. Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. **[Because I can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zri68u1i67cc4o8ed9rhiu3hapojp5ip1i5v5610_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge4oj2c1h2bs)** Millions of families are already watching Season One of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ on our streaming service BRAVE+, YouTube, and on DVD. And the reviews from parents, grandparents, and kids are incredible. One Mom of three little girls told us: “Our family was struggling through a pretty difficult day. But I turned on _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ and that was exactly what my heart needed as much as theirs.” It’s amazing that your simple response to this letter can make that kind of difference for a family. Each episode costs around $70,000 to produce. I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously we won’t work through Hollywood. Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children. We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. [**That’s why I’m asking you to help us finish Season Two of**** _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_****by giving a gift of $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $70,000 per episode.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z84tm8q7duphevd941sc2kaosbuicgk8cpcs5ue8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge4oj2c1h2bs)**** Whether you can send $35, $25,000, anything in between, or anything higher or lower – please know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated. As a special “Thank You” for your **[gift of $50 or more](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zl9ntobp64f50qqvd2pt1igubeikvoju6ljarma0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge4oj2c1h2bs)** , I’ll send you Season One of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ for your family to enjoy FREE on DVD. And with your [**gift of $100 or more**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z36u3o1usaac7o5gjne7irqon1fgrmd182c2o9go_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge4oj2c1h2bs), I’ll also send you a copy of my children’s book: Pride Comes Before the Fall which teaches children to be humble before God instead of prideful. I wrote Pride Comes Before the Fall with the great team at BRAVE books – the same God-focused conservative team that’s bringing _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ to life. Maybe you’ve seen me and other BRAVE Books authors on Fox News, Newsmax, TBN or other media outlets. Unabashed conservatives like Riley Gaines, Lara Trump, Kevin Sorbo, Missy Robertson, Dinesh D’Souza, John Solomon, Jack Posobiec, and so many more have written a BRAVE Book to stop the Hollywood groomers. Supported by you, BRAVE Books gives parents the tools they need to rebuild our families and reclaim America with the Biblical values our country was founded upon. Now I know there are a lot of places you can spend your money in the next ten minutes. **[But I hope you’ll be a part of history by supporting _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_. ](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zf1g0uen0arm5hd536h88vhlfjfk14dsdnkk28ng_rp22sh2s8i6epb0c9ge4oj2c1h2bs)** Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes. And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth. Thank you for joining us in the fight.
---
Sincerely,
---

name: Keith
subject: Grieving a tremendous loss
disclaimer_text: paid for by the Keith Ellison for Attorney General committee, PO Box 17224, Minneapolis, MN 55417
body:
Peter,

Like many of you, I’m grieving the enormous loss of Melissa and Mark Hortman. I’m also grieving for Minnesota, as we try and navigate this difficult moment, when the tools of division and hateful, violent discourse have become far too common in our political and social landscapes.

Melissa and I were friends for over two decades. She was wise, caring, and brilliant. Her smile lifted people up in good times and helped them through the bad.

As a legislator and Speaker, Melissa relied on a strong moral compass and an unwavering dedication to her community and the state of Minnesota. She fought for the vulnerable, stood up to bullies, and embraced people without regard for personal or political differences.

Melissa was a force in Minnesota politics, but she was also a compassionate and kind person. Through all the ups and downs of public life, she never lost sight of what’s right, and always stood on the side of fairness, and of justice.

We can honor Melissa and Mark by doing the same.

My heart goes out to Melissa and Mark’s two children and their families. I’m also praying for Senator John Hoffman, his wife Yvette, and their daughter Hope as they begin their long road to recovery.

In times like this, we need each other. I hope all of us can offer grace, care, and kindness to others in the days ahead.

Thank you,

Keith Ellison

body:
It’s outrageous that in the richest country on Earth, people have to worry about whether they’ll be able to afford needed care if they or a loved one becomes sick or gets into an accident.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109826188/552372058/150430950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OWViZDQzMC02YzRjLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9KNxZmYJ-HYbXAGJwfsf3Jba9ReGzcShs30_lHbqQs8=&emci=52ebd430-6c4c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=59ebd430-6c4c-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=7731215)
---

| | It's outrageous that in the richest country on Earth, people have to worry about whether they'll be able to afford needed care if they or a loved one becomes sick or gets into an accident. **We need to make sure every American — no matter their zip code — has access to high-quality, affordable health care.** Americans are tired of being stuck in a broken health care system that puts profits ahead of people. The good news? We already have an effective, popular solution: Medicare. **That's why I reintroduced the**** _Choose Medicare Act_****— to make sure every American has the option to buy in if they want to and to put us further along the path toward universal health care.** This legislation opens up Medicare to all Americans and builds on the system we have today. By allowing Medicare to compete with private health insurance, we're giving consumers and businesses a choice on the path to universal health care and lowering health care and prescription drug costs, too. That means no more skyrocketing premiums, surprise bills, or insurance companies making final decisions about your health care. I'm working hard to improve health care affordability while increasing access, competition, and choice. **The**** _Choose Medicare Act_****would do just that. It's about freedom, fairness, and putting people back in control of their health care.** Right now, we face a clear choice: stick with a broken system that gets more expensive every year, puts working families one pink slip away from losing their health coverage, and makes our businesses less competitive, or an improved model that works for people, expands options, and lowers costs. clean_body: It’s outrageous that in the richest country on Earth, people have to worry about whether they’ll be able to afford needed care if they or a loved one becomes sick or gets into an accident. | | | | It's outrageous that in the richest country on Earth, people have to worry about whether they'll be able to afford needed care if they or a loved one becomes sick or gets into an accident. We need to make sure every American — no matter their zip code — has access to high-quality, affordable health care. Americans are tired of being stuck in a broken health care system that puts profits ahead of people. The good news? We already have an effective, popular solution: Medicare. That's why I reintroduced the Choose Medicare Act— to make sure every American has the option to buy in if they want to and to put us further along the path toward universal health care. This legislation opens up Medicare to all Americans and builds on the system we have today. By allowing Medicare to compete with private health insurance, we're giving consumers and businesses a choice on the path to universal health care and lowering health care and prescription drug costs, too. That means no more skyrocketing premiums, surprise bills, or insurance companies making final decisions about your health care. I'm working hard to improve health care affordability while increasing access, competition, and choice. The Choose Medicare Actwould do just that. It's about freedom, fairness, and putting people back in control of their health care. Right now, we face a clear choice: stick with a broken system that gets more expensive every year, puts working families one pink slip away from losing their health coverage, and makes our businesses less competitive, or an improved model that works for people, expands options, and lowers costs. We can't afford to do nothing, and that's why I'm urging the Senate to pass the Choose Medicare Act. Onward! Team — I am officially the Democratic nominee for Attorney General of Virginia. I couldn’t be more thankful to everyone who chipped in, spread the word, or even read emails just like this one. I couldn’t have done it without every single one of you.
Now, the real fight begins.
I’m up against our far-right AG Jason Miyares, who prioritizes his allegiance to Donald Trump over the people of Virginia, leaving our families and communities vulnerable to attacks. He’s allowed the Trump administration to walk all over the Commonwealth.
The Commonwealth needs a change – but Miyares is going to be tough to beat because his wealthy friends are trying to buy this election.
We need all hands on deck to fight back.
I’m immediately setting up a General Election Launch Fund with a goal of raising $50,000 in the first 3 days of this race. We can’t waste any time if we’re going to win in November. Can you chip in $15 or more to help me reach my goal and retire Jason Miyares? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-launch_em_q22025?amount=15]

Virginians are concerned about keeping their families safe, having good jobs that put food on the table, and having access to life-saving services like Medicaid and Social Security that millions depend on.
That’s why I’m in this race – because I know a brighter future for Virginia is possible.
But unless we build a strong supporter base from the start, Miyares and Trump’s MAGA cronies will jump at the opportunity to crush our grassroots movement.

# HELP SUSTAIN STRONG LEADERSHIP
Friends,

I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished together—but real change doesn’t happen overnight. It takes consistent, focused leadership and a community willing to show up again and again. **That’s why I’m asking you to become a monthly donor today.** Sustaining support helps us stay ready—whether it's fighting for fair housing, access to healthcare, or strong public schools. Our work is far from over. This is about building lasting impact, year after year. **Can I count on you to join as a monthly supporter?** A recurring contribution—even $10 or $15 a month—helps us plan ahead, organize smarter, and stay focused on what matters most: delivering results for our community. [BECOME A MONTHLY DONOR](https://andreahunley.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=e123da8585&e=d9ebccf591) Thank you for believing in people-powered leadership.
Andrea

| | Peter, I had the honor of standing with thousands of Pennsylvanians at No Kings protests in Pittsburgh and Greensburg. **This type of civil dissent is EXACTLY what Democracy looks like, and I couldn't be prouder of our state for taking a stand against Trump's authoritarianism.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/109828313/552379898/2067543217?amount=10&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_061825_NOKINGS_30DO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYjE4MWEyNi03MDRjLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=caE5O1PBBaTmf2YQGwYcPrNbldhKTDvH3ydeqxTs3vs=) **America hasn't had a king in 249 years, and we aren't going back now. ** Our Democracy was born in Pennsylvania. Primary wins, Pittsburgh’s loss, and what’s next for our movement. | | | Hi Peter, **Welcome back to the Pennsylvania Working Families Party's monthly newsletter,** your go-to source for major wins, critical updates, and ways to get involved as we build working-class power across the Commonwealth. Let’s dig in.
* * *
💥 **May Primary Takeaways: Our Movement Showed Up** On May 20th, we went toe-to-toe with billionaires, real estate developers, and political machines. We won big, we took a gut-punch loss, and we made one thing clear: working people are organizing, and the bosses are sweating. * * *
**🏆 Big Wins Across Pennsylvania**
* **PHILADELPHIA:** Progressive champion Larry Krasner secured the Democratic nomination for a third term as District Attorney. Since 2017, Larry has cut future incarceration rates by nearly 50%, helped lower homicide rates to a decade-low, and taken on the carceral status quo, and Philly voters have stood by his vision.
* **LANCASTER:** Jaime Arroyo won his mayoral primary. Ahmed Ahmed and Marshall Miller are advancing to the general election for City Council.
* **ALLENTOWN:** WFP-endorsed Natalie Santos is headed to the general election.
* **ALLEGHENY COUNTY:** Four of our endorsed judicial candidates will be on the November ballot.

* * *
**💔 The Fight in Pittsburgh: Corporate Cash Strikes Again** Mayor **Ed Gainey** , Pittsburgh’s first Black mayor and a lifelong champion for working people, was defeated in the primary, not by a better vision, but by an avalanche of dark money:
* $160,000+ from Republican donors in a Democratic primary
* $285,000+ from real estate and corporate developers
* $745,000+ in attack ads from a shadowy PAC called Common Sense Change

**The message?** When you challenge the wealthy and well-connected, when you fight for tenants, refuse to collaborate with ICE, and stand up to UPMC, they come for you. But here’s the truth: They might’ve taken a seat. But they haven’t taken us. We’re still here. Still organizing. Still fighting. And we’re not backing down.

clean_body: Primary wins, Pittsburgh’s loss, and what’s next for our movement. | | | Hi Peter, Welcome back to the Pennsylvania Working Families Party's monthly newsletter, your go-to source for major wins, critical updates, and ways to get involved as we build working-class power across the Commonwealth. Let’s dig in. 💥 May Primary Takeaways: Our Movement Showed Up On May 20th, we went toe-to-toe with billionaires, real estate developers, and political machines. We won big, we took a gut-punch loss, and we made one thing clear: working people are organizing, and the bosses are sweating. 🏆 Big Wins Across Pennsylvania PHILADELPHIA: Progressive champion Larry Krasner secured the Democratic nomination for a third term as District Attorney. Since 2017, Larry has cut future incarceration rates by nearly 50%, helped lower homicide rates to a decade-low, and taken on the carceral status quo, and Philly voters have stood by his vision. LANCASTER: Jaime Arroyo won his mayoral primary. Ahmed Ahmed and Marshall Miller are advancing to the general election for City Council. ALLENTOWN: WFP-endorsed Natalie Santos is headed to the general election. ALLEGHENY COUNTY: Four of our endorsed judicial candidates will be on the November ballot. 💔 The Fight in Pittsburgh: Corporate Cash Strikes Again Mayor Ed Gainey , Pittsburgh’s first Black mayor and a lifelong champion for working people, was defeated in the primary, not by a better vision, but by an avalanche of dark money: $160,000+ from Republican donors in a Democratic primary $285,000+ from real estate and corporate developers $745,000+ in attack ads from a shadowy PAC called Common Sense Change The message? When you challenge the wealthy and well-connected, when you fight for tenants, refuse to collaborate with ICE, and stand up to UPMC, they come for you. But here’s the truth: They might’ve taken a seat. But they haven’t taken us. We’re still here. Still organizing. Still fighting. And we’re not backing down. 📅 Upcoming Events: Build Power With Us 📅 Wednesday, June 18th | 5:00 PM EDT 📍2000 Market St, Philadelphia, PA 19103 US Stand with Philadelphia workers as we tell Senator McCormick: No Cuts to Medicaid or SNAP! 📅 Sunday, June 22nd | 12:00 - 2:00 PM EDT 📍Bethlehem Rose Garden, W Union Blvd &, 725 8th Ave, Bethlehem, PA 18018 Join the annual We the People Rally the Valley. | | | President Trump suddenly appears ready to rush into war with Iran as soon as possible. He is making wild threats, talking openly of killing its leader, and acting in a way that is just plain nuts. [**Don't let him rush us into a war we may long regret. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1bab76ce-af23-416d-842b-ab1843c7cca2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) When we went to war with Iraq, we were told it would last "days or weeks." We were there for a decade. Iran is a much bigger country than Iraq, with larger armed forces and this could end up being a much more difficult fight. Let's not rush into this without a damn good reason, and a well thought out plan. Listen, writing these emails asking for your hard-earned money is definitely _not_ my favorite part of the job. I’d much rather send you a long laundry list of what I’m getting done in Congress for Kansas families, and not have to worry about fundraising for even a minute.
But that’s just not realistic, as much as I wish it was. The cold, hard truth is that these fundraising emails are necessary, because National Republicans know that the outcome of next year’s elections will determine which path our country will take — and they’re spending like it too.
If National Republicans expand their Congressional majority and flip KS-03, it would mean two more years of unchecked power in the White House. And it would mean total Republican control of our state.
**But if we hold KS-03 and take back the House majority, we can place a check on Trump’s power. We can hold extremists accountable for their blatant corruption. And we can finally get Congress focused on the real needs of the American people, like lowering costs, protecting our fundamental freedoms, and building safer, stronger communities.**

| | Hi Friend, This past weekend, I stood shoulder to shoulder with more than 10,000 of our neighbors in the heart of Oakland. We gathered under the hot June sun in Frank Ogawa Plaza, as part of the nationwide “No Kings” day of action. Our message was clear: we will not accept authoritarianism. We will not kneel to tyranny. _**And we will never stop fighting for a democracy that works for all of us.**_ Standing on that stage, I looked out at a sea of signs, elders linked arm-in-arm with teenagers, families with strollers, union members in bright t-shirts, and longtime organizers who’ve marched for decades. I spoke at that event with a clear message:
### _“We are coming. We are coming with ballots. We are coming with protests. We are coming with policy. We are coming with the poetry of the truth... No fear will break us. We will never kneel to a king,” she said. “We will show them that we will never throw trans children under the bus. We will be voting in 2026. We will show them who we are.”_

clean_body: Thousands gathered in Oakland to defend our democracy, and we won’t stop now. | = = | | Hi Friend, This past weekend, I stood shoulder to shoulder with more than 10,000 of our neighbors in the heart of Oakland. We gathered under the hot June sun in Frank Ogawa Plaza, as part of the nationwide “No Kings” day of action. Our message was clear: we will not accept authoritarianism. We will not kneel to tyranny. And we will never stop fighting for a democracy that works for all of us. Standing on that stage, I looked out at a sea of signs, elders linked arm-in-arm with teenagers, families with strollers, union members in bright t-shirts, and longtime organizers who’ve marched for decades. I spoke at that event with a clear message: “We are coming. We are coming with ballots. We are coming with protests. We are coming with policy. We are coming with the poetry of the truth... No fear will break us. We will never kneel to a king,” she said. “We will show them that we will never throw trans children under the bus. We will be voting in 2026. We will show them who we are.” = Credit: Jerome Parmer for The Oaklandside In the face of a Republican-controlled Congress that refuses to act, we must be clear-eyed: our democracy is in danger. But here in Oakland, we know how to fight back—with strategy, with solidarity, and with love– it’s in our history, it’s in our blood.. I’ve been in this fight since I was a teenager, organizing young women impacted by incarceration. And now, as your Congresswoman and one of the only single moms of a school-age child in the House, I carry your voices with me every day to Washington. We won’t be silenced. We won’t be intimidated. And we sure as hell won’t be ruled by kings. = | | = = | = = | = = Thank you for showing up. Thank you for resisting. I'm disappointed. Not in you (never in you) but in myself.

It cost our nation trillions of dollars that could have gone to building schools, paving roads, providing healthcare, or solving homelessness. But war with Iran wouldn't just be another Iraq War, it would be far, far worse: | Iran has roughly double the population of Iraq and the largest military in the Middle East. And unlike Iraq Russia, China, and other Middle Eastern countries are likely to aid Iran's defense. A conflict with Iran not only has the likelihood of sparking a massive regional conflict, but potentially a third World War. This is not a game, Mr. President. Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning.
I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible.
I also ran — years before the _Dobbs_ decision — because it was already clear the GOP was coming for reproductive rights. I saw Georgia as the front line in that fight. With a six-week ban now in place here, and Republicans pushing for a national abortion ban, it still is.
**Now this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history. In his first 100 days:**
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Purged independent watchdogs across government.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists—and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Defied and threatened federal judges.
* Undermined the press.
* Handed sweeping, unaccountable power to the billionaire who spent $300 million to elect him.

Trump’s goal isn’t just revenge. He wants to use the government to crush the opposition. And now, Americans are living in fear of their own government.
This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes.
**In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history—and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.**
Now we must win again. And we _will_ win again.
Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.

Hi friends – last week I re-introduced the My Body, My Data Act to codify meaningful privacy protections for reproductive and sexual health data.
If you use a period tracking app (like I do), or know someone who does – that data is *not* protected by HIPAA. And since Roe was overturned, law enforcement agencies can actually use that personal data – along with things like search engine history and location tracking data from your phone – to investigate and prosecute people for having abortions (or even miscarriages!) that are illegal under state law.
That’s truly terrifying, and it’s not okay with me.
The good news is we can do something about it. My legislation would make it illegal for companies to collect or retain information beyond what they actually need, or to sell or share any of your data. Plus, it would allow you to ask for your data to be deleted at any time, and to sue any company you think is misusing your data in any way.
We desperately need comprehensive data privacy legislation in this country so our laws can keep up with our technology – and right now, as our reproductive freedoms are being attacked left and right, making sure private reproductive and sexual health data is kept private should be a top priority.
If you agree, I hope you’ll sign on to show your support for this important data privacy legislation today. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/0jK174jmPUipXPEaHfsyhQ2]

Team, yesterday New York City comptroller Brad Lander was arrested by ICE for demanding to see an arrest warrant as they detained people outside an immigration hearing.
**ICE does not have the authority to arrest US citizens like Brad Lander.**
Last week, Senator Alex Padilla was handcuffed and thrown to the ground by DHS for daring to question Secretary Kristi Noem.
A Democratic mayor and my colleague Rep. LaMonica McIver were both arrested by ICE at a protest, and LaMonica is now facing felony charges.
A judge in Wisconsin was arrested for protecting people from an outrageous courthouse ICE crackdown.
And dozens of student protest leaders have been detained by ICE indefinitely or deported simply for exercising their right to free speech.
**Trump is an out of control authoritarian, and ICE is his personal police force.**
They don’t identify themselves. They wear plain clothes. They hide themselves with masks. And they show up anywhere and everywhere to separate families, violently detain people, and enforce Donald Trump’s extremist policies on immigration.
If you understand how dangerous this is for our democracy, you have to continue to stand up and fight back. Because if we let this kind of conduct become normalized we will be on the fast-track to full fascism before too long.

subject: Let me lay this out
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream
#

[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-ossoff-em-split.vUHoTq&refcode=em250618-1-160+&refcode2=3894.734936.drBUGF&t=1&akid=3894%2E734936%2EdrBUGF)
---
_Let me lay this out, clear as day:_
I am the only Democratic Senator up for re-election in a state Trump won in 2024.
This Senate race in Georgia will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation.
If you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight — [**please split $5 between my re-election campaign and Ruben Gallego today.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-ossoff-em-split.vUHoTq&refcode=em250618-1-160+&t=2&akid=3894%2E734936%2EdrBUGF)
[SPLIT A DONATION](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-ossoff-em-split.vUHoTq&refcode=em250618-1-160+&t=3&akid=3894%2E734936%2EdrBUGF)
Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, and where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning.
I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible.
I also ran — years before the Dobbs decision — because it was already clear the GOP was coming for reproductive rights. I saw Georgia as the front line in that fight. With a six-week ban now in place here, and Republicans pushing for a national abortion ban, it still is.
**Now, this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history. In his first 100 days:**
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Purged independent watchdogs across government.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists—and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Defied and threatened federal judges.
* Undermined the press.
* Handed sweeping, unaccountable power to the billionaire who spent $300 million to elect him.

Trump’s goal isn’t just revenge. He wants to use the government to crush the opposition. And now, Americans are living in fear of their own government.
This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes.
**In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history—and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.**
Now we must win again. And we _will_ win again.
Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.
So I’m asking:
[**Please split a contribution between my re-election campaign and Ruben Gallego today, of $5 or any amount that works for you.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-ossoff-em-split.vUHoTq&refcode=em250618-1-160+&t=4&akid=3894%2E734936%2EdrBUGF)
The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more.
All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can to power our grassroots campaign. Please, contribute today.
[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-ossoff-em-split.vUHoTq&refcode=em250618-1-160+&t=5&akid=3894%2E734936%2EdrBUGF)
Thanks for being part of this team.
As always,
Jon Ossoff

In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history—and we won. We’re going to get right to the point here, Peter:
You know that massive Frankenstein’s monster of a budget that Trump and his MAGA Congress are trying to force through? The one giving trillions in tax cuts for the rich and taking health care and services from the poor? It’s even worse than you thought.
Utah Senator Mike Lee just tacked on a plan to sell off 250 million acres of public lands to the richest people in the country, in 3 million acre portions, every 60 days.
These people want to make a quick buck by selling OUR public lands to oil, gas, logging, and mining interests.
They want to take land that Veterans use to walk off the war and hand it over to guys like Elon Musk so they can build mansions on it.
Forest Service land, Bureau of Land Management land, even tribal homelands — with no right of refusal. Some of the most beautiful, biodiverse, precious lands we’ve got. Migration corridors for big game, national forests, recreation areas, sacred places — all on the auction block.
Trump keeps calling this the Big Beautiful Bill, but a Big Beautiful Betrayal is what it really is. This is one area where the left and the right agree — and a lot of people who voted for Trump are outraged right now.
Trump and the GOP messed up. It is time we made them pay for it.
VoteVets is working with our allies to stop this betrayal from becoming law. We’re pulling broad coalitions together to mobilize not just for public lands, but for the VA and for affordable housing, food, and health care.

| | | _**- A Personal Note from Congresswoman Young Kim - **_
Dear, Friend,

You may not know me, but this is Congresswoman Young Kim, and I would really appreciate it if you would take a moment to read my story.

I am a Christian, mother, wife, small business owner, and a first-generation immigrant.

When I moved to America, I didn't speak a word of English. But I worked hard, put myself through school, and am now one of the first Korean-American women to serve in Congress. But my road hasn't been exactly easy.

_In 2018, I ran for Congress and I lost my election._

But I wouldn't let myself give up no matter how hard the Democrats tried to make me. So I ran again in 2020, and despite MILLIONS in spending against me, we won. **Together, we flipped a DEEP BLUE seat RED for the FIRST TIME in 26 years. **

Every year since then, we've continued to defy the odds to stop the woke Democrat machine and keep this seat for House Republicans.

_I 'm nothing special._ Just an immigrant who came to this country - not knowing a word of English - who lived the American Dream. And I've made it my mission on Capitol Hill to help make that same Dream possible for everyone.

But now, the Democrats are once again after my seat. They are angry that I flipped a deep Blue seat Red, and they want it back. _The far-Left knows that my seat could very well decide the House Majority and they are DESPERATE for revenge._

This past
weekend was a reminder of both the strength and fragility of our
democracy.

In our nation’s capital, Donald Trump threw a costly military parade — a
goal of his for nearly a decade now, and not-so-coincidentally held on his
own birthday. Tanks rolled down the streets of Washington, D.C. and
helicopters flew overhead as a thin crowd looked on.

On the same day, millions of people in every corner of California and
across the country came together at No Kings Day protests to peacefully,
powerfully, and lawfully demand better.

These two events could not have been more different, but together they
remind us just how much is at stake right now. We can stand by and allow
our country to continue down a dangerous path into authoritarianism — or
we can stand up and fight back, together.

Democracy thrives on engagement and dies in neglect. It’s a contact sport,
which means we need you in the game, not on the sidelines.

If you believe our democracy is worth protecting, I urge you to continue
speaking up and speaking out. Exercise your rights and demand change. Do
it lawfully, peacefully, and safely — but do not stay silent.

As your Attorney General, here is what I will do:

Each and every time President Trump breaks the law or violates the
Constitution, I will take him to court. Unapologetically, resolutely.

I will continue doing the job the people of California elected me to do:
fighting for your rights, your freedoms, and your safety. And together, we
can — and will — take a stand.

The US has a long history of diving into wars on false pretenses, from the Spanish-American War to Afghanistan, each sold with lies that betray our founding principles.
They say that the first casualty in war... _is truth._
So, excuse me if I roll my eyes at the thought of America being dragged into WWIII based on the decades long threat of Iran being "days away from getting nukes."
_They 've been saying that since I was a kid._
So now, a brief history lesson...
## The Spanish American War
The U.S. claimed the USS Maine was sunk by Spanish sabotage to justify war.
In reality, the explosion was likely an accident, and exaggerated stories of Spanish cruelty in Cuba fueled public support. The goal was not liberation but seizing Spanish colonies to build an American empire. Cuba and the Philippines merely exchanged one ruler for another. Many view this as the moment the U.S. abandoned the Founders' non-interventionist principles, trading integrity for imperial ambition (a major pattern that escalated in the 20th century) with no benefit to the nation.
## The Korean "War"
They said North Korea's invasion of South Korea was a sudden communist assault that threatened "global freedom."
In reality, the U.S. and Soviets divided Korea after WWII, creating rival states that clashed repeatedly before the war. The U.S. supported South Korea's authoritarian regime and inflated the Soviet threat to justify intervention. It was about projecting power in Asia, not "saving democracy" (another phrase used ad nauseum in the 20th and 21st century). This war killed 36,000 Americans in a stalemate that achieved nothing.
## The Vietnam "War"
The Gulf of Tonkin incident was presented as North Vietnamese aggression to rally support for war.
In reality, one attack was minor, another made up, and the U.S. escalated tensions deliberately. Vietnam posed no direct threat. Yet the U.S. inserted themselves into a civil war anyhow. This was a catastrophic waste of 58,000 American lives, millions of Vietnamese, and billions in costs, all for no national gain, enriching only defense contractors, and leaving Vietnam in a worse state than before our intervention.
## The Panama Invasion
The U.S. justified invading Panama by claiming Manuel Noriega was a drug-trafficking dictator endangering American lives and the Panama Canal.
In reality, Noriega was a longtime CIA asset until he resisted U.S. control. The drug charges were amplified to justify removing him, and the canal was never at risk. The invasion killed hundreds of Panamanian civilians and secured U.S. influence in Central America. This was an overreach, wasting lives to maintain regional dominance.
## The Gulf "War"
The U.S. claimed Iraq's invasion of Kuwait endangered global stability and cited stories of Iraqi soldiers killing Kuwaiti babies.
In reality, the baby-killing tale was a PR stunt by Kuwaiti royal and U.S. firms. The U.S. had supported Saddam against Iran until he targeted oil-rich Kuwait. The war was about securing oil and influence, not justice. We regrettably squandered American lives for corporate interests, with no reason to play global enforcer.
## The Kosovo "War"
The U.S. and NATO claimed intervention in Kosovo was needed to stop Serbian genocide against ethnic Albanians.
In reality, the genocide claims were overstated; the conflict was a civil war with atrocities on both sides. The U.S. backed the Kosovo Liberation Army, a group with terrorist ties, to weaken Serbia and expand NATO's influence in the Balkans. The bombing campaign killed civilians and destabilized the region. This is yet another unnecessary intervention, entangling the U.S. in a conflict with no national interest.
## The Afghanistan "War"
The invasion was sold as a response to 9/11 to dismantle al-Qaeda and capture Bin Laden.
In reality, the mission was always nation-building to secure a foothold near Iran, China, and Russia. The war cost $2 trillion, thousands of American lives, and ended in a disgraceful, shameful withdrawal by the bumbling fool, Joe Biden. It was a 20-year distraction from national priorities.
## The Iraq "War"
The invasion was justified by claims of Saddam's "weapons of mass destruction" and al-Qaeda connections.
In reality, no weapons or links existed; the intelligence was manipulated to sell the war. The true aim was reshaping the Middle East for U.S. and allied interests, securing oil, and establishing bases. This reckless venture cost us trillions, thousands of American lives, and regional stability, yielding nothing but debt and chaos for the nation.
## The Libya Intervention
The U.S. claimed Gaddafi was on the verge of genocide, demanding urgent intervention to save civilians.
In realty, the goal was eliminating a leader who resisted Western control. NATO's bombing, backed by the U.S., turned Libya into a failed state with jihadists and slave markets. Yet another pointless conflict that harmed America's interests and left destruction in its wake.
## The Pattern is Clear
Each "war" was sold with falsehoods like sinking ships, fake atrocities, and nonexistent threats to serve globalist elites... _not the American people._
Many see these as betrayals, draining blood and treasure while eroding sovereignty. The solution is to stay out of foreign conflicts, focus on home, and reject the neocon warhawk lies that fuel endless wars.
**#AmericaFirst**

Census data says Los Angeles has 4 million total residents. A birther crypto scammer convicted of 34 felony fraud charges says the city harbors "Millions upon Millions of Illegal Aliens." For busy voters, it can be hard to know who to trust.
The owner of Twitter sends out 100 right wing propaganda tweets every single day and the algorithm is set up so that every single person on Twitter has to see every single one of these tweets. Now here's another piece about Blue Sky's ideological diversity problem.
### **Cliff 's Note: **
#### **Well, Well, Well ... The MAGA Cult Finally Found Something to Fight About**
Foreign policy. That's what it took. Not the corruption. Not the grifting. Not the tax cuts for billionaires while working folks lose jobs, healthcare and homes. Not the kids in cages. Not the insurrection. Not the time he told people to inject bleach, or screamed "they're eating the pets" on live tv. Not the 34 count conviction. Not the time a judge found he committed rape in a civil trial.
Not the payoff to the porn star he had sex with while his wife was home with their newborn. Not that he wears a girdle. Not the "shithole countries" that just all happened to be in Africa. Not his aptly named (by Penn Jillette) "piss cotton candy hair." Not when he stared directly into an eclipse. Not his role in creating Eric Trump.
No, what's finally tearing Trump's MAGA coalition apart is the oldest snake pit in politics: war. It turns out that even cults may have their limits--especially when their Dear Leader starts sounding like Dick Cheney circa early 2000s. Ya know, when he was so bored he'd go hunting and shoot a random friend in the face.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bb542116-e15c-487b-8b44-05d9e26fe9c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump's fanatics spent years giving the thumbs up every time he'd like a bag of poop on fire, place it on their doormat, ring and run. They stopped even pretending to support fiscal responsibility, moral values, constitutionalism and basic common sense faster than you can say "Mar-a-Lago crapper converted into stolen-document-storage center."
But now that Trump's frothing at the mouth to drop 30,000-pound bombs on Iran? Well, suddenly the MAGA brain-worm trust is splintering into isolationists, war-hawks and good old-fashioned conspiracy grifters calling each other "kooky" on Fox, Newsmax, Truth Social and Telegram. Or the Mai-Tai-meth cocktail version of Thomas Paine's "Common Sense."
**This is what happens when many in a movement pretending to care about "America First" realize their messiah only ever meant **_**Trump First**_**.** _Whoops_.
Tucker Carlson, who spent years turning the Fox News audience demographic of constipation-battling 78-year old prigs into a paranoid militia with Wi-Fi, is doing his best Abby Hoffman--slamming Trump for selling out the base. Steve Bannon's sounding like he just read _Foreign Affairs_. Marjorie Taylor Greene is so off the MAGA-beaten path I half expect her to tweet "workers of the world, unite" at any moment.

Meanwhile, Trump's on Truth Social daring them to start their own TV networks if they've got something to say. Leadership, folks! Which reminds me, for us to ignore Putin's role in convincing these Americans to stop an attack on Iran, his ally, would be to miss a key plot point.
Not to mention Putin's providing talking points to Tucker, who skipped on over to Moscow do supermarket propaganda for Putin in the past, as yo may recall. And MTG, who's never met a Russian talking point she can't regurgitate. You can be on the right side for the wrong reasons, folks.
The thing about Trump is he never had a foreign policy philosophy. Hell, the man doesn't know when World War II ended, mixed up the fascist leaders of Turkey and Hungary and pronounces China like he learned it from watching porn. His only foreign policy has been fear. Anger. Resentment. Ya know, the stuff Yoda warned would land you squarely on the Sith side of things.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d355387e-9d39-4281-bb8c-6fbddc93af8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Bombing Iran? Sure. Meeting with the Taliban at Camp David? Why the fuck not? Sell out the Kurds? Who are they again? No, really, who are they? Trump's like a geopolitical toddler smashing Legos just to see what topples over. And laughing at the destruction when he's done.
And now it's happening. The Israel-Iran conflict is real. It's dangerous. And it's pulling a thread on the frayed MAGA quilt. Some in this coalition of the willing to destroy America, like Mark Levin and Lindsey "Lick the Boot" Graham, are lining up to bang the war drums, all but begging Trump to put on some Idi Amin-esque, metal-littered military garb and go all Greg Stillson from "The Dead Zone."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b8cae75e-2faf-4824-9e35-af680b1db415?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_The missiles are flying. Hallelujah, hallelujah_
Others--like Jack Posobiec, Candace Owens, Rep. Tom Massie--are scrambling to remind voters that "endless wars" are bad...blah blah blah...it's Democrats' fault..blah blah blah...Jews control the world...etc. Remember, Posobiec has openly called for the overthrow of American democracy, Owens said Hitler did good work domestically and Massie is one of the half dozen who posed for the Charlie Manson deluxe Christmas Card with his family--including kids--all holding assault rifles.
As I said, right side, but for very wrong reasons (except that first one about endless wars). Don't break out the champagne yet, though. Like these guys do constantly on tv:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/33b1b1ff-e68e-4905-b491-2dadd4c0edc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Remember, MAGA was never bound by ideas. Or strategy. Or the ability to exhibit an adult-level emotional IQ. It was--and still is--bound by the permission slip Trump provided for open cruelty and bigotry, vengeance vs those who got ahead because they were allowed to compete--as well as those who fought for the opportunity--pure greed and, of course, the cultish devotion of people who think tough talk is tough-ness.
If Trump flips again tomorrow and says bombing Iran is some woke shit, half the movement will fall back in line and chant "USA! USA!" like nothing ever happened. The other half will forget that the potential for a war even existed, much as they do about the existence of vegetables or multi-syllabic words. And there's a good chance Trump will indeed flip--let's remember: infrastructure week, tariffs, NATO, tariffs, a healthcare bill, tariffs, and also let's not forget: tariffs.
Trump switches sides more than a triple agent. And if anything involves critical thinking, work or not getting distracted by a squirrel outside there is a solid chance he'll change his view. Honestly, his pure stupidity and laziness usually saves us from the worst outcome, and there's good reason to think that will also happen here.
Still, there's reason for concern. If he goes through with war, you can be sure he'll 1) fuck it up 2) quit paying attention halfway through 3) strike a match in what's already a political and theological tinderbox with no idea what to do. You see, Trump voters, we didn't just tell you Trump would suck harder than an anaconda on a year-long vegan diet for our health. Actually, come to think of it, we did.
We'll see if the MAGA machine eats itself. But if this foreign policy fracture holds--and it feels like it may, as it seems like a final straw after dissension on tariffs, the budget bill, mass deportations and more--it may be the first real proof Trump's grip on the GOP isn't divine, that it's just been a really long and effective con.
But every con has an expiration date. I assume only more so when it involves body bags.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/68b635b4-fa59-40cf-bc19-9b36a6637dc9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

My 3 year-old was reading the Times when he turned to me, gravely, and asked: "Daddy, why did the senator ask mean questions to the nice plastic surgery lady?" And when I told him "because that lady pledged to liberate LA from socialists," he started crying.

subject: Riding with Pride and purpose
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
|
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=8698%2E5257348%2Eenbubp)
Hi Derek,
Just a couple of weeks ago, I rode 80 miles — from San Francisco to Santa Cruz — as part of the AIDS/LifeCycle ride to raise funds for two incredible LGBTQ+ organizations: the San Francisco AIDS Foundation and the Los Angeles LGBT Center.
Participating in this ride is one of the most meaningful things I’ve done as a public servant. Because it’s about more than a bike ride. It’s about the people who passed when there was no treatment. It’s about protecting future generations. Fighting back against stigma, discrimination, and indifference.
And this Pride Month, when LGBTQ+ rights are under attack across the country, this fight is more important and more challenging than ever.
I’m fighting for equal rights and protections against discrimination. Because your sexual orientation or gender identity should not determine your worth, your pay, your status in society, your right to be a parent, or start a business, or get a job.
These rights are under attack by the Trump administration. GOP leaders are attacking the transgender community, specifically targeting trans kids. They’re cutting funding for the emergency suicide hotline for LGBTQ+ youth. They even want to rename the USNS Harvey Milk.
**We must stay in this fight. Not just during Pride month, but every single day.**
**[Will you pitch in today to help fuel my fight and help me keep standing up for the LGBTQIA+ community in the Senate?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=q22025_abs_em.PyXMxO&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250618_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=8698%2E5257348%2Eenbubp)**
[DONATE](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=q22025_abs_em.PyXMxO&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20250618_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=8698%2E5257348%2Eenbubp)
---
From protecting trans youth to expanding access to HIV prevention and care, to pushing back on hateful rhetoric and dangerous legislation, I’m all in. But I can’t do it alone.
Let’s keep riding forward with pride.
Thank you.
— Adam
P.S. I want to thank the people who donated toward my Aids/LifeCycle ride. Your support means the world to me, to all the participants, and to the organizations benefiting from your donation. Your messages of support moved me too, including some of the below:
_I know and love people within the LGBTQ community and I want to thank you for what you are doing. My twin brother died from AIDS when we were 33. I’m 72 now and I miss him dearly each day. Ride knowing you have my love and support._
_Thank you. Please protect my own trans family members and all trans folks, their friends and families everywhere. We need to stand up for human rights and against bigotry, discrimination and cruelty._
_As a long term HIV/AIDS survivor I am moved hearing that you will ride in the AIDS ride. As a California resident I am proud to say that I voted for you... Thank you for your service in our Government. And thank you for fighting for the LGBTQ community._
_I’m proud that you’re my senator and that you’re supporting LGBTQ+ young people!_

Dear Peter,

I’ve spent my life fighting for Wyoming — because this is my home. I was born and raised on a cattle ranch in Laramie County, and my roots here run deep.

I know what it means to work hard, live free, and take pride in where you come from. That’s the Wyoming way — and it’s exactly what I’ve taken with me to Washington.

From my years in the State Legislature to serving as your U.S. Senator, I’ve never stopped fighting to protect the values that make Wyoming strong and America great.

**Whether it’s securing our borders, defending the Second Amendment, or creating good-paying jobs, I’ve always put Wyoming and America first.**

As Chair of the Senate Western Caucus and a member of the conservative Senate Steering Committee, I pushed back against the Biden administration’s extreme agenda — especially when it came to reckless spending, anti-energy mandates, and efforts to lock up our lands.

I’ve fought to protect our coal, oil, gas, and uranium industries, because I know how vital they are — not just to Wyoming’s economy, but to America’s future.

This year, I’ve also been fighting to cut red tape, secure our border, and lead on crypto policy that protects innovation and freedom. **I’m in the Senate to make Washington work for Wyoming — _not the other way around._**

_But now, our work is under serious threat._

**Democrats have made it clear: flipping the Senate is their top priority in 2026.** They know that without the Senate, they can’t ram through their radical agenda.

That’s why they’re pouring money into races across the country — including right here in the West — trying to tip the balance of power in their favor.

**_We can’t let that happen._**

If we lose our Senate majority, we lose the ability to block dangerous policies and stand up for the freedoms we hold dear. [**That’s why I’m asking for your help today.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=4f67dc36880d4ec98c405b4933f1d491&_e=-YBvB8P4etXFue6XxxxmI2FT1pxjtO122obzpNndUVepA6E9n1RCj8XVfULHO2SFmUEmkyyUilzvNWaeH8D_G5NcDLTZycGKzBftTFI_J3-Mz8fKcV6yXjKhnFf-Kn7ILFRxpDBAu8MVonHAJwWU4wu5LjL1ks6j1ESTfU6SDy9aJDKZdZYSvUEc9uKpLXvuaLzP8Zx9n18-UfrMYbEqvshB17AdNBb1Lns_PRKm_NncIwz4cW1qhvaUjW1e8XJnnx_e8Lp7QnYcTUqD7a2a4et58Fp4i8kKCSJYAfD7wjSmrfqgV6bw3lwPMAp-tOrX-KqJyUsCffPaBI6WB6U8WksOBeiHpqxvtMuV8yjmnNIcRO1-B2DcTeq0SCaRxyRXdJ3rwBC4sHHDBnJbWby8NB-emCIxgfSv2edd0E4Pj0aksOQ_1_07YkJq12dXBm4Pvv9JCPoE7M7LE1obIl7nKyv2hfpWmapN7S8W4At2O-2Xvi8lafPYC3hdZdXBc6k4IJaMYV9mS6bsP39UVOLRlMYn8yObFvkZtmx2ofuuh0JT2lOdIKYKfJ8osEz3hYeoSvoqABplkrpY2o6Ctg_NpzfgoGL-anT7PBqL4wZrvMHqeTBC31uqT4ZIap6sR9rxmGJ1e-PGYtB5UjdSfpfIt2tC4X2ENeUJHxrM-uGH_KqmOK-EqzQC6U9LlNSzCGHr)

June 2025 Newsletter
Groundbreaking at Park Place
Last week, I had the honor of joining fellow elected officials and community leaders for a Groundbreaking Ceremony and Celebration at Park Place at Addison Road Metro. This is a cornerstone project for the Blue Line Corridor and a major step forward for Capitol Heights. The transformative $96.1 million development will bring much-needed housing, economic opportunity, and revitalization to the community. This represents one of the largest single development investments our community has ever seen. I was proud to stand alongside Governor Wes Moore, U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks, Maryland Comptroller Brooke Lierman, Acting County Executive Tara Jackson, Councilman Calvin Hawkins, and Banneker Ventures President Omar A. Karim as we marked this important milestone.
Park Place at Addison Road is more than just a construction project. It reflects a bold commitment to the families of Capitol Heights and Seat Pleasant. This development underscores our belief that everyone deserves safe, walkable neighborhoods, access to reliable public transit, and community spaces that foster connection and opportunity. After years of collaboration, advocacy, and persistence, this groundbreaking milestone is a testament to our shared vision coming to life. I am proud to have helped secure state funding that made this possible, and I am grateful to Banneker Ventures for their vision and partnership. I can’t wait to see what the future holds for this new chapter!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88468/images/Groundbreaking%20at%20Park%20Place.jpg]
Collington Life Care Community
On June 6th, I had the distinct honor of introducing my good friend and proud Prince George’s County resident, Senator Angela Alsobrooks, to the residents of Collington Life Care Community. Collington is a remarkable not-for-profit community that provides our seniors with the support, healthcare, and enriching educational opportunities they need to thrive and remain actively engaged in the life of our county.
We are truly fortunate to have Collington as part of the fabric of Prince George’s County, and we thank them for their unwavering commitment to serving our seniors with compassion and excellence.
It’s always a pleasure to connect with residents and hear their perspectives on how we can work together to strengthen our communities and move Maryland forward. I’m especially grateful to Senator Alsobrooks for her tireless work in Washington, D.C., where she consistently fights to protect Maryland’s seniors, safeguard their healthcare, and stand up to Trump’s harmful policies that threaten our most vulnerable citizens.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88468/images/Collington%20Life%20Care%20Community.jpg]
Protect Our Federal Workers Act
During the previous legislative session, I proudly introduced Maryland’s HB1424, the Protect Our Federal Workers Act, and, alongside my colleagues, we passed this crucial bill into law. I’m even prouder to say that on June 5th, the Maryland Department of Labor launched the Federal Emergency Loan Program , opening an online portal for qualified former federal employees to apply for an emergency, no-interest loan. This loan program was created in response to this bill, and my colleagues and I worked tirelessly to ensure that any Maryland federal worker would not live in fear that losing their job would mean economic ruin.
These civil servants didn’t lose their jobs because they failed us; our federal government failed them . Reckless decisions in Washington turned public servants into political targets. These are our neighbors, our veterans, our essential workers who labor day in and day out to ensure our freedoms and the progress of this country; they are not criminals who are “the enemy within.” No American should ever live in fear because of their political affiliation, identity, or their job. Thank you to my colleagues in the House and Senate, as well as to Governor Moore, for his support of this bill and the program.
Click this link [https://labor.maryland.gov/federalworkers/?fbclid=IwY2xjawK5KU9leHRuA2FlbQIxMQBicmlkETFhcmkyQUhteWpjQlR4dUtLAR7O1TLlHNt9HPSsPSn5ZJhqoYeb5VTRQrAXgMPNE3j6vUVF9CZTT_-j0QcHnQ_aem_JilQgmVdkpDAI9B0_e-sXA] to learn more about the program, how you could qualify, and where to apply.
Greater Baden Health Clinic
I was honored to attend the ribbon-cutting ceremony for the new Greater Baden Health Clinic in Lexington Park. It was a privilege to stand alongside so many dedicated healthcare advocates, including my good friend and mentor, Congressman Steny Hoyer, as we celebrated this important milestone.
This new facility will provide critical health services to a community that has long been underserved and deserves increased access to quality care. I was proud to sponsor legislation in support of Federally Qualified Health Centers, such as Greater Baden, as well as legislation establishing Health Equity Resource Communities—initiatives designed to bring medical services directly to underserved areas, including Lexington Park.
It is incredibly rewarding to see these efforts take shape and to know that more Marylanders will now have access to the care they need and deserve.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88468/images/GBHC1.png]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88468/images/GBHC2.png]
Juneteenth 2025
On June 19th, we commemorate Juneteenth, the day that marked the end of slavery in the United States, and the long-overdue emancipation of those who had endured the cruelties of bondage.
At a time when diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts are being erased from the federal government, private companies, and educational institutions, it is absolutely vital to recognize the strength in our differences and to honor the generations who struggled, fought, and sacrificed to make this country a place of greater justice and belonging for all.

# SCOTUS upholds Tennessee ban of minor sex-change surgeries
The Supreme Court **[came to a majority decision today](https://substack.com/redirect/93b459f1-f0fd-4353-936a-0034a399f25b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that Tennessee's ban of sex changes in minors does not violate any part of the U.S. Constitution and can remain in place.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/93b459f1-f0fd-4353-936a-0034a399f25b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Court Decision** : On June 18, the U.S. Supreme Court upheld Tennessee's ban on gender-affirming medical treatments--such as puberty blockers and hormone therapy--for minors, in a 6-3 ruling, deciding that the law is not discriminatory and therefore does not violate the Equal Protection Clause of the 14th Amendment.
* **Majority Opinion** : Chief Justice John Roberts, writing for the conservative majority, stated that the law involves contested medical and policy issues beyond judicial resolution and does not classify based on sex or transgender status, thus satisfying rational basis review.
* **Opposing Opinion** : Justice Sonia Sotomayor dissented, warning that the decision "authorizes untold harm to transgender children" and allows legislatures to engage in discrimination under the guise of medical regulation.
* **Broader Impact** : The ruling potentially enables similar laws in 26 states to stand, affecting hundreds of thousands of transgender youth and potentially shifting authority of things like transgender bathroom access, school sport participation and transgender healthcare, to state legislatures.

# Democrat NYC Mayoral candidate ARRESTED after assaulting I.C.E officials
Immigrations and Customs Enforcement **[(I.C.E) officials arrested a New York City mayoral candidate](https://substack.com/redirect/185cb4b6-757a-4fdd-abce-ad1500d0861c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after he reportedly assaulted Department of Homeland Security (DHS) officers on Tuesday.
* **Incident & Charges**: On Tuesday, New York City Comptroller and mayoral candidate Brad Lander was handcuffed by masked I.C.E agents in a Manhattan immigration court hallway after linking arms with an immigrant and questioning the agents' authority to arrest U.S. citizens without a judicial warrant. DHS charged him with "assaulting law enforcement and impeding a federal officer."
* **Lander protested the detainment** , insisting agents lacked a warrant for an arrest of the immigrant, even after an alleged warrant was held up to him in the video. The footage also shows him stating, "I'm not obstructing" as he was pinned against a wall.
* **Political Commentary** : The arrest--in the middle of NYC's early voting period--sparked swift criticism from Democratic leaders including Governor Hochul, Attorney General Letitia James, and AOC, who portrayed the move as federal overreach and political intimidation.
* **Wider Context** : Lander's detention is part of a broader pattern of high‐profile confrontations between I.C.E and Democratic officials (including Sen. Padilla and Rep. McIver), amid an aggressive ramp-up in immigration enforcement by the Trump administration.
