# Democrats hide from Senate hearing on Biden's mental decline
**[Democrat lawmakers boycotted](https://substack.com/redirect/5ce298ec-1bd8-4b87-a0b8-91ef182e2803?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** today's Senate hearing regarding allegations of factions covering up President Joe Biden's mental decline during his term.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5ce298ec-1bd8-4b87-a0b8-91ef182e2803?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Senate hearing launched today** : Republican Senators John Cornyn (R‐TX) and Eric Schmitt (R‐MO) held a Senate Judiciary Committee session titled "Unfit to Serve: How the Biden Cover‐Up Endangered America and Undermined the Constitution," asserting that President Biden's cognitive decline was concealed by the Biden Administration's aides and liberal media.
Coryn said in his opening statement:

> _" There was a conspiracy to hide the president's true condition by his family, by his staff, by the media, and many elected officials. This was a constitutional crisis bigger than President Biden, bigger than any single election, and one that cannot be absolved by the collective apology of the press and an election where the president's party lost._
* **Key allegations presented** : The hearing featured video clips of verbal missteps--such as Biden's blunders during the June 2024 debate--and pointed to the use of an autopen for official signatures as evidence of diminished mental acuity.
* **Strong Democratic backlash** : All Senate Democrats except Sen. Peter Welch skipped the hearing. Sen. Dick Durbin briefly attended, condemned the proceedings as partisan grandstanding, and then exited in protest.
* **Selective scrutiny criticized** : Media observers and critics noted that Republicans focused on Biden's age-related fitness without similarly examining older GOP figures--such as Sen. Mitch McConnell (83), and Sen. Chuck Grassley (91)--suggesting the inquiry was politically motivated.

Dear Derek,
Senate Republicans just announced they want to sell our public lands.
**Under their proposal, over 250 million acres of public lands across western states would be eligible for sale, and the federal government would be _required_ to sell at least 2 million acres.** Even worse, it gives the Trump administration broad discretion to choose what lands to sell—with no public input and no priority for Tribal Nations to bid, even on areas that contain sacred sites.
In California, Republicans want to authorize the sale of lands next to Yosemite, Mount Shasta, Big Sur, and Lake Tahoe.
Californians—and visitors from across the country and around the world—know that these are some of the most beautiful places on the planet. They should belong to all of us as Americans. Once they’re sold off, we aren’t getting them back.
It’s doubly offensive that the money from these sales will go to funding tax breaks for the ultra wealthy.
We need to get loud and make clear to our representatives that public lands belong in public hands. subject: Justice Department Files Statement of Interest in Judicial Watch’s Lawsuit to Compel Oregon to Clean Voter Rolls
body:
Judicial Watch announced recently that the U.S. Department of Justice
filed a statement of interest in Judicial Watch’s lawsuit that
calls on Oregon’s secretary of state to make “a reasonable effort
to remove” the registrations of ineligible registrants from the
voter rolls as required by federal law (Judicial Watch, et al. v. The
State of Oregon et al. (No. 6:24-cv-01783)). U.S. District Court
Judge Michael J. McShane set a hearing in the case for June 18 at
10:00 a.m.

| | | _**- A Personal Note from Congresswoman Young Kim - **_
Dear, Peter,

You may not know me, but this is Congresswoman Young Kim, and I would really appreciate it if you would take a moment to read my story.

I am a Christian, mother, wife, small business owner, and a first-generation immigrant.

When I moved to America, I didn't speak a word of English. But I worked hard, put myself through school, and am now one of the first Korean-American women to serve in Congress. But my road hasn't been exactly easy.

_In 2018, I ran for Congress and I lost my election._

But I wouldn't let myself give up no matter how hard the Democrats tried to make me. So I ran again in 2020, and despite MILLIONS in spending against me, we won. **Together, we flipped a DEEP BLUE seat RED for the FIRST TIME in 26 years. **

Every year since then, we've continued to defy the odds to stop the woke Democrat machine and keep this seat for House Republicans.

_I 'm nothing special._ Just an immigrant who came to this country - not knowing a word of English - who lived the American Dream. And I've made it my mission on Capitol Hill to help make that same Dream possible for everyone.

But now, the Democrats are once again after my seat. They are angry that I flipped a deep Blue seat Red, and they want it back. _The far-Left knows that my seat could very well decide the House Majority and they are DESPERATE for revenge._

clean_body: The MAGA Supreme Court just made a horrible ruling that puts trans kids and equal protection at risk. | | Peter, We’re devastated. The MAGA Supreme Court just dropped their newest ruling—this time upholding a discriminatory ban on gender-affirming care for transgender kids. The ruling allows states to deny trans youth access to medically necessary care. 27 states currently have such bans on the books, impacting over 100,000 transgender kids. One of the most shocking parts of this whole case? It puts bigoted political ideology over scientific consensus. The MAGA Court is choosing to ignore decades of established medical research proving gender-affirming care is safe, appropriate, and effective. Instead, the Court is siding with MAGA extremists and anti-trans propagandists, legitimizing this manufactured controversy in the highest court in the land. Justice Sotomayor said it best in her dissent, saying that with this ruling “the Court abandons transgender children and their families to political whims.” We’ve already jumped into action with a statement condemning the ruling, and we’ve distributed talking points and social media to our allies and activists across the country. It’s not just trans kids that will suffer from this ruling. Setting an extremely dangerous precedent, this decision actually means that the Court is allowing discrimination on the basis of sex. The Tennessee law clearly and plainly discriminates on the basis of sex, no matter how many knots the Court ties itself into trying to deny it. In her dissent, Justice Sotomayor also wrote: “The Court ... does irrevocable damage to the Equal Protection Clause and invites legislatures to engage in discrimination.” She’s right. It’s hard to believe that in 2025, the American justice system is paving the way for discriminatory legislation and jeopardizing protections for marginalized groups. But that’s where we’re at. name: Wes Moore
subject: Deeply personal to me
body:
[ https://act.wesmoore.com/go/9?t=1001&akid=193%2E1086043%2EbI1bS0 ]Wes Moore for Governor[ https://act.wesmoore.com/go/9?t=1002&akid=193%2E1086043%2EbI1bS0 ]Wes Moore for Governor

I am sure you saw what Donald Trump did in honor of the Army’s 250th
Anniversary over the weekend... throwing a whole $45 million parade for his
birthday in Washington, D.C.

Now, in Maryland, we got to show how we celebrate. I joined some of my
fellow service members for a run. We shared stories. I thanked them for
their service. We even sang some of my favorite songs passed down through
generations of soldiers.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250618-2?refcode=em-20250618-2&refcode2=193_1086043_bI1bS0&akid=193%2E1086043%2EbI1bS0 ]Wes Moore with service members

Listen, I joined the Army when I was 17 years old. It changed the
trajectory of my life. The things I learned in the military I still use to
this day, and the people I served alongside are my brothers and sisters
for life.

So, the Army’s 250th Anniversary was deeply personal to me. Not only
because we got to celebrate, but because I know what it means to fight for
the freedoms that allow for that celebration.

This weekend we honored our armed services and the importance of those who
raised their hands to serve by coming together. Not by using them as props
for a parade.

But it shouldn’t surprise us that this is how this administration chose to
do it.

Whether it is firing federal workers – many of whom are military veterans
– or cutting veterans’ services, it’s clear this administration doesn’t
value our servicemembers. Every chance they get, this administration puts
their own petty interests first.

Peter, that’s not
what service is about.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250618-2?refcode=em-20250618-2&refcode2=193_1086043_bI1bS0&akid=193%2E1086043%2EbI1bS0 ]When I took office, I took an oath to serve every Marylander. No matter if
that is on the 250th anniversary of our nation’s Army – or any other day –
I’ll always put my people and our country first.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250618-2?refcode=em-20250618-2&refcode2=193_1086043_bI1bS0&akid=193%2E1086043%2EbI1bS0 ]But I count on grassroots support from folks like you to keep up the
fight. If you can chip in any amount today to power our campaign, I’d
appreciate it,
Peter.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250618-2?amount=5&refcode=em-20250618-2&refcode2=193_1086043_bI1bS0&akid=193%2E1086043%2EbI1bS0 ]Donate $5 ››

Elevate,

Wes

Peter,
Virginia voters just made their voices heard in record numbers during yesterday's Primary Election, and if you're anything like me, you saw something special in those results: the beginning of something bigger.
That's why I'm proud to join forces with GOTV PAC to support Virginia Democrats up and down the ballot this November, protecting the House of Delegates and electing Abigail Spanberger as our next governor.
This moment matters. Not just because of what's at stake here in Virginia, but because of what it says about who we are and what kind of future we're building together.
But we know this won't be easy.
In my role as Campaigns Chair for the House Democratic Caucus, I've had the privilege of working alongside some extraordinary candidates running to represent all of us – not just the powerful or well-connected.
But MAGA Republicans are already pouring an enormous amount of resources into these races because they know that what happens in Virginia this year will send a powerful signal about how the American people feel about Donald Trump's agenda heading into the midterms.
That's why the work that organizations like GOTV PAC are doing is so important. By investing early and running effective phone banks, they're giving our candidates the foundation they need to succeed.
Right now, seventeen of our endorsed candidates are in tough, competitive races. So if you’re able, I’m asking you to split a donation between GOTV PAC and my PAC, Secure Progress. name: Eliza Walton
subject: Let’s change wildlife funding, Peter!
body:
https://secure.everyaction.com/1NY3ms0tAE-JBKKPkqb4CA2?contactdata=lVE/uyMo3qWWMRMVql9rVMJ/GaXE+JirqAkT2PDffoFaN/h5v11srlVddN9XYMORWN6KoyqY8nFwKZOJEwlriCjxEFTu/XVeRkrOKHYd7nsfGBpKxhOkiIEJUlKo7Z8w [https://secure.everyaction.com/1NY3ms0tAE-JBKKPkqb4CA2?contactdata=lVE/uyMo3qWWMRMVql9rVMJ/GaXE+JirqAkT2PDffoFaN/h5v11srlVddN9XYMORWN6KoyqY8nFwKZOJEwlriCjxEFTu/XVeRkrOKHYd7nsfGBpKxhOkiIEJUlKo7Z8w]
Dear Peter,
If you’ve kept up with our emails, you may have already heard of HB 2977 [https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2025R1/Measures/Overview/HB2977] : a bill that would provide critical funding to address Oregon’s biodiversity crisis and to protect and recover the native wildlife and habitats that make Oregon so special. I’m reaching out today to provide an exciting update that HB 2977 has just advanced from the House Committee on Revenue and will soon be up for a vote in the full House of Representatives. With Oregon losing biodiversity at an alarming rate and wildlife conservation woefully underfunded for decades, HB 2977 would establish ongoing and unprecedented state funding for wildlife conservation. This monumental opportunity cannot be overstated, as dependable ongoing funding will benefit wildlife and Oregonians for generations. Will you take action for Oregon’s wildlife today? [https://secure.everyaction.com/1NY3ms0tAE-JBKKPkqb4CA2]
Take action now [https://secure.everyaction.com/1NY3ms0tAE-JBKKPkqb4CA2?contactdata=lVE/uyMo3qWWMRMVql9rVMJ/GaXE+JirqAkT2PDffoFaN/h5v11srlVddN9XYMORWN6KoyqY8nFwKZOJEwlriCjxEFTu/XVeRkrOKHYd7nsfGBpKxhOkiIEJUlKo7Z8w]
We know how much Oregonians value our wildlife, as well as our tourists. The objective of HB 2977 is to increase funding for wildlife and habitat conservation ( read more [https://www.olcv.org/oregons-wildlife-needs-you/] ). After much negotiation to garner broad support from diverse parties, the base bill was amended to significantly increase the overall funding for wildlife conservation priorities generated through an increase in the statewide transient lodging tax.
This bill, with the newly added amendment, would be a historic win for wildlife conservation, saving many of Oregon’s native species from the brink of extinction, and providing a new ongoing revenue stream for many wildlife programs. In particular, the amendment added funding for several of our wildlife priorities this session, including a Wildlife Stewardship Program, wildlife crossings and habitat connectivity, invasive species response, and programs to combat illegal poaching of wildlife. It would also allow ODFW to hire a full-time wolf coexistence biologist to increase knowledge and reduce conflict in interspecies relationships. In addition, the bill would enable the state to invest in conservation of numerous wildlife species and urgent needs that have previously been overlooked.
Oregon’s wildlife deserve more. If we don’t protect them now by passing HB 2977, modernizing our manner and scale of wildlife conservation funding, we will continue to lose many of Oregon’s special native species that make our beloved state what it is. Now is our time to change the conversation and prioritize wildlife conservation for good. Please show your lawmakers that you support this bill and Oregon’s native wildlife! [https://secure.everyaction.com/1NY3ms0tAE-JBKKPkqb4CA2]
Take action now [https://secure.everyaction.com/1NY3ms0tAE-JBKKPkqb4CA2?contactdata=lVE/uyMo3qWWMRMVql9rVMJ/GaXE+JirqAkT2PDffoFaN/h5v11srlVddN9XYMORWN6KoyqY8nFwKZOJEwlriCjxEFTu/XVeRkrOKHYd7nsfGBpKxhOkiIEJUlKo7Z8w]
Thank you for your advocacy,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Eliza.png]
Eliza Walton (she/they)
OLCV Coalition Director

clean_body: [] Dear Peter, If you’ve kept up with our emails, you may have already heard of HB 2977 [] : a bill that would provide critical funding to address Oregon’s biodiversity crisis and to protect and recover the native wildlife and habitats that make Oregon so special. I’m reaching out today to provide an exciting update that HB 2977 has just advanced from the House Committee on Revenue and will soon be up for a vote in the full House of Representatives. With Oregon losing biodiversity at an alarming rate and wildlife conservation woefully underfunded for decades, HB 2977 would establish ongoing and unprecedented state funding for wildlife conservation. This monumental opportunity cannot be overstated, as dependable ongoing funding will benefit wildlife and Oregonians for generations. Will you take action for Oregon’s wildlife today? [] Take action now [] We know how much Oregonians value our wildlife, as well as our tourists. The objective of HB 2977 is to increase funding for wildlife and habitat conservation ( read more [] ). After much negotiation to garner broad support from diverse parties, the base bill was amended to significantly increase the overall funding for wildlife conservation priorities generated through an increase in the statewide transient lodging tax. This bill, with the newly added amendment, would be a historic win for wildlife conservation, saving many of Oregon’s native species from the brink of extinction, and providing a new ongoing revenue stream for many wildlife programs. In particular, the amendment added funding for several of our wildlife priorities this session, including a Wildlife Stewardship Program, wildlife crossings and habitat connectivity, invasive species response, and programs to combat illegal poaching of wildlife. It would also allow ODFW to hire a full-time wolf coexistence biologist to increase knowledge and reduce conflict in interspecies relationships. In addition, the bill would enable the state to invest in conservation of numerous wildlife species and urgent needs that have previously been overlooked. Oregon’s wildlife deserve more. If we don’t protect them now by passing HB 2977, modernizing our manner and scale of wildlife conservation funding, we will continue to lose many of Oregon’s special native species that make our beloved state what it is. Now is our time to change the conversation and prioritize wildlife conservation for good. Please show your lawmakers that you support this bill and Oregon’s native wildlife! [] Take action now [] Thank you for your advocacy, [] Eliza Walton (she/they) OLCV Coalition Director P.S.: OLCV’s spring membership drive is going on now, click here [] to renew your membership and support important legislation, like HB 2977, getting across the finish line! name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: What does Medicaid mean to you?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
One of the most powerful things you can do to fight back against these attacks on health care is to share your story.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2572%2E4032634%2EjJufdg)
---
Our budgets show our values. Plain and simple. Trump and his Republican allies have shown us their values loudly and clearly: **Cut Medicaid for millions so that Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk don’t have to pay their fair share.** Trump’s Big Ugly Bill that the Senate is debating slashes health care funding for an estimated 16 million people. Let’s put that into perspective: Half of all newborn babies today get their health care through Medicaid. Virtually every person with a serious disability who has a home health aide, or a wheelchair, or a breathing apparatus, relies on Medicaid for this care. About half of all seniors in nursing homes rely on Medicaid. Cuts to Medicaid could mean that local hospitals don’t get reimbursed when these folks show up in the emergency room. The consequence of unreimbursed care could mean a number of hospitals just completely shut down. Then it's not just the people who receive benefits from Medicaid that get hurt. It's everybody in the community who then has to drive farther and farther out to receive the care they need. It’s all of us. Republicans know that this is a deeply unpopular plan. They’re still going to try to pass it anyway. That's why it is so important — right now — to get people to speak up. This is the moment. **One of the most powerful things you can do to fight back against these attacks on Medicaid is to share your story. Do you rely on Medicaid? Does your loved one rely on Medicaid? Are you worried about your local hospital staying open? Do you already have to travel a long way to receive care?** [**If you have a story to share, I would like to hear from you right now. Please click here to share your story with our team. I will make sure voices like yours are heard in this fight.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-medicaidstory/?source=EMZ26G_SOC_E_20250618_V1S1&t=8&akid=2572%2E4032634%2EjJufdg) | [**SHARE YOUR STORY**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-medicaidstory/?source=EMZ26G_SOC_E_20250618_V1S1&t=9&akid=2572%2E4032634%2EjJufdg)
---
I’m going to fight my heart out to protect Medicaid coverage for the millions of Americans who rely on it.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

Both attorneys are involved with Freedom Counsel.

clean_body: Millions of people walked away from their jobs because they were being forced to take the deadly COVID shot. | | Patriot, Millions of people walked away from their jobs because they were being forced to take the deadly COVID shot. Americans sensed their rights were being violated by their employers and by the government, so they stood up for their constitutional rights and walked away from their jobs and livelihoods. Now, we’re holding these corrupt employers and the government accountable! Two attorneys in LA, Jonathan Cherne and Alan Reinach, recently represented an LA Physician Assistant who was fired for being unvaccinated. They won their client $912,000 for her unconstitutional firing. She was also awarded $15,000 per month until reinstated. With interest, it will be more than $950,000. Both attorneys are involved with Freedom Counsel. This case reminds me of why I started this organization in the first place. I'm Warner Mendenhall, co-founder of Freedom Counsel, and I'd like to share with you the important work we're doing at Freedom Counsel to help those affected by COVID policies. Freedom Counsel is trying to make sure we are developing pathways for citizens to be empowered to defend their rights and to fight and reclaim this country for what it really is. Freedom Counsel emerged from the COVID Litigation Conference in Atlanta in 2023 with a clear purpose: to provide legal support and coordination for those seeking justice and accountability through the court system. We work alongside dedicated attorneys, medical professionals, scientists, and concerned citizens to address the challenges many Americans continue to face. But we can’t fight this alone. One of the things I find most compelling is that American citizens have really stood up for their own constitutional rights. We’ve had a real awakening to – Constitutional rights Privacy Religious freedom Medical freedom Right to speak All of these rights have been revived in the population because they came under attack by our own government. The government came at us through every institution in our daily lives. This is the new civil rights movement. Our rights have been taken away in every area of our lives, but American citizens are reclaiming the Constitution and our individual rights by holding these bad actors accountable. Americans know what happened during COVID was wrong. That’s why so many millions of people are still fighting for accountability from the government. We need to make sure that everyone understands we are a movement, and we are going to keep going after employers who violated religious rights, the right to bodily autonomy, and medical exemptions. Patriot, while the legal process can be lengthy, we're committed to supporting those seeking justice through proper legal channels. If you've been affected by these policies or know someone who has, please know that you're not alone. We're here to help coordinate legal resources and support. Over the last four years, we have already won tremendous battles for religious rights, educational rights, employment rights, and so much more. You can help those affected continue to find their path to justice by donating today. Thank you for supporting our mission. name: Deb Haaland
subject: Can I send you my recipe for green chile chicken posole?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
Cooking has always been a way for me to foster connection and build community.
#
Friend, it’s Deb Haaland. I’m running for Governor of New Mexico and Mandela Barnes and The Long Run said I could reach out to you.
One thing you should know about me is that **I love to cook.**
My love of cooking New Mexican cuisine started early, thanks to the hours I spent watching my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She wouldn’t let us kids in the kitchen while she cooked, but I’d perch myself outside and watch her through the window for hours. I still hold those memories close as I prepare my favorite traditional New Mexican dishes.
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=partner_ms_dh_em_longrun.uQL3Ri&refcode=em250518-1-360&refcode2=5571.196590.t9l1co&t=1&akid=5571%2E196590%2Et9l1co)
---
_New Mexico chiles – the best in the world!_
**There’s something powerful about connecting with others over a home cooked meal.** When I was in law school at UNM, I’d make chicken green chile stew for student gatherings, and I made that same dish for my Congressional colleagues during the 2019 winter holiday season. I even cooked chile and tortillas for the water protectors when I traveled to Standing Rock during the protests against the Dakota Access Pipeline.
Cooking became more than a hobby after I decided to start my own salsa business. I worked out of a commercial kitchen and bought my red chile pequin from a farm in northern New Mexico. I’d prepare my salsa and deliver jars to mom-and-pop shops across the state, often with Somáh riding with me in the back seat.
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=partner_ms_dh_em_longrun.uQL3Ri&refcode=em250518-1-360&refcode2=5571.196590.t9l1co&t=2&akid=5571%2E196590%2Et9l1co)
---
_Here’s Somáh posing with jars of my homemade salsa. Kids in New Mexico start early... 🌶️_
**For me, cooking has always been a way to foster connection and build community, which is exactly what we’re doing now as we grow our campaign for New Mexico.** I’ve had the chance to sit down with New Mexicans in living rooms and at kitchen tables to hear about their lives, their struggles, and their hopes for the future. Every conversation is another reminder of the incredibly high stakes in this race – and proof that if we organize around our shared values, we will win.
[**Will you split $5 between my campaign and The Long Run today? If you donate through this link, I’ll even send you my recipe for green chile chicken posole!**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=partner_ms_dh_em_longrun.uQL3Ri&refcode=em250518-1-360&t=3&akid=5571%2E196590%2Et9l1co)

Deb 🌶️

Some elected officials can't take a joke.

And unfortunately, they think they have the power to do something about it.

After the governor of California saw a video parody of a politician, he responded by saying the video should be "illegal." Then the California legislature fast-tracked and passed two bills, banning certain political speech.

body:
Let’s rise to meet this moment.
|
---

Peter,
The progress we’ve made to build a more inclusive democracy is a testament to generations of heroes.
That includes ordinary Americans like my late friend John Lewis, who marched in Selma, endured billy clubs and tear gas, and put his body on the line for the right to vote. Without courageous champions like him, Congress would not have passed the Voting Rights Act 60 years ago this August.
But despite the profound sacrifices of people like John, some politicians today are still trying to roll back our hard-won progress on equal rights and equal representation.
They’re working to take power away from their fellow citizens — even when it means violating the promises of the Voting Rights Act. They’re drawing district lines that deny communities of color the opportunity to elect the candidates of their choice. They’re making it harder to vote in ways that disproportionately hurt seniors and anyone who works hard to make ends meet.
And they think they’ve got a better chance of clinging to power if they get to choose their voters instead of the other way around.
**That’s why groups like the National Redistricting Action Fund are fighting for a truly representative democracy. They are ****_the_****strategic force against racial and partisan gerrymandering, with a systematic 10 Year Plan to have the fairest maps possible in 2032. They work to protect the right to vote so our leaders can’t escape accountability.**
**[And they are counting on you, Peter, to power this work. I’m counting on you, too. Will you join me in supporting the National Redistricting Action Fund today, and help build an America that is stronger because it better lives up to our more fundamental values?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/109842566/552429942/-776240876?refcode=don_aotl_tier1_email_ObamaJune_email_20250618-AOTL-Tier1-ObamaJune-Obama_var1&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250618-AOTL-Tier1-ObamaJune-Obama_var1&utm_campaign=ObamaJune&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU0NjQ1NGY0LTk3NGMtZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=A7wOL9bPiUgbLR0HsTLUFB6LArvGWQZn2AFJ6YDQWNk=)**

With support from people like you, the fair maps movement is standing up for the promise of democracy.
In court, the National Redistricting Action Fund’s affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation, has successfully fought to uphold the Voting Rights Act and won new district maps with new opportunities for equal representation. Like in Alabama, which elected two Black members of Congress for the first time in history in 2024 after voters fought for and won a new map that reflected their voices.
And the National Redistricting Action Fund's work — including organizing citizens to advocate against gerrymandered maps and holding map manipulators accountable — has resulted in what _The New York Times_ called “the fairest House map of the last 40 years.”
But too many Americans still live under manipulated maps that deny them a real voice in their state legislatures or in Congress. And we face ongoing threats to basic fairness in our elections.
This spring, House conservatives launched one of the most striking attacks on voting rights in decades. The SAVE Act would make it harder to vote by forcing people to show a costly and burdensome amount of proof of their citizenship in person before gaining access to the ballot box.
The new requirements could disenfranchise millions of Americans who can’t afford a passport, can’t take time off work to visit an elections office, or don’t have a birth certificate that matches their married name.

Fellow Conservative,

Figuring out where to start writing this email has been tough because the content of the copy you’re about to read is, quite honestly, absurd.

I’ve spent most of my adult life in some of the world’s most dangerous places. **I’ve seen what happens when governments collapse, the truth is suppressed, and strong men choose silence instead of standing up. But I never thought I’d see it here, not in America.**

And yet last week, sitting in a congressional hearing, Minnesota Governor Tim Walz was asked a straightforward question:

_**“Can you define what a woman is?”**_

_**He couldn’t.**_
_**He wouldn’t.**_

He dodged. He deflected. And then he sat in silence.

Let me be clear — this wasn’t a trick. This wasn’t a “gotcha” question. This was the easiest test a leader can face: tell the truth, or bow to the mob.
**
Governor Walz chose the mob.**

That moment — that silence — wasn’t just embarrassing. It was dangerous.

Because when leaders abandon truth to protect their politics, it’s the people who suffer. And right now, our daughters, wives, sisters, and grandmothers are being erased in real time—not just from locker rooms and playing fields but from language itself.

My name is Adam Schwarze.

**I’m a proud Minnesotan and a retired Navy SEAL.** I joined the Marine Corps after 9/11 and served in special operations, deploying 13 times to over 70 countries.

_**I didn’t just fight for this country — I bled for it.**_

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=5f34a934ef2b4455ae1869d8540d7d8c&_e=DnlbSFfAxSbyTTudyaRyxLg_MNawQ0aS1uZoJj5Sh93QX31Ky4yzHrFdNoZdZDNUtD7TTyhr0SfQ8Zor8E-c8SBVby55yFmES8nD6P80H3wOd1FGUMBZE3IbADpYgBWSIyZL0Ofwbzxj4vRdWp6ikLrLtQXr4_a_m4Anf2LTjAsF3aYGogdgqq5JF4aguoK5moInzW19LRDKl2tG3Iiq-vpHMV1vI-97vqQY03-J_rqx26gO7_ArSoX_zUAn-KtPqKpPzQJaKWjBP2_k_M_nI8zgTaK-f07PXEtPswkwTO-0MV3pL3vNtVl4cSazcd29rhmk5W6NIFaGNeDakLFzU9Ke7Ucc5PBX78-Sgnaq_-VH1H9gsjnHzvPm5Tz0PT4gxC_m4u-H0v76yiXVxDYwtqfkVBhpbPQNxq1rzPrSum-GRVEM30bKuSQ-5ib1da-IDy6kRh6uqqrml_EJ4Qj3MNthwlxDw6nr_G9Dt4cE2pCo9WxSn6kCdIKWOPtLvLs7bVAk6OhT3_FCF11EBXThNbhnB396kuZByz2l3dQvU-luk2tlK80J-2h5Y7NF98rmEyLVbuZtRj8m9KdBanj-YPyyZsyodHc_Weu7ef-r0tvO5MxthcRP_PK6xzM_1-NzvOuLvXB2pA_9O7yStCrIeGJg9neDNB-oW7f3T481Eokz3Wk3buLzc3BTds_UlwxcKjYkwCAVP_usgI2U7z88hPyV9NLNbeAhTAMX_S3Urx5iPy4nH7B-z-O3vIUN_ifKmOK9f_Hxc3jtgxmVoSCUg8rccNQEN4NB99k3WfS-SJM%3D)

And I never imagined I’d be running for public office. But something has changed. Something fundamental.

When a governor can’t say what a woman is...
When “men in women’s sports” becomes policy...
**When the truth becomes optional, and lies become virtue, that’s when I knew I had one more mission.**

I’m running for the United States Senate because I believe America is worth saving. But it’s going to take more than votes — it’s going to take backbone.

I’ve seen the cost of freedom. I’ve watched friends give everything so that future generations could live in a country built on truth. I won’t let their sacrifice be undone by a political class too cowardly to speak plainly.

That’s why I need your help today.

clean_body: I’m not a biologist, but I certainly know the definition of a woman. | Fellow Conservative, Figuring out where to start writing this email has been tough because the content of the copy you’re about to read is, quite honestly, absurd. I’ve spent most of my adult life in some of the world’s most dangerous places. I’ve seen what happens when governments collapse, the truth is suppressed, and strong men choose silence instead of standing up. But I never thought I’d see it here, not in America. And yet last week, sitting in a congressional hearing, Minnesota Governor Tim Walz was asked a straightforward question: “Can you define what a woman is?” He couldn’t. He wouldn’t. He dodged. He deflected. And then he sat in silence. Let me be clear — this wasn’t a trick. This wasn’t a “gotcha” question. This was the easiest test a leader can face: tell the truth, or bow to the mob. Governor Walz chose the mob. That moment — that silence — wasn’t just embarrassing. It was dangerous. Because when leaders abandon truth to protect their politics, it’s the people who suffer. And right now, our daughters, wives, sisters, and grandmothers are being erased in real time—not just from locker rooms and playing fields but from language itself. My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a proud Minnesotan and a retired Navy SEAL. I joined the Marine Corps after 9/11 and served in special operations, deploying 13 times to over 70 countries. I didn’t just fight for this country — I bled for it. And I never imagined I’d be running for public office. But something has changed. Something fundamental. When a governor can’t say what a woman is... When “men in women’s sports” becomes policy... When the truth becomes optional, and lies become virtue, that’s when I knew I had one more mission. I’m running for the United States Senate because I believe America is worth saving. But it’s going to take more than votes — it’s going to take backbone. I’ve seen the cost of freedom. I’ve watched friends give everything so that future generations could live in a country built on truth. I won’t let their sacrifice be undone by a political class too cowardly to speak plainly. That’s why I need your help today. The Democratic Party isn’t just drifting — it’s sprinting toward something unrecognizable. First, they said men could use women’s bathrooms. Then they demanded that girls compete against biological males in school sports. Now, they claim they don’t even know what a woman is. And Governor Walz? He’s not a bystander. He’s a willing participant in this charade. His likely successor — my opponent — is even more radical. So if you’re like me — and Stand with me. Fight back. Let’s win this. With gratitude, Adam Schwarze Retired Navy SEAL Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate - Minnesota FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate Adam Schwarze is a former Navy SEAL and Marine.
